wylie: zhus pa brgyad du dris pa las/_/
english: from the eight questions asked,

wylie: sku rnams bkod pa bcu drug yin/_/
english: there are sixteen arrays of embodiments;

wylie: de yi yan lag sum cu gnyis/_/
english: their branches number thirty-two.

wylie: drug pa'i lus dang yan lag rdzogs/_/
english: The sixth body and its branches are complete.

wylie: dris lan bco brgyad pa'o/_/
english: [Source heading: Eighteenth reply.]

wylie: _'byung ba'i 'dod pa 'di lta ste/_/
english: The account of the elements is as follows.

wylie: spyi mthun las kyi bye brag las/_/
english: Through the particulars of shared karma,

wylie: sems can las kyi brten so yis/_/
english: sentient beings, with karma as their support,

wylie: phyi yi 'byung ba la brten nas/_/
english: depend on the outer elements.

wylie: las dang gos dang dbang po dang*/_/
english: Actions, clothing, and faculties, [N-055]

wylie: 'khor dang skye ba rdzogs par 'dod/_/
english: retinues and births, are held to become complete.

wylie: nang 'byung las kyi rim pa ni/_/
english: The sequence of activity of the inner elements is this:

wylie: sas ni lus kyi gzhi byas te/_/
english: earth makes the body's foundation; [N-055]

wylie: bskyed pas sha ni smin par 'dod/_/
english: through its generation, maturation into flesh is held to occur.

wylie: chus ni lus kun bsdus nas ni/_/
english: Water gathers the whole body together;

wylie: bskyed pas khrag tu smin par 'dod/_/
english: through its generation, maturation into blood is held to occur.

wylie: mes ni lus kun smin byas te/_/
english: Fire brings the whole body to maturity;

wylie: bskyed pas drod du smin par 'dod/_/
english: through its generation, maturation into warmth is held to occur.

wylie: rlung gis lus kun 'degs pa la/_/
english: Wind raises the whole body;

wylie: bskyed pas dbugs su smin par byed/_/
english: through its generation, it brings about maturation into breath.

wylie: de yi sgra don bye brag gis/_/
english: Through the particulars of their word and meaning,

wylie: spyi yi rnam pa nges bstan pa/_/
english: the general aspects are definitely taught. [N-055]

wylie: gzugs la bslabs pas lus zad 'gyur/_/
english: Through training with form, the body will be exhausted. [N-056]

wylie: sgra yis skad rnams shes par 'gyur/_/
english: Through sound, languages will be known. [N-T03]

wylie: dris ni bcud kyis len pa 'grub/_/
english: Through smell, taking nourishment from vital essences is accomplished. [N-T16]

wylie: ros ni dngos po bdud rtsir bsgyur/_/
english: Through taste, substances are transformed into nectar.

wylie: tshig chad song /
english: [Source note: Words have been lost.] [N-056]

wylie: rtsi ni sems can gzhan don dang /_/
english: The nectar completes the benefit of other sentient beings

wylie: rang gi don yang rdzogs pa'o/_/
english: and also one's own benefit. [N-056]

wylie: dris lan bcu dgu pa/
english: [Source heading: Nineteenth reply.]

wylie: sems can dus ni rnam pa brgyad/_/
english: The times of sentient beings have eight aspects:

wylie: nad dang rlung dang tsha ba ni/_/
english: illness, wind, and heat;

wylie: shes pa nyon mongs byang sems dang /_/
english: knowing, afflictions, awakening ordinary mind, [N-T25]

wylie: ye shes nyid dang 'byung ba'o/_/
english: primordial knowing itself, and the elements. [N-057]

wylie: dbyar dgun ston dpyid dus bzhi la/_/
english: In the four times—summer, winter, autumn, and spring—

wylie: rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa bzhi/_/
english: wind, bile, phlegm, and their conjunction, the four,

wylie: so so'i gnas nas 'phos pa yis/_/
english: shift from their respective places.

wylie: sems can rlung sems 'pho ba'i dus/_/
english: This is the time of sentient beings' wind-mind shifting.

wylie: 'di dus rlung ni brtseg ma 'am/_/
english: At this time wind is layered,

wylie: yang na dal zhing bar chad pa/_/
english: or slow and interrupted,

wylie: yang na phra zhing tsha bar 'gyur/_/
english: or subtle and hot. [N-057]

wylie: 'di yis tshe rnams thung bar byed/_/
english: This shortens lifespans;

wylie: shes pa 'phrog cing myos pa'o/_/
english: it steals knowing and brings stupefaction.

wylie: skabs su g.yeng zhing 'pho bar 'gyur/_/
english: At intervals [knowing] becomes distracted and shifts.

wylie: nyon mongs lnga po 'dus pa yis/_/
english: Through the gathering of the five afflictions,

wylie: ngan song gnas su 'phen par byed/_/
english: [beings] are projected into places of lower destiny.

wylie: byang chub sems ni 'jil ba dang /_/
english: Awakening ordinary mind dissipates, [N-T25]

wylie: rab tu 'phrigs shing phra bar 'gyur/_/
english: flutters greatly, and becomes subtle. [N-057]

wylie: ye shes gsal ba ma yin no/_/
english: Primordial knowing is not clear.

wylie: 'byung ba byer zug las 'phros nas/_/
english: The elements proliferate from their dispersal and penetration. [N-057]

wylie: sems can gcig gi dus yin no/_/
english: This is the time of an individual sentient being.

wylie: sems can spyi yi dus dag ni/_/
english: As for the times common to sentient beings:

wylie: dang po dpag tu med pa nas/_/
english: from the first, immeasurable [lifespan],

wylie: tha ma tshe lo bcu pa'i bar/_/
english: to the final lifespan of ten years,

wylie: dus kyi rim pa drug cu 'byung*/_/
english: sixty successive periods occur.

wylie: nyon mongs las dbang gzhan 'gyur phyir/_/
english: Because afflictions change under the power of karma,

wylie: rang mthun spyi don las kyi yang*/_/
english: through the karma of concordant, common purposes, [N-057]

wylie: tshe lo nyid ni stong pa las/_/
english: from a lifespan of a thousand years,

wylie: 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la yang*/_/
english: also among the people of Jambudvīpa,

wylie: brgya yi bar la dus rim ni/_/
english: down to a hundred, the successive periods

wylie: sum cu dag tu 'gyur ba yin/_/
english: number thirty.

wylie: de nas brtsams te bcu yi bar/_/
english: Beginning from there, down to ten,

wylie: dus kyi rim pa sum cu 'byung*/_/
english: thirty successive periods occur.

wylie: goms pa'i 'pho dus brgyad rim gyis/_/
english: Through eight stages in the times when habituation shifts,

wylie: spyod pa phyi nas ngan par 'gyur/_/
english: activity subsequently becomes worse.

wylie: dus kyi gdon dang mu ge dang*/_/
english: Periods of afflicting spirits and famine,

wylie: mtshon dang nad kyis dus 'byung ste/_/
english: weapons and illness, arise.

wylie: bye brag mang ste dus rim pa'o/_/
english: Their particulars are many: these are the successive periods. [N-057]

wylie: dris lan nyi shu pa/
english: [Source heading: Twentieth reply.]

wylie: phyi rol 'byung ba rlung la yang*/_/
english: Among the outer elements, wind

wylie: nam mkha'i khams dang sbyar ba ste/_/
english: is joined with the element of space.

wylie: de la chu ste de steng sa/_/
english: Upon it is water, and above that, earth.

wylie: rgya khyon sa la mthug khod snyoms/_/
english: The earth's extent and thickness are equal. [N-058]

wylie: grangs med bzhi dang sa ya gcig_/
english: ‘Four innumerables and one million’;

wylie: gcig ni de yi bzhi cha stong /_/
english: ‘one is a thousand of its quarter.’ [Numerical construction unresolved.] [N-058]

wylie: gling rnams bkod dang ri rab dang /_/
english: There are the arrays of continents and Mount Meru,

wylie: dpag bsam shing dang nor bur bcas/_/
english: together with wish-granting trees and jewels,

wylie: nyi zla so so'i lha rnams dang*/_/
english: the sun and moon, and the respective gods,

wylie: rgya mtsho chen po'i zabs kyis bskor/_/
english: surrounded by the depths of the great ocean.

wylie: ri rab rnams dang chu bran dang*/_/
english: The Meru mountains and tributary streams

wylie: rin chen bdun gyis nges par bkod/_/
english: are definitely arrayed with seven precious substances.

wylie: nang ste gzugs med dang po la/_/
english: Inwardly, first there is the formless [realm];

wylie: gzugs kyi khams te 'od gsal ni/_/
english: then the form realm, clear light;

wylie: rim pas 'dod pa'i khams su yang*/_/
english: gradually, also in the desire realm,

wylie: zla ba dri ma med pa dang /_/
english: from the stainless moon

wylie: nyi ma rab tu snang byed las/_/
english: and the sun that makes things shine brightly,

wylie: 'jig rten khams ni mched pa ste/_/
english: the world system proliferates. [N-058]

wylie: gzhan 'phrul la sogs yas rim bzhin/_/
english: Beginning with Mastery over Others' Emanations, in descending order,

wylie: de nas lha min gnas dag ste/_/
english: then the abodes of the demigods,

wylie: gling bzhi'i mi rnams rim gyis so/_/
english: then the humans of the four continents, successively.

wylie: nyon mongs bdag dang bcas pa yis/_/
english: Through afflictions together with selfhood,

wylie: ngan song gnas ni rim par chags/_/
english: the places of lower destiny gradually form.

wylie: rigs drug so so'i 'gro ba ni/_/
english: The respective beings of the six classes

wylie: nang du chags te lus bong dang /_/
english: form within; their bodily size

wylie: tshe tshad spyi mthun las kyi yang /_/
english: and lifespan, through shared karma,

wylie: so so'i gnas dang bsod nams ni/_/
english: and their respective abodes and merit,

wylie: gling dang mthun par gnas pa'o/_/
english: abide in accordance with their continent. [N-058]

wylie: don ni 'jig dang chags pa dang /_/
english: The meaning is destruction and formation,

wylie: gnas pa nyid dang stongs pa dang*/_/
english: abiding itself and becoming empty;

wylie: skyes dang rgas dang na dang 'chi/_/
english: birth, aging, illness, and death—

wylie: srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor nyid du'o/_/
english: the mechanism of existence itself.

wylie: dris lan nyer gcig pa'o/_/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-first reply.]

wylie: dus kyi 'pho ba 'di lta ste/_/
english: The shifting of times is as follows.

wylie: thog ma dpag tu med pa nas/_/
english: From the initial immeasurable [lifespan]

wylie: tha ma bcu yi bar dag las/_/
english: down to the final ten [years],

wylie: yar skyes pa dang mar 'grib pa/_/
english: there are increases upward and decreases downward.

wylie: nad dang mu ge mtshon dang ni/_/
english: Illness, famine, and weapons—

wylie: bskal chung gsum gyis mtshams sbyar nas/_/
english: the three minor ages—join the intervals.

wylie: drug cu dag ni thal nas kyang*/_/
english: When sixty have thus passed,

wylie: me yis bdun la chu yis bdun/_/
english: seven [destructions] are by fire, and seven by water.

wylie: de ltar bcu bzhi rdzogs nas ni/_/
english: When these fourteen have been completed,

wylie: lhag ma rlung gis 'jig pa yin/_/
english: the remaining [destruction] is by wind. [N-059]

wylie: de ltar drug cu gnas pa dang*/_/
english: Thus there are sixty [periods] of abiding,

wylie: 'jig pa'i yun kyang de tsam las/_/
english: and the duration of destruction is as long;

wylie: drug cu'i bar la stongs par gnas/_/
english: for sixty [periods] it abides empty.

wylie: de ltar brgya dang brgyad cu chags 'jig stongs pa las/_/
english: Thus, from one hundred and eighty [periods]—[Source gloss: ‘Formation, destruction, emptiness.’] [N-059]

wylie: yun gyis bskal pa dang por 'dod/_/
english: the duration is reckoned as the first age.

wylie: de ltar brgya dang brgyad cu la/_/
english: Likewise, with one hundred and eighty,

wylie: bar gyi bskal pa gnyis pa'o/_/
english: there is the second, intermediate age.

wylie: de ltar sbrags chags 'jig stongs pa pa de tsam las/_/
english: Through that many such repetitions—[Source gloss: ‘Formation, destruction, emptiness.’] [N-059]

wylie: bskal pa chen po gcig yin no/_/
english: there is one great age.

wylie: dris lan nyer gnyis pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-second reply.]

wylie: zhag ni bcu phrag gsum pa yang*/_/
english: Three tens of days

wylie: zla ba dag ni gcig yin te/_/
english: constitute one month.

wylie: de ltar bcu gnyis rdzogs pa las/_/
english: When twelve such [months] are complete,

wylie: lo ni gcig tu 'dod pa'o/_/
english: they are reckoned as one year.

wylie: nang dang dgong mo bdun brgya dang /_/
english: When seven hundred

wylie: nyi shu dag ni rdzogs pa las/_/
english: and twenty mornings and evenings are complete,

wylie: zhag ni sum brgya drug cur 'dod/_/
english: they are reckoned as three hundred and sixty days.

wylie: de rnams rdzogs pas lo ni gcig_/
english: Their completion constitutes one year.

wylie: zhag ni pho mo las kyi dbye/_/
english: Days are distinguished as male and female according to activity. [N-060]

wylie: zla ba ston dpyid dbyar dang dgun/_/
english: The months of autumn, spring, summer, and winter—

wylie: re re dag la gsum gsum gyis/_/
english: three for each—

wylie: 'jug cing 'byung ba'i rnam lnga byed/_/
english: enter into operation and enact the five aspects of the elements.

wylie: byi ba glang dang stag nyid dang*/_/
english: Rat, ox, and tiger;

wylie: rna ring sbrul dang 'brug dang yang /_/
english: long-eared hare, snake, and dragon;

wylie: rta dang lug dang spre'u dang*/_/
english: horse, sheep, and monkey;

wylie: bya dang khyi phag bcu gnyis kyis/_/
english: bird, dog, and pig—through these twelve,

wylie: 'byung ba'i rtsis rnams spel ba'o/_/
english: the elemental calculations are extended. [N-061]

wylie: dris lan nyer gsum pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-third reply.]

wylie: _tshe ni spel dang gso ba dang*/_/
english: The rites for increasing and restoring life,

wylie: bsgrub dang rgyas pa'i cho ga nyid/_/
english: accomplishing it and making it flourish—

wylie: rnal 'byor pa yis sbyor shes na/_/
english: when a yogin knows how to apply them,

wylie: nyi zla dag dang mnyam par 'gyur/_/
english: [the lifespan] becomes equal to the sun and moon. [N-062]

wylie: gzhan ni mnyam dang gzhig pa las/_/
english: For others, from equalizing and dismantling,

wylie: dgug dang bcings dang gshed la dbab/_/
english: there are summoning, binding, and bringing down a slayer,

wylie: spor zhing bsad pa'i las rnams kyang /_/
english: expelling, and the activities of killing.

wylie: rnal 'byor pa yis bkug dkrug kyang _shes na/_/
english: When a yogin knows how to summon, [Source variant: ‘Stir also.’] [N-062]

wylie: 'gro ba rnams ni dbang du 'dus/_/
english: beings are gathered under his power.

wylie: dbang thang spel dang gso ba dang /_/
english: Increasing and restoring ascendancy,

wylie: gnas shing chags par byed pa nyid/_/
english: making it abide and become established,

wylie: gzhan ni mnyam pa'i sbyor ba nyid/_/
english: and, further, the application of equalizing—

wylie: rnal 'byor pa yis brtsam par bya'o/
english: these a yogin should undertake. [N-062]

wylie: dris lan nyer bzhi pa'o/_/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-fourth reply.]

wylie: byer zug snyoms la bcu gnyis te/_/
english: Dispersal, penetration, and equalizing comprise twelve:

wylie: sa chu me rlung bzhi la yang*/_/
english: for earth, water, fire, and wind, the four,

wylie: gsum gsum nyid de bcu gnyis la/_/
english: three each make twelve. [N-063]

wylie: sa yi zug pas rdul rnams 'byin/_/
english: Earth's penetration produces particles;

wylie: byer ba yis ni yan lag 'byin/_/
english: its dispersal produces branches;

wylie: snyoms pas lus 'byung rdzogs pa'o/_/
english: through its equalizing, the body's elements are complete.

wylie: me yi zug pas nad du byed/_/
english: Fire's penetration produces illness;

wylie: byer ba dag gis lus gnas 'gyur/_/
english: through its dispersal, the body will abide;

wylie: snyoms pas 'byung ba gnas par byed/_/
english: its equalizing makes the elements abide.

wylie: rlung gi zug pas 'byung ba skyob/_/
english: Wind's penetration protects the elements;

wylie: byer bas las gzhan 'jig pa las/_/
english: its dispersal destroys other activities;

wylie: snyoms pas rlung sems gcig du sdud/_/
english: its equalizing gathers wind-mind into one.

wylie: gsum gyis byed pa'i mtha' 'di'o/_/
english: These are the limits of what the three do.

wylie: chu yi zug pas sa 'dus la/_/
english: Through water's penetration, earth gathers together.

wylie: chu'i byer snyoms gnyis chad/
english: [Source note: The two—water's dispersal and equalizing—are missing.] [N-063]

wylie: zug pa zug pa 'phrad pa yis/_/
english: When penetration meets penetration,

wylie: gang mi 'grub cing 'jig par 'gyur/_/
english: nothing is accomplished, and destruction follows. [N-063]

wylie: byer ba nyid kyis nad du 'gyur/_/
english: Through dispersal itself, illness occurs;

wylie: snyoms pas rtsi sbyor sman rnams 'grub/_/
english: through equalizing, elixir preparations and medicines are accomplished.

wylie: me dang rlung gnyis phung po 'jig_/
english: Fire and wind together destroy the aggregates;

wylie: byer bas las kun 'grub pa la/_/
english: through dispersal, all activities are accomplished;

wylie: snyoms pas 'khrug pa'i las mthar 'gyur/_/
english: through equalizing, activities of conflict reach their culmination.

wylie: chu dang me las don rab 'grub/_/
english: Through water and fire, purposes are thoroughly accomplished;

wylie: byer bas gzhan la 'jug par 'gyur/_/
english: through dispersal, one enters another;

wylie: snyoms pas tshe ring dbang thang 'grub/_/
english: through equalizing, long life and ascendancy are accomplished.

wylie: sa dang rlung gis zhi ba 'grub/_/
english: Through earth and wind, pacification is accomplished;

wylie: byer bas rgyas dang dbang du byed/_/
english: through dispersal, increase and subjugation are enacted;

wylie: snyoms pas mngon spyod las rnams 'grub/_/
english: through equalizing, aggressive ritual activities are accomplished. [N-063]

wylie: rlung dang chu yi bya ba nyid/_/
english: As for the activity of wind and water:

wylie: byer bas dge ba'i las kun 'grub/_/
english: through dispersal, all virtuous activities are accomplished;

wylie: snyoms pas dmag las rgyal ba'o/_/
english: through equalizing, there is victory in warfare.

wylie: sa dang mes ni spel ba 'grub/_/
english: Through earth and fire, increase is accomplished;

wylie: byer bas 'byung ba spo ba 'grub/_/
english: through dispersal, transferring the elements is accomplished;

wylie: snyoms pas gshed kyi cho ga 'grub/_/
english: through equalizing, the slayer's rite is accomplished.

wylie: zug byer las kyi mtha' la yang*/_/
english: At the culmination of the activities of penetration and dispersal,

wylie: nges par 'gyur ro dbang po'i lha/_/
english: [these results] will definitely occur, Deity of the Faculties. [N-063]

wylie: dris lan nyer lnga pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-fifth reply.]

wylie: 'khor ba'i las rgyud gcad 'dod na/_/
english: To cut the karmic continuum of samsara:

wylie: bya ba bral bar rdzogs pas rdzogs/_/
english: complete in freedom from doing, it is complete.

wylie: mtha' dang bral bas dbus mi gnas/_/
english: Free from extremes, it does not abide in a center.

wylie: yongs su rdzogs pas dngos dang bral/_/
english: Entirely complete, it is free from entities.

wylie: lhag ma med pas cha shas min/_/
english: Without remainder, it is not a portion.

wylie: gcig tu ma yin gnyis mtha' zad/_/
english: Not being one, the two extremes are exhausted.

wylie: du mar mi snang gcig las 'das/_/
english: Not appearing as many, it is beyond one.

wylie: brjod du med pas tshig gi gzhi/_/
english: Inexpressible, [it is] the Ground of words. [N-064]

wylie: dngos bral stong pa snying po'i don/_/
english: Free from entities and empty: the core meaning.

wylie: phyogs su ma lhung lta ba'i don/_/
english: Not falling to any side: the meaning of the view.

wylie: 'di shes 'khor ba'i lam 'gag go/_/
english: Knowing this blocks the path of samsara.

wylie: gnad las byung ba'i mngon sum nyid/_/
english: Direct perception arising from the crucial point itself—

wylie: goms pa'i stobs kyis 'khrul pa 'jig_/
english: through the power of familiarity, delusion is destroyed.

wylie: rang bzhin dag pas g.yengs pa med/_/
english: With intrinsic nature pure, there is no distraction.

wylie: rgyun du gnas pas 'bral ba med/_/
english: Abiding continuously, there is no separation.

wylie: rang snang yin pas rnam rtog zad/_/
english: Being self-appearance, differentiating conceptualization is exhausted.

wylie: rlung zad ye shes nyid la spyod/_/
english: Wind exhausted, one engages in primordial knowing itself.

wylie: 'di dang 'bral ba med pa yis/_/
english: Through never being separate from this,

wylie: 'gro drug lam gyi rgyun gcod do/_/
english: one cuts the flow of the paths of the six destinies.

wylie: byas shing bcos pa med pa yis/_/
english: Without making or contriving,

wylie: shugs su spyad pas 'khrul pa 'dag_/
english: through activity by its own momentum, delusion is purified. [N-064]

wylie: lhug mar byung bas skye ba med/_/
english: Arising in letting be, there is non-arising.

wylie: 'dzin chags med pas ci dgar rol/_/
english: Without grasping or attachment, one plays as one pleases.

wylie: rnal du phab pas rnyog pa sangs/_/
english: Settled into its own condition, turbidity clears.

wylie: rang bzhin yin pas thabs las 'das/_/
english: Being intrinsic nature, it is beyond methods.

wylie: 'dis kyang 'khor ba'i sgo 'gag go/_/
english: This, too, blocks the gate of samsara.

wylie: dris lan nyer drug pa'o/_/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-sixth reply.]

wylie: ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/_/
english: The qualities of the teacher, the buddha, the Blessed One,

wylie: yon tan brjod kyis langs pa min/_/
english: cannot be encompassed by expression.

wylie: phun sum tshogs pa drug cu yis/_/
english: Through sixty excellences,

wylie: bstan pa dam pa'i gzhi ma 'dzin/_/
english: he upholds the foundation of the sacred teaching. [N-065]

wylie: 'jig rten khams su yun ring bar/_/
english: For a long time in the world system,

wylie: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas pa la/_/
english: the buddha's teaching abides.

wylie: yon tan brjod kyis mi langs pa/_/
english: Its qualities cannot be encompassed by expression.

wylie: de ni gang las byung zhe na/_/

wylie: bsdams pas gtems kyang byung 'gags la btsir bas 'ching*/_/

wylie: mnan pas gnas la gcud pas gsal/_/

wylie: gcus pas rgal la drang bas shes/_/

wylie: 'phul bas sdod la drag pas zin/_/

wylie: de ltar rtsa yis gnad kyis kyang*/_/

wylie: sangs rgyas gnas ni mtshon pa'o/_/
english: the abode of buddhahood is indicated.

wylie: rtsa la brten pa'i rlung dag ni/_/
english: The winds that depend on the channels

wylie: nyi khri dang ni stong phrag gcig_/

wylie: drug brgya dag tu 'gyu ba ni/_/
english: and six hundred [times].

wylie: 'gyu ba chen po'i rlung du 'dod/_/
english: These are reckoned as the winds of great movement.

wylie: de yi byed las rnam pa gnyis/_/
english: Their activity has two aspects:

wylie: gyen la rgyu dang thur du sel/_/
english: moving upward and clearing downward.

wylie: yang na mkhas pas gnad nyid btsal/_/
english: Or, when a skilled person seeks the crucial point,

wylie: rtsa nas nges par 'gyu ba ni/_/
english: those definitely moving from the channels—

wylie: 'bum phrag gcig dang khri phrag gnyis/_/
english: one hundred thousand, twenty thousand,

wylie: stong phrag drug dang brgya phrag drug_/
english: six thousand, and six hundred—

wylie: rtsa nas nges par 'byung ba ste/_/
english: definitely arise from the channels.

wylie: 'gyu ba chung ba'i rlung du 'dod/_/
english: They are reckoned as the winds of small movement. [N-075]

wylie: nad dang gdon dang tshe yi dus/_/
english: Times of illness, afflicting spirits, and lifespan

wylie: mkhas pas shes par bya de yang /_/
english: are to be known by the skilled person.

wylie: de yi gnad kyis sbyor thabs 'bad/_/
english: Through their crucial point, one strives in methods of application.

wylie: chen po la ni dus brtsi ste/_/
english: For the great [movements], one calculates the time

wylie: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub brtag_/
english: and examines supreme and common accomplishments.

wylie: so so'i las kyi bye brag gis/_/
english: Through the particulars of their respective activities,

wylie: las dang ye shes gnyis bar dang /_/
english: between karma and primordial knowing, the two,

wylie: nyon mongs rnams dang rtog med las/_/
english: and among afflictions and freedom from conceptualization,

wylie: so so'i grangs tshad bzung ba ste/_/
english: one takes the respective numerical measures. [N-075]

wylie: sgom pa pos ni rnam par sbyang*/_/
english: The cultivator trains thoroughly;

wylie: des ni so so'i rlung tshad zin/_/
english: through this the measures of the respective winds are grasped.

wylie: dris lan so bzhi pa'o/_/
english: [Source heading: Thirty-fourth reply.]

wylie: thig le'i chos nyid brtan 'dod pas/_/
english: One wishing to stabilize the nature of phenomena of the sphere: [N-076]

wylie: don dam dang ni kun rdzo ba las/_/
english: there are the ultimate and the relative.

wylie: re zhig kun rdzob thig le la/_/
english: For now, relying on the relative sphere,

wylie: brten nas sangs rgyas 'dod pa yis/_/
english: one wishing for buddhahood—

wylie: rigs ma mtshan nyid rdzogs pa ni/_/
english: a woman of the family, with complete characteristics,

wylie: lha dang lha min tshangs pa dang*/_/
english: from gods, demigods, or Brahmā's [class],

wylie: gal te rigs ngan mu stegs sam/_/
english: or even a low-caste non-Buddhist—[N-076]

wylie: _mtshan nyid rdzogs pa dag mthong na/_/
english: if one sees [her] complete characteristics,

wylie: 'gugs pa'i sbyor ba nges brtsams nas/_/
english: one definitely undertakes the application of summoning.

wylie: brten bya nyid dang rtsa rnams dang /_/
english: Through what is to be relied upon, the channels,

wylie: dmigs bya dag gis lus rdzogs bya/_/
english: and the objects of focus, one completes the body. [N-076]

wylie: de nas kun rdzob thig le nyid/_/
english: Then the relative sphere itself

wylie: dbab cing gzung dang bzlog pa dang*/_/
english: is lowered, retained, and reversed;

wylie: rtsa la gdab cing rlung dang bsre/_/

wylie: stong nyid brtan bya blo rjes bcad/_/

wylie: lus dang sems gnyis go bzlog bya'o/_/

wylie: don dam thig le brtan pa yis/_/

wylie: chos sku stong pa'i yul rnams rnyed/_/

wylie: thig le stong pa'i sgron ma nyid/_/

wylie: gtems te rig pa'i rtsal rnams sbyang /_/

wylie: nyin mtshan med par goms spyod na/_/
english: Engaging in familiarity without [distinguishing] day and night,

wylie: 'di nyid rtsol bral mngon du snang /_/
english: this itself appears directly, free from effort.

wylie: de ni 'byongs pa'i tshad yin no/_/
english: This is the measure of proficiency.

wylie: dris lan so lnga pa'o/_/
english: [Source heading: Thirty-fifth reply.]

wylie: mkha' 'gro ma yi las kyi mtha'/_/
english: The extent of the activities of ḍākinīs,

wylie: dbye na brjod kyis mi langs kyang /_/

wylie: mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya/_/
english: nevertheless, it will be explained in brief.

wylie: rten 'brel zab mo dag gis kyang /_/
english: Through profound dependent connections,

wylie: zas gos la sogs bral ba dang /_/
english: one is free of food, clothing, and so forth,

wylie: bde chen zag med thob pa dang /_/
english: attains uncontaminated great bliss,

wylie: 'byung bzhi dag la dbang sgyur 'gyur/

wylie: dngos la brtags pa'i las mtha' yis/_/
english: Through the culmination of activities examined in actuality,

wylie: gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/_/
english: and through examining the domains of form, sound, smell, taste,

wylie: reg gi khams la brtags pa yis/_/
english: and touch, [N-T03]

wylie: 'jig rten thun mong las mtha' dang*/_/
english: the culmination of common worldly activities

wylie: mngon par shes pa rdzogs pa dang /_/
english: and higher knowing are perfected,

wylie: zhing khams rnams la longs spyod do/_/
english: and one enjoys the fields.

wylie: dris lan so drug pa/
english: [Source heading: Thirty-sixth reply.]

wylie: 'pho ba'i bye brag rnam pa gsum/
english: There are three particular kinds of transference, [N-T32]

wylie: dbang po dag gi dbye ba yis/_/
english: according to distinctions in faculties:

wylie: 'od gsal ba dang sgyu lus dang*/_/
english: clear light and illusory body;

wylie: tha ma lus ngag yid la'o/_/
english: for the last, body, speech, and mental faculty. [N-077]

wylie: lus ngag 'pho ba rnam pa gnyis/_/
english: Transference of body and speech has two aspects:

wylie: dngos su 'pho dang dngos med do/_/
english: actual transference and nonactual transference.

wylie: dngos ni rlung gis sbyang ba'i thabs/_/
english: The actual is a method of training through wind.

wylie: sgra dang bzo dang sgyu rtsal dang /_/
english: Through training in word, craft, illusory expressiveness,

wylie: rten cing 'brel la sbyangs pas ni/_/
english: and dependent connections,

wylie: so so'i 'byung ba nang mthun pas/_/
english: when the respective elements accord inwardly,

wylie: lus ngag yid kyis gtad pas 'grub/_/
english: it is accomplished by directing body, speech, and mental faculty. [N-077]

wylie: dngos med sems kyi goms stobs brtan/_/
english: For the nonactual, stabilize the power of the ordinary mind's familiarity.

wylie: sgyu lus rmi lam dag la sbyangs/_/
english: Train the illusory body in dreams.

wylie: de nyid 'byongs pas lus nyid kyang*/_/
english: Through proficiency in this, the body itself

wylie: grib ma'i rnam pa lta bur 'gyur/_/
english: becomes like the form of a shadow.

wylie: des ni bar ma do yi lus/_/
english: Through this, the body of the intermediate state

wylie: 'di dag ngang du 'dzin par 'gyur/_/
english: comes to be held within this condition. [N-077]

wylie: 'od gsal 'pho ba rab kyis te/_/
english: Clear-light transference is for the superior:

wylie: gnyid kyi bsam gtan la sbyangs nas/_/
english: having trained in the meditative stabilization of sleep,

wylie: 'byongs pas nyin dang mtshan med par/_/
english: through proficiency, without [distinguishing] day and night,

wylie: phyi rol snang ba gsal ba na/_/
english: when outer appearances are clear,

wylie: 'dis ni 'od gsal chen po 'grub/_/
english: through this great clear light is accomplished.

wylie: 'di yi lus kyang lugs kyang gsum yin te/_/
english: Its body, too, is threefold. [Source variant: ‘Manner also.’] [N-077]

wylie: brtson 'grus kyi ni rim pa yis/_/
english: Through the stages of diligence,

wylie: sprul sku longs sku chos sku la/_/
english: into the emanation embodiment, complete enjoyment embodiment, and dharma embodiment,

wylie: nges par dngos su 'pho bar nus/_/
english: one can definitely transfer in actuality.

wylie: dris lan so bdun pa/
english: [Source heading: Thirty-seventh reply.]

wylie: rten 'brel sbyor ba rnam pa gnyis/_/
english: The application of dependent connections has two aspects:

wylie: sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul bsgrub pa dang /_/
english: accomplishing manifold miracles

wylie: 'byung ba gnad kyi cho ga'o/_/
english: and the rites of the crucial points of the elements.

wylie: sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul thabs sna tshogs/_/
english: Manifold miracles have manifold methods.

wylie: lam sna zin pas rang shes sbyar/_/
english: Grasping the various paths, one applies one's own knowing. [N-078]

wylie: rgyu dang mi rgyu rlung gis bskor/_/
english: The moving and unmoving are encircled with wind.

wylie: bkang yang byung /
english: [Source variant: ‘Filled also occurs.’] [N-078]

wylie: _lus dang dbang po bsgrub pas dbye/_/
english: They are differentiated through accomplishing body and faculties.

wylie: 'byung ba'i gnad ni rang dang gzhan/_/

wylie: rang rang lus dang 'byung bar sbyar/_/

wylie: chu dang sa dang me dang rlung /_/

wylie: so so'i las kyi rten 'brel gyis/_/

wylie: gso zhing spel dang nyams par byed/_/

wylie: sa dang chu yis 'jig pa la/_/
english: Earth and water destroy;

wylie: sa dang mes ni spel ba'o/_/
english: earth and fire increase;

wylie: sa dang rlung gis gshed du 'bebs/_/
english: earth and wind bring down a slayer;

wylie: chu dang mes ni nyams par byed/_/
english: water and fire cause decline;

wylie: chu dang rlung gis gso ba'o/_/
english: water and wind restore;

wylie: me dang rlung gis snyoms pa nyid/_/

wylie: gang zhig brjod pa'i rten 'brel ni/_/

wylie: rnal 'byor so so'i nyams dang sbyar/_/

wylie: yid kyi rten 'brel rlung la dri/_/
english: For the mental faculty's dependent connections, inquire of wind. [N-078]

wylie: gsum 'dus pa yi byed pa nyid/_/
english: As for the activity of the three gathered together,

wylie: so so'i sdeb dang legs sbyar na/_/
english: when properly combined with each corresponding arrangement,

wylie: 'dis kyang phan dang gnod pa 'grub/_/
english: through this, too, benefit and harm are accomplished.

wylie: dris lan so brgyad pa'o/_/
english: [Source heading: Thirty-eighth reply.]

wylie: nad dang sdug bsngal grol 'dod pas/_/
english: One wishing to be liberated from illness and suffering

wylie: rang dang gzhan gnyis rnam par sbyar/_/
english: applies [the methods] distinctly to oneself and others.

wylie: gzhan la rten 'brel dag gis bya/_/
english: For others, act through dependent connections;

wylie: rang gi spo dang byabs bya'o/_/
english: for oneself, perform transferring and stroking. [N-079]

wylie: bya ba dag ni gsum yin te/_/
english: There are three actions:

wylie: lus kyi gnad dang ngag dang yang*/_/
english: through the crucial point of body, speech,

wylie: de bzhin sems kyi gnas kyis dgrol/_/
english: and likewise the abiding of ordinary mind, one is liberated.

wylie: lus ni 'khrul 'khor sna tshogs la/_/
english: For the body, in the various bodily mechanisms:

wylie: seng ge nyid dang glang po che/_/
english: the lion and elephant,

wylie: bya rgod dag dang lug gis sprug_/
english: vulture and sheep shake [the body];

wylie: wa mo dang ni skyes bu nyid/_/
english: the vixen and the person,

wylie: 'bu srin la sogs lus dang ni/_/
english: worms and so forth—with bodily [forms]

wylie: 'khrul 'khor rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/_/
english: and manifold bodily mechanisms,

wylie: phyi nang stod smad yan lag lus/_/
english: outer and inner, upper and lower, limbs and body,

wylie: rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa ni/_/
english: wind, bile, phlegm, and their conjunction,

wylie: 'byung ba nad sdeb bzhi yis sbyar/_/
english: are combined with the four groups of elemental illnesses. [N-079]

wylie: tsha dang grang bas mtha' phyes te/_/
english: Distinguishing their extremes as hot and cold,

wylie: de dang de sbyar nad las grol/_/
english: one joins each with its counterpart and is liberated from illness.

wylie: ngag ni sgra skad sna tshogs pa/_/
english: For speech, there are manifold sounds and voices:

wylie: A li kA li rab gsal bas/_/
english: with āli and kāli exceedingly clear,

wylie: rang bzhin rtsa la gnas pa yi/_/
english: for the letters abiding by intrinsic nature in the channels,

wylie: yi ge bzlog brjod kyang tshul drug gis kyang*/_/
english: through the six ways of reversing [them], [Source variant: ‘Pronouncing also.’] [N-079]

wylie: so so'i gnas dang sbyar ba dang /_/
english: one joins [them] to their respective places.

wylie: lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*/_/
english: The voices of gods, nāgas, and yakṣas,

wylie: srin po nam mkha' lding gi skad/_/
english: rākṣasas and sky-soarers;

wylie: tshangs dang brgya byin khyab 'jug dang*/_/
english: Brahmā, the Hundred-Giver, and the All-Pervader;

wylie: 'dre dang rlung lha dag gi dag pa'i skad kyang byung skad/_/
english: spirits and wind gods; [Source variant: ‘Pure voice also occurs.’] [N-079]

wylie: grul bum lto 'phye dri za dang*/_/
english: kumbhāṇḍas, belly-crawlers, and gandharvas,

wylie: lhag cing dngos po'i skad kyis kyang*/_/
english: and the voices of further entities—[N-079]

wylie: so so'i skad dang sbyar bas grol/_/
english: by joining the respective voices, one is liberated.

wylie: sems ni dran pa sna tshogs dang*/_/
english: For ordinary mind, manifold forms of mindfulness,

wylie: ci ltar 'gyus pa'i mtha' yi yang /_/

wylie: rnal 'byor pa yi rig pas dbye/_/

wylie: gzhan yang lus ngag yid kyis bsgyur/_/
english: Furthermore, transform through body, speech, and mental faculty.

wylie: yang na sems kyi bya ba'i las/_/
english: Or, through the activity of ordinary mind's doing,

wylie: sna tshogs ting nge 'dzin gyis bsgyur/_/
english: transform through manifold deep absorptions,

wylie: sdug bsngal las kyang mtha' dbye'o/_/
english: and distinguish the extent of suffering as well. [N-079]

wylie: dris lan so dgu pa/
english: [Source heading: Thirty-ninth reply.]

wylie: 'byung ba'i 'pho ba 'di lta bu/_/
english: The shifting of the elements is like this:

wylie: e ma ngo mtshar che bar bshad/_/
english: Ema! It is explained as greatly wondrous.

wylie: phyi rol nang gi dbye ba las/_/
english: Through the distinction of outer and inner,

wylie: sa dang sa ste lhag ma yang*/_/
english: earth [joins] earth; the remaining [elements], too,

wylie: gong ma'i 'gres kyis shes par bya'o/_/
english: are to be understood by extension from the preceding [account].

wylie: nyin mtshan nang nub zhag dang ni/_/
english: Day and night, morning and evening, days,

wylie: zla ba lo yi 'khrul 'khrugs lugs kyang lugs kyis/_/
english: months and years, through the manner of error—[Source variant: ‘Manner of confusion also.’] [N-080]

wylie: bcu gnyis phrag dang sbom pa yang*/_/
english: sets of twelve, and the coarse [divisions], too;

wylie: zug dang byer dang snyoms pa las/_/
english: penetration, dispersal, and equalizing,

wylie: nges med 'khrugs mar gnas pa bzhi/_/

wylie: dus la nges phye bcu drug gi/_/

wylie: so so'i dus nges 'pho ba'i mtshams/_/
english: Their respective definite times, the intervals of shifting,

wylie: rten 'brel la sogs 'byung ba'i gnas/_/
english: and the places of the elements in dependent connections and so forth:

wylie: 'pho ba'i dus la 'pho ba ste/_/
english: at the time of shifting, there is shifting;

wylie: de bzhin 'jug dus 'jug pa la/_/
english: likewise, at the time of entering, entering;

wylie: gnas pa'i dus na gnas pa'o/_/
english: at the time of abiding, abiding;

wylie: 'khrugs ma nyid la 'khrugs mar ro/_/
english: and in confusion itself, confusion.

wylie: nyin mtshan zhag dang zla ba'o/_/
english: These concern day and night, days and months.

wylie: 'pho ba'i gnas ni mkhas pas dpyad/_/
english: The places of shifting are examined by the skilled person.

wylie: chu dang sa ste me rlung gis/_/
english: Through water, earth, fire, and wind,

wylie: mthun pa dang ni mi mthun pa/_/
english: concordance and discordance,

wylie: so so'i las dus sdeb ka yis/_/
english: and the respective combinations of activities and times,

wylie: las kyi mtha' rnams bsgyur bar bya'o/
english: the culminations of activities are to be transformed. [N-080]

wylie: dris lan bzhi bcu pa/
english: [Source heading: Fortieth reply.]

wylie: gnad kyi 'byung ba rnam phye na/_/
english: Distinguishing the elements of the crucial points:

wylie: bzhi brgya nyid dang rtsa bzhi las/_/

wylie: nges bcas 'jug pa brgyad cur sdud/_/
english: the specified entries are condensed into eighty;

wylie: de las nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/_/
english: from these, twenty-four;

wylie: mchog tu gnas pa bcu drug nyid/_/
english: the supreme abidings themselves are sixteen;

wylie: pho mo'i sdebs kyis brgyad du 'gyur/
english: through male–female pairing, they become eight.

wylie: rang ngo dag pa bzhi yis ni/_/
english: Through four pure in their own identity,

wylie: gnad rnams bsdus te nges par bstan/_/

wylie: byer zug snyoms pa'i byed las kyi/_/
english: When the activities of dispersal, penetration, and equalizing

wylie: tshes dang zla ba lo rnams dang /_/

wylie: 'khrul pa med par sbyar byas na/_/
english: without error,

wylie: gnad rnams dag kyang nges par 'gyur/_/
english: the crucial points, too, become definite.

wylie: dris lan zhe gcig pa/
english: [Source heading: Forty-first reply.]

wylie: _de ltar gnad la brten nas ni/_/
english: Thus, relying on the crucial points,

wylie: rtsis kyi sbyor ba'i yan lag bshad/_/
english: the branches of the application of calculation are explained.

wylie: e ma ngo mtshar che ba nyid/_/
english: Ema! How greatly wondrous!

wylie: sangs rgyas gzhan gyis ma gsungs pa'i/_/
english: Not spoken by other buddhas,

wylie: 'byung ba'i rtsis kyi rim pa la/_/

wylie: brten nas 'khor 'das 'jal byed pa'i/_/
english: relying on which one measures samsara and nirvana—

wylie: rab tu gsang ba 'di nyon cig_/
english: listen to this utmost secret! [N-082]

wylie: chu dang sa ste me rlung las/_/

wylie: rnam par dbye ba'i rim pa nyid/_/

wylie: lnga pa gcig ni ma ning stong*/_/

wylie: shes shing brtsi ba'i rim pa yin/_/
english: This is the sequence of knowing and calculating.

wylie: min kyang /
english: [Source variant: ‘Is not, also.’] [N-082]

wylie: _zug dang byer dang snyoms pa'i las/_/
english: From the twelve activities

wylie: bcu gnyis dag las ma yi lo rnams kyang /_/

wylie: bcu gnyis dag ste gsum gsum gyis/_/

wylie: byer zug snyoms pa'i dus kyis kyang /_/

wylie: nyon mongs 'byung ba ci yi rgyu/_/
english: What causes afflictions to arise?

wylie: 'di dag bdag gis ma shes pas/_/
english: Because I do not know these,

wylie: ston pa thugs rje chen po la/_/
english: Teacher of great compassionate responsiveness,

wylie: tshig brjod rtog dpyod mi mnga' yang*/_/
english: although you have neither verbal expression nor conceptual examination,

wylie: rang bzhin bcos med nam mkha' nas/_/
english: from the space of uncontrived intrinsic nature,

wylie: brjod med gsung gis bdag la gsungs/_/
english: speak to me through inexpressible speech.’ [N-117]

wylie: dang po la nang gses bcu bdun/
english: [Source annotation: The first [reply] has seventeen subdivisions.]

wylie: de nas ston pa rdo rje 'chang /_/
english: Then the teacher, the vajra-holder,

wylie: rang bzhin spros med rdzogs chen las/_/
english: from the Great Perfection of intrinsic nature free from conceptual elaborations,

wylie: sgra tshig ming du mi gnas kyang /_/
english: though not abiding as words, phrases, or names,

wylie: lha dbang nyid la 'di skad gsungs/_/
english: spoke to the lord of the gods in these words.

wylie: rtog pa zad pa'i nam mkha' las/_/
english: From the space in which conceptual thought is exhausted,

wylie: sgra tshig ming du ma bsgrags kyang*/_/
english: though not proclaimed as words, phrases, or names,

wylie: rang byung ye shes chen po nyid/_/
english: great naturally arisen primordial knowing itself,

wylie: gdod nas byas med rang bzhin las/_/
english: from intrinsic nature, unmade from the outset,

wylie: ma bkod tshig tu 'di ltar shar/_/
english: arose thus as unarranged phrases: [N-118]

wylie: 'khor ba rnams kyi thog ma ni/_/
english: ‘The beginning of samsara:

wylie: mi 'byed byas med rang gzhan las/_/
english: from the undifferentiated, unmade, self and other,

wylie: dmigs par 'dzin pa'i yul shar te/_/
english: an object held as a focus arose.

wylie: rtog 'dzin las ni tha dad snang*/_/
english: From conceptualizing and holding, distinct appearances [arose].

wylie: dmigs 'dzin 'brel pa bcu gnyis su/_/
english: In the twelve connections of focusing and holding,

wylie: 'khor ba'i thog ma nyid du'o/_/
english: there is the very beginning of samsara. [N-118]

wylie: ma rig gsum gyi 'khrul tshul te/_/
english: This is the manner of delusion through three ignorances.

wylie: rgyu gcig 'byed med rtsa ba ste/_/
english: The single cause, undifferentiated, is the root:

wylie: rang ngo yin par ma shes pa/_/
english: not knowing [this] to be one's own identity.

wylie: 'di yang 'khor ba'i thog ma'o/_/
english: This, too, is the beginning of samsara.

wylie: de las gcig gsum brgya phrag bzhi/_/
english: From this: one, three, and four hundred—[Numerical grouping unresolved.] [N-118]

wylie: 'khor rkyen brgyad kyis nges bzung ste/_/

wylie: gzhi gnas 'khrul pa'i rtsis sbyor ro/_/

wylie: de las lhan cig skyes pa ste/_/
english: From this, there is the co-emergent [ignorance]. [N-T58]

wylie: don dam kun rdzob snang brtags pa'i/_/
english: From the ultimate and the relative, apparent and imputed—

wylie: bden gnyis cha yi yul nas ni/_/
english: the objects belonging to the two truths—

wylie: las kun spyod pa nyi shur 'gyur/_/
english: engagement in all activities becomes twenty. [N-118]

wylie: de yul snang cha'i bye brag las/_/
english: From the particulars of the apparent aspects of those objects,

wylie: kun brtags nges pa'i rkyen bzhi'i cha/_/

wylie: rgyu dang bdag pos nges bzung ste/_/
english: definitely grasped through cause and dominance,

wylie: dmigs pa nyid dang dus mtshungs pas/_/
english: the object of focus itself, and simultaneity. [N-118]

wylie: 'khrul pa'i cha yang brgyad gnyis te/_/
english: The portions of delusion, too, are eight and two.

wylie: dmigs pa'i dus ni mtshungs pas na/_/
english: Because the times of the objects of focus coincide,

wylie: 'du byed btags pa'i 'khrul pa ni/_/
english: as for the delusion imputed as formations:

wylie: 'du ba brgya la brgyad kyang byed pa gcig_/
english: for a hundred gatherings, one agent. [Source variant: ‘Eight also.’] [N-119]

wylie: las kun rdzogs pas mtha' yas 'byung*/_/
english: Through the completion of all activities, limitless [forms] arise.

wylie: de yi dus dang dbang po brtsi'o/_/
english: Calculate their times and faculties.

wylie: rnam shes 'khrul pa lugs bzhin las/_/
english: According to the manner of the delusion of consciousness,

wylie: snang ba yul ni brgyad dang drug_/

wylie: shes pas dpyod byed nyi shur 'gyur/_/

wylie: de yis lus dang yan lag brtsi'o/_/

wylie: de yang ming gzugs 'khrul pa'i cha/_/
english: Furthermore, for the portion of delusion of name-and-form:

wylie: ming las gdags bzhi drug cu gnyis/_/

wylie: 'khor 'das bzhi dang yi ger bcas/_/
english: samsara and nirvana, four, together with letters.

wylie: _gzugs ni phra rags rtags phye nas/_/
english: For form, distinguish fine and coarse characteristics;

wylie: grub cing 'dzin pa brgya dang lnga/_/

wylie: las kun 'gyur byed bzhi sa brtsi'o/_/

wylie: skye mched 'khor lo drug gi yang /_/
english: For the six wheels of the sense bases, too,

wylie: yul dang shes pa dbang po'i gnad/_/
english: the crucial points of objects, knowing, and faculties:

wylie: so so'i 'jug cha brgyad gnyis drug_/

wylie: las yul brtsi ba de tsam mo/_/
english: That is the extent of calculating the objects of activities. [N-120]

wylie: reg cha sems kyi 'khrul pa'i lugs/_/
english: For the portion of contact, the manner of ordinary mind's delusion:

wylie: rgyu byed snang ba nyams bcas drug_/

wylie: las dang byed pa reg shes lnga/_/

wylie: mtha' yi rtog pa bdun 'gyur brtsi/_/
english: Calculate seven transformations of the final conceptual thought. [N-120]

wylie: tshor ba'i tshul ni bdun gnyis te/_/
english: The manners of feeling are seven and two.

wylie: yid ldan snang cha'i rtog pa las/_/
english: From conceptual thought concerning the apparent aspect endowed with mental faculty,

wylie: yid sems 'gyur ba brgyad cur 'gyur/_/
english: transformations of mental faculty and ordinary mind become eighty.

wylie: de las rtog bcas bdun cur brtsi'o/_/
english: From this, calculate seventy accompanied by conceptual thought.

wylie: sred pa'i 'khrul pa gsum lnga las/_/
english: From the three and five delusions of craving,

wylie: byas tshogs kyang tshe grangs ni drug cu ste/_/
english: when enacted, the number is sixty. [Source variant: ‘Accumulation also.’] [N-120]

wylie: yan lag mtha' yi bzlog tshul grangs/_/
english: The number of ways of reversing at the limits of the branches

wylie: brgya gnyis las kyi mthar bzlog bya'o/_/
english: is two hundred; reverse at the culmination of activities.

wylie: len pa'i 'khrul gzhi bcu gsum drug_/
english: The Grounds of delusion of grasping: thirteen, six. [Numerical grouping unresolved.] [N-120]

wylie: las mtha'i gzugs la reg nus brgya/_/
english: A hundred can contact forms at the culmination of activities.

wylie: 'khrul bzung yul la snang char 'gyur/_/
english: For an object held in delusion, [these] become aspects of appearance.

wylie: de yi byed par 'gyur brtsi'o/_/
english: Calculate their transformation into agents. [N-120]

wylie: srid pa'i 'khrul pa bcu gnyis la/_/
english: For the twelve delusions of becoming,

wylie: mi 'byed cha la bcu drug go/_/
english: the undifferentiated portion has sixteen.

wylie: de yis rtog bcas yul sems bcings/_/
english: Through this, objects and ordinary mind, with conceptual thought, are bound.

wylie: las bzhi so sor rnam dpyad bya'o/_/
english: Examine the four activities individually. [N-120]

wylie: skye ba'i cha las gsum gnyis lnga/_/
english: From the portion of birth: three, two, and five.

wylie: 'jug dang 'ong ba rlung gis byed/_/
english: Entering and coming are performed by wind.

wylie: langs dang gnas pa'i dus la brgyad/_/
english: For the times of rising and abiding, there are eight.

wylie: 'khor tshul 'bras bu bcu gnyis so/_/
english: The results of the manner of circling are twelve.

wylie: rga dang shi las 'khrul rkyen dgu/_/
english: From aging and death, there are nine conditions of delusion.

wylie: 'bad 'gags rtog pa la bco brgyad/_/
english: For the conceptual thought of effort and cessation, there are eighteen.

wylie: gnas su 'jug pa brgyad dang cha/_/
english: Entry into an abode: eight, and a portion;

wylie: bag la nyal dang kun 'khor ro/_/
english: [there are] dormant tendencies and circling everywhere. [N-121]

wylie: de ltar 'khrul rtsa bcu gnyis las/_/
english: Thus, from the twelve roots of delusion,

wylie: lus dang dbang po lo rnams dang /_/
english: bodies, faculties, years,

wylie: so so'i 'byung ba dus kyis dbye/_/
english: and the respective elements are distinguished by time.

wylie: rang dang gzhan te bzhir 'gyur ro/_/
english: Self and other become four.

wylie: 'di dag 'khor ba'i thog mar byung /_/
english: These arose at the beginning of samsara.

wylie: sems can khams ni du mar bcas/_/
english: For sentient beings' realms, with their many [aspects],

wylie: 'jug phyir las kun mthar spyad pa/_/
english: in order to enter, engagement in all activities to their culmination,

wylie: ldan pas rdzogs te nyer bstan pa'o/_/
english: endowed [with these], is complete and closely taught. [N-121]

wylie: dris lan gnyis pa/
english: [Source heading: Second reply.]

wylie: lha dbang ngo mtshar chen po nyon/_/
english: Lord of the gods, listen to this great wonder.

wylie: mya ngan 'das pa'i tha ma ni/_/
english: The final extent of passing beyond sorrow:

wylie: 'khrul pa'i rtog pa kun zad pas/_/
english: when all conceptual thought of delusion is exhausted,

wylie: 'khor ba'i byed snang med tshe na/_/
english: and the appearance of the agency of samsara is absent,

wylie: rtog zad 'khrul pa rang snang bas/_/
english: delusion is self-appearance with conceptual thought exhausted.

wylie: 'das pa gzhag phyir sems can khams/_/
english: To posit transcendence, the realm of sentient beings,

wylie: rang bzhin du yang 'di nyid yul/_/
english: in its intrinsic nature, too, has this very object:

wylie: gzhan dbang ma yin yongs su grub/_/
english: not dependent on another, completely established;

wylie: mtha' ldan phye ba ma yin no/_/
english: not distinguished as possessing an extreme. [N-122]

wylie: gnyis gnyis 'jug dang kun tu khyab/_/
english: Entering in pairs and pervading everywhere—

wylie: las dang dbang po blo rnams yul/_/

wylie: 'jug pa'i las ni thad ka'o/_/
english: the activity of entering is immediate. [N-122]

wylie: dris lan gsum pa/
english: [Source heading: Third reply.]

wylie: de ltar 'khor 'das thog mtha' las/_/
english: Thus, concerning the beginning and end of samsara and nirvana,

wylie: sangs rgyas 'khrul par ma gyur pas/_/
english: because the buddhas have not become deluded,

wylie: gzhi las 'phags pa'i dbang po yis/_/
english: through a noble faculty from the Ground,

wylie: rang snang rang bzhin med par shes/_/
english: they know self-appearance to be without intrinsic nature.

wylie: rtog dpyod yid rnams phyir ma shor/_/
english: Conceptual examination and mental faculty have not strayed outward;

wylie: 'gyu ba rang thag chod pa'o/_/
english: movement is cut off of itself. [N-123]

wylie: de yang gnas lugs chen po las/_/
english: Furthermore, in the great natural state,

wylie: 'khrul zhes ka nas dag pa la/_/
english: what is called delusion is pure from the outset;

wylie: ma 'khrul nyid du bcos su med/_/
english: it cannot be contrived into nondelusion.

wylie: med snang mthong ba med pa'i chos/_/
english: Phenomena that appear without existing, yet are not seen—

wylie: byas byung rtog pa rang 'gags so/_/
english: the conceptual thought that arises through doing ceases of itself.

wylie: 'khrul nas dmigs par snang ba min/_/
english: There is no appearance as an object of focus through delusion.

wylie: rang bzhin ye gdangs ma g.yos pas/_/
english: Because the primordial radiance of intrinsic nature has not stirred,

wylie: chos kun mnyam par ro gcig go/_/
english: all phenomena are equally of one taste.

wylie: 'dzin rtog bral nas ye sangs rgyas/_/
english: Free from holding and conceptualizing, there is primordial buddhahood.

wylie: bcos shing bsgyur du btub pa min/_/
english: It cannot be contrived or transformed.

wylie: de yi gnad ni yul yin te/_/
english: Its crucial point is the object:

wylie: yul dang stong pa rig rtsal mnyam/_/
english: the object, the empty, and awareness's expressiveness are equal.

wylie: tha dad rtog pas shes pa min/_/
english: This is not known through differentiating conceptual thought. [N-123]

wylie: yang ni 'khrul pa min pa'i gnad/_/
english: Furthermore, the crucial point of not being deluded:

wylie: gcig shes pa yis thams cad grol/_/
english: through knowing one, all are liberated.

wylie: de nyid shes pas bzlog pa nyid/_/
english: Through knowing that itself, there is reversal.

wylie: mi snang 'dzad pa med pa las/_/
english: With no appearance and no exhaustion,

wylie: 'byung rig gnas kyi rtog pa zad/_/
english: conceptual thought of arising, awareness, and abiding is exhausted. [N-123]

wylie: byas pas ma phye bcos su med/_/
english: Not differentiated through doing, it cannot be contrived.

wylie: bya dang byed pa'i blo med pas/_/
english: Because there is no conceptual mind of action and agent,

wylie: yul rkyen sangs pas sangs rgyas so/_/
english: with objects and conditions cleared away, there is buddhahood.

wylie: mtha' grol 'gag pa med pa las/_/
english: Free from extremes and without cessation,

wylie: yongs su rdzogs pa'i ting 'dzin gnas/_/
english: one abides in fully complete deep absorption.

wylie: chen po yin pas gong na med/_/
english: Because it is great, there is nothing above it,

wylie: rang bzhin g.yos pa med phyir ro/_/
english: for intrinsic nature has not stirred. [N-123]

wylie: dris lan bzhi pa/
english: [Source heading: Fourth reply.]

wylie: sems can 'khrul pa gong ma yi/_/

wylie: rtsa ba'i rten 'brel la 'khyal pas/_/

wylie: 'khrul 'khor rtsis kyi gzhi mar byung*/_/

wylie: bsgribs shing rang snang ma dag gyur/_/

wylie: de las bag la nyal ba nyid/_/

wylie: phra zhing rdul gyi cha dag ni/_/

wylie: 'gyu zhing 'dzin pa tsam du gyur/_/

wylie: phra bas phra 'gyur shes pa las/_/

wylie: rtog dpyod gzung cha gnyis su song /_/

wylie: phra rdul ye shes snang ba 'gags/_/

wylie: yul shes thad ka tsam du shar/_/

wylie: ma rig la sogs bcu gnyis chos/_/

wylie: 'gro ba'i 'byung rigs bcu gnyis 'gyur/_/
