english: and primordial knowing.

wylie: rnam dag dbyings kyi brten pa ni/_/
english: Perfectly pure basic space relies on

wylie: smin mtshams nyid dang nam mkha' dang /_/
english: the space between the eyebrows, space,

wylie: 'od dang thig le dag dang yang*/_/
english: light and spheres,

wylie: sna tshogs sku la brten pa'o/_/
english: and manifold embodiments. [N-135]

wylie: de yang rten yul khyad par ni/_/
english: Furthermore, the distinctive supports and objects:

wylie: gsum gyis byed 'dus khyad par brten/_/
english: through three, they rely on the distinction of gathered agency. [N-135]

wylie: rgyang zhags nyid las rten pas ni/_/
english: By relying on the far-reaching lasso itself,

wylie: skyon med bya byed rnams spangs pas/_/
english: free from faults, having abandoned action and agency,

wylie: chos nyid ma la spyod pa'o/_/
english: one engages in the mother nature of phenomena.

wylie: las dang bag chags dag byed pas/_/
english: Through purifying karma and habitual tendencies,

wylie: chos nyid mngon sum snang ba la/_/
english: relying on the vision of the direct perception of the nature of phenomena,

wylie: brten pas 'khor ba dong sprugs te/_/
english: one empties samsara from its depths,

wylie: myang 'das mtshams su reg nus pa'o/_/
english: and can touch the boundary of passing beyond sorrow.

wylie: rtog dpyod zad pa'i sems nyid kyis/_/
english: Through the nature of ordinary mind in which conceptual thought and examination are exhausted,

wylie: 'khor ba rgyang du 'phangs pa yis/_/
english: samsara is cast far away.

wylie: ye shes dag pa'i sku mthong nas/_/
english: Having seen the embodiment of pure primordial knowing,

wylie: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'dun sa 'jig_/
english: the point of aim of samsara and nirvana, the two, is destroyed. [N-135]

wylie: gang gis me tog mdzes mthong ba/_/
english: Whoever sees a beautiful flower—

wylie: 'dis ni chos nyid yur bar 'drongs/_/
english: through this, the nature of phenomena is led into an irrigation channel.

wylie: rig pa srang la btab nas ni/_/
english: Having placed awareness on the balance (srang),

wylie: chos rnams zad pa'i sar bskyal lo/_/
english: one is brought to where phenomena are exhausted. [N-135]

wylie: dbyings la goms par gyur pa'i mis/_/
english: A person who becomes familiar with basic space,

wylie: 'khrul snang stongs par byas nas ni/_/
english: having emptied delusive appearances,

wylie: chos nyid dag pa'i yul mthong bas/_/
english: through seeing the object of the pure nature of phenomena,

wylie: zhen yul khungs nas thon pa'o/_/
english: emerges from the very source of objects of attachment. [N-135]

wylie: dris lan bcu gnyis pa/
english: [Source heading: Twelfth reply.]

wylie: blo rim gnad ni 'di lta ste/_/
english: The crucial point of the stages of conceptual mind is like this:

wylie: 'byung ba snod kyi khyad par las/_/
english: through distinctions in the vessel of the elements,

wylie: 'byung ba'i smin so'i khyad par gyis/_/
english: through distinctions in the elements' junctures of maturation,

wylie: 'gro ba'i blo yi bye brag gis/_/
english: and through differences in beings' conceptual minds,

wylie: rigs dang dbang po tha dad do/_/
english: families and faculties differ.

wylie: de yang 'byung ba'i rnam 'phrul gyis/_/
english: Furthermore, through the magical displays of the elements:

wylie: chu yis sa ni las dag pas/_/
english: water's earth, its activity purified,

wylie: thog ma mched par nus pa la/_/
english: at first can spread;

wylie: tha ma zin pa'i chos mi brjed/_/
english: finally it does not forget the teaching it has grasped.

wylie: chu yi mes ni zin skyen brjed/_/
english: Water's fire grasps readily and forgets.

wylie: _chu yi rlung gis blo bsgyur cing*/_/
english: Water's wind transforms conceptual mind,

wylie: kun la 'jug cing sa zin med/_/
english: entering everything, without holding a ground. [N-136]

wylie: chu'i rlung lan gnyis byung ba dpyad/
english: [Source query: Water's wind occurs twice; examine this.] [N-136]

wylie: chu yi rlung gis yangs pa dang*/_/
english: Water's wind [brings] spaciousness,

wylie: yul dang shes pa 'phrad par 'gyur/_/
english: and brings object and knowing into contact.

wylie: chu yi chus ni babs che zhing /_/
english: Water's water has a strong inclination,

wylie: 'du shes chung zhing zin pa'o/_/
english: with little perception, and grasps. [N-136]

wylie: sa yi 'byung ba dag pa las/_/
english: From the pure elements of earth:

wylie: sa yi chu yis tshig 'phel dang*/_/
english: earth's water increases words

wylie: rtog pa sna tshogs spel bar byed/_/
english: and multiplies manifold conceptual thoughts.

wylie: sa yi mes ni mchog tu dbang po dag_/
english: Earth's fire [makes] the faculties supremely pure,

wylie: gsal zhing 'jam des ldan par ston/_/
english: revealing them as clear and endowed with gentleness.

wylie: sa yi rlung gis rmugs pa dang /_/
english: Earth's wind [brings] stupefaction

wylie: bar chad can de res 'jog 'gyur/_/
english: and interruptions, alternating at intervals.

wylie: sa yis sa ni tshigs dang yan lag rgyas par 'dzin/_/
english: Earth's earth extensively holds joints and limbs. [N-136]

wylie: me yis sa ni dbang po rgyas/_/
english: Fire's earth expands the faculties.

wylie: chu yis 'jug cing khyab par ston/_/
english: [Fire's] water reveals entering and pervading.

wylie: rlung gis dbang po rab tu rno/_/
english: [Fire's] wind makes the faculties exceedingly sharp.

wylie: me yi mes ni zin skyen brjed/_/
english: Fire's fire grasps readily and forgets.

wylie: rlung gis sa ni don spyod che/_/
english: Wind's earth has great engagement with meaning.

wylie: chu yis ting 'dzin dmigs pa gsal/_/
english: [Wind's] water makes the object of deep absorption clear.

wylie: me yis tshig la longs spyod nus/_/
english: [Wind's] fire enables enjoyment of words.

wylie: rlung gi rlung gis rtog dpyod 'dzin/_/
english: Wind's wind holds conceptual thought and examination. [N-136]

wylie: 'di yi 'byung ba ma dag pas/_/
english: When these elements are impure,

wylie: log pa'i las kun byed par ston/_/
english: they reveal engagement in all mistaken activities.

wylie: snang ba g.yengs dang shes pa 'gyur/_/
english: Appearances distract, and knowing changes.

wylie: rtog pa rags shing mi dge slong/_/
english: Conceptual thought is coarse and arouses nonvirtue.

wylie: chos kyi sems kyang spang ba'o/_/
english: Even the ordinary mind [oriented] toward the teaching is abandoned. [N-137]

wylie: de ltar 'byung ba snod dag pas/_/
english: Thus, through the vessel of the elements being pure,

wylie: thar pa'i lam sna ston pa dang /_/
english: the many paths of liberation are revealed,

wylie: sku gsum yang dag gtan la 'bebs/_/
english: and the three embodiments are authentically established.

wylie: de nas ma yi mngal zhugs pas/_/
english: Then, having entered the mother's womb,

wylie: lo dang zla ba zhag gi rtsis/_/
english: through the calculation of years, months, and days,

wylie: so so'i 'byung ba'i rang dus kyis/_/
english: and the respective elements' own times,

wylie: dus tshod nges par bzung byas la/_/
english: having definitely grasped the measures of time,

wylie: rang rang 'byung ba gso ba yi/_/
english: through restoring each respective element,

wylie: rten 'brel sngags pas 'bad de brten/_/
english: the mantra practitioner should diligently rely on dependent connections.

wylie: 'byung ba bskyed pa'i cho ga yis/_/
english: Through the rite of generating the elements,

wylie: dbang po rno la ye shes gsal/_/
english: faculties are sharp, and primordial knowing is clear.

wylie: gzugs dang kha dog rdzogs pa dang*/_/
english: Form and color are complete.

wylie: 'gro ba byams zhing longs spyod ldan/_/
english: One is loving toward beings and endowed with enjoyments,

wylie: sdig spang dge ba spyod par smin/_/
english: maturing into one who abandons misdeeds and acts virtuously. [N-137]

wylie: des ni 'byung bas bcud bskyabs te/_/
english: Thus, the elements protect the vital essence.

wylie: snod kyi kha dog bye brag gis/_/
english: Through differences in the vessel's color,

wylie: man shel mdog kyang 'gyur ba bzhin/_/
english: just as the color of glass (man-shel), too, changes,

wylie: dri ma med pa'i sems nyid kyang*/_/
english: the stainless nature of ordinary mind, too,

wylie: 'byung ba'i snod kyis de bzhin no/_/
english: is like that through the vessel of the elements. [N-137]

wylie: dris lan bcu gsum pa/
english: [Source heading: Thirteenth reply.]

wylie: nyams su len pa'i gnad 'di'o/_/
english: This is the crucial point of taking [the teaching] up in experience:

wylie: dmigs rten nyid dang bsam gnas so/_/
english: the support of focus and the abiding of reflection.

wylie: dmigs gzugs sgra dri ro dang reg_/
english: The objects of focus are form, sound, smell, taste, and touch.

wylie: 'dod pa lnga yi gnas sbyangs te/_/
english: Train in the domains of the five desires.

wylie: gzugs ni kha dog dbyibs rnams dang /_/
english: For form: colors and shapes,

wylie: bzo dang sgyu rtsal tha dad dang*/_/
english: different crafts and illusory expressiveness,

wylie: mig 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs pa'o/_/
english: and manifold optical illusions. [N-138]

wylie: sgra ni pi wang bum ldir dang /_/
english: For sound: lute and booming pot,

wylie: rgyud mangs rdza rnga gling bu dang /_/
english: many-stringed instrument, earthenware drum, and flute,

wylie: pheg dang har la sogs pa'o/_/
english: and sounds such as ‘phek’ and ‘har.’ [N-138]

wylie: dri ni ngad ldan sbyar ba dang*/_/
english: For smell: combine fragrant substances,

wylie: yid mthun rten 'brel zab mos bya/_/
english: and act through profound, agreeable dependent connections.

wylie: ro ni bu ram drug ldan dang*/_/
english: For taste: jaggery endowed with six [unspecified aspects],

wylie: rgun chang sbyar ba sna tshogs bsgyur/_/
english: and various mixtures of grape wine are transformed.

wylie: rten 'brel yan lag sbyor ba'o/_/
english: Join the branches of dependent connections. [N-138]

wylie: reg ni mkhas pas khri steng 'dug_/
english: For touch, the skilled person sits on a seat.

wylie: gzhu bsnol 'byung ba'i sbyor ba dang /_/
english: Through crossed bows, a combination of elements,

wylie: shing gi lo ma 'ga' zhig gis/_/
english: and certain leaves of trees,

wylie: reg pa tsam gyis chos nyid la/_/
english: through mere touch, in the nature of phenomena,

wylie: 'bral med sems kyi gnas pa'o/_/
english: ordinary mind abides without separation. [N-138]

wylie: sems ni bzung dang gnas pa dang /_/
english: For ordinary mind: holding and abiding,

wylie: rtsa ba bcad dang dngos pos ded/_/
english: cutting the root and pursuing through entities,

wylie: yul dang shes pa'i bar nas btsal/_/
english: searching between object and knowing,

wylie: yengs la bor ba rnams yin no/_/
english: and casting into distraction. [N-138]

wylie: dris lan bcu bzhi pa/
english: [Source heading: Fourteenth reply.]

wylie: de ltar nyams su blangs pa las/_/
english: From taking [this] up in experience in this way,

wylie: rtags dang tshad ni 'di lta ste/_/
english: the signs and measures are as follows.

wylie: lus ni yang zhing zang thal snang /_/
english: The body appears light, with unimpeded penetration.

wylie: sa la reg med thogs med dang*/_/
english: It does not touch the earth and is unobstructed.

wylie: ngag gi nus rdzogs gtam zungs zad/_/
english: Speech's capacity is complete; its store of words is exhausted.

wylie: sems ni 'pho bar nus pa'o/_/
english: Ordinary mind is capable of transference.

wylie: mig dang rna ba sna dang lce/_/
english: Eye, ear, nose, tongue,

wylie: lus kyi dbang po kun zad ste/_/
english: and all bodily faculties are exhausted.

wylie: rang bzhin med pas nus pa zad/_/
english: Because there is no intrinsic nature, their capacities are exhausted. [N-139]

wylie: dris lan bco lnga pa/
english: [Source heading: Fifteenth reply.]

wylie: bar ma do yi snang ba ni/_/
english: The appearances of the intermediate state:

wylie: rang bzhin gnas pa'i phung po dang*/_/
english: the aggregates of abiding in intrinsic nature,

wylie: khams dang nyon mongs yul du snang /_/
english: the elements, and afflictions appear as objects. [N-140]

wylie: 'chi kha'i ban bun lang ling dang /_/
english: At death there are mistiness and wavering,

wylie: shes pa gcig tu mi gnas pa'o/_/
english: and knowing does not remain in one [place].

wylie: chos nyid bar do'i sku dang yang*/_/
english: In the intermediate state of the nature of phenomena: embodiments,

wylie: ye shes 'od dang kha dog go/
english: primordial knowing, light, and colors.

wylie: thig le mched dang 'byung snang dag_/
english: Spheres spread, and elemental appearances are pure.

wylie: cir snang chos nyid gzhal yas so/_/
english: Whatever appears is the immeasurable palace of the nature of phenomena. [N-140]

wylie: srid pa'i snang ba phyad phyod dang /_/
english: The appearances of becoming are fitful,

wylie: yad yud rmi lam snang ba ltar/_/
english: fleeting, like dream appearances.

wylie: bden snang rdzun pa yid kyi lus/_/
english: Appearing true, though false, is the body of mental faculty.

wylie: dkar gleg la sogs rigs drug 'od/_/
english: White, gleg [unresolved], and so forth—the lights of the six classes—

wylie: so so'i dmigs pa'i snang ba'o/_/
english: are appearances of their respective objects of focus. [N-140]

wylie: dris lan bcu drug pa/
english: [Source heading: Sixteenth reply.]

wylie: rang sems grol ba zhes bya ba/_/
english: What is called the liberation of one's own ordinary mind

wylie: gcig nas gcig tu song ba med/_/
english: is not a going from one [place] to another.

wylie: gang gis bkrol ba med pa'i sems/_/
english: Ordinary mind is not released by anyone.

wylie: gzhi la rdzogs pas 'gro 'ong med/_/
english: Complete in the Ground, there is no going or coming.

wylie: brtags pas ma rnyed rgyu mtshan med/_/
english: It is not found by examination; there is no reason.

wylie: gzhi rtsa med pas stong par gnas/_/
english: Without Ground or root, it abides empty.

wylie: rang gsal gnas pa'i sems de ni/_/
english: That ordinary mind, abiding in its own clarity,

wylie: gnad kyis grol bas phyogs ris min/_/
english: liberated through the crucial point, is not partial to any side. [N-141]

wylie: dus kyis grol bas ltos gzhi med/_/
english: Liberated through time, there is no basis of dependence.

wylie: 'bad med grol bas rtsol sgrub med/_/
english: Liberated without effort, there is no effortful accomplishment.

wylie: gdeng gis grol bas 'bad rtsol med/_/
english: Liberated through confidence, there is no endeavor or effort.

wylie: de la gdeng gis grol bar bshad/_/
english: This is explained as liberation through confidence.

wylie: ye nas grol bas bskyar gzhi med/_/
english: Liberated from the outset, there is nothing to repeat.

wylie: rang gis grol bas gnyen po med/_/
english: Liberated by itself, there is no antidote.

wylie: cer gyis grol bas mthong sar yal/_/
english: Liberated nakedly, it vanishes where it is seen.

wylie: yongs su grol bas 'bad med pa'o/_/
english: Completely liberated, it is effortless. [N-142]

wylie: dris lan bcu bdun pa/
english: [Source heading: Seventeenth reply.]

wylie: de ltar grol ba'i sems nyid la/_/
english: In the nature of ordinary mind liberated in this way,

wylie: thugs rje med pa ma yin te/_/
english: it is not that compassionate responsiveness is absent.

wylie: gzhi la gnas pa'i ye shes kyis/_/
english: Through primordial knowing that abides in the Ground,

wylie: rang bzhin shugs kyis 'chang gzhi byed/_/
english: intrinsic nature, by its own momentum, serves as a support for holding. [N-143]

wylie: mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyis/_/
english: Through primordial knowing that holds characteristics,

wylie: rkyen gyis dag pa smin par byed/_/
english: purity is brought to maturity through conditions.

wylie: shes dang shes bya'i ye shes kyis/_/
english: Through primordial knowing of knowing and what is to be known,

wylie: mos gus can la dngos grub ster/_/
english: accomplishments are granted to those with aspiration and devotion.

wylie: de yang sems nyid smin pa'i tshe/_/
english: Furthermore, when the nature of ordinary mind matures,

wylie: chos kyi sku la gzhi gnas te/_/
english: the Ground abides in the dharma embodiment.

wylie: ka nas dag pa'i dri ma zad/_/
english: The stains of what is pure from the outset are exhausted. [N-143]

wylie: ngo bo ye nas 'khrul pa med/_/
english: Essence is undeluded from the outset.

wylie: 'char byed ma 'gags lhun grub po/_/
english: Making appearances arise without cessation is spontaneous presence.

wylie: rang bzhin 'di 'dra nges pa med/_/
english: Intrinsic nature is not determined as ‘like this.’

wylie: kun la khyab pas thugs rje ste/_/
english: Because it pervades all, it is compassionate responsiveness.

wylie: 'khor ba 'das pa chad pa min/_/
english: Samsara and passing beyond are not cut off.

wylie: longs sku'i ye shes mtshan nyid 'dzin/_/
english: The primordial knowing of the complete enjoyment embodiment holds characteristics.

wylie: yul dngos dag pas me long ste/_/
english: Through objects and entities being pure, there is the mirror-like [primordial knowing],

wylie: 'khor 'das gzugs brnyan gsal ba'o/_/
english: the clear reflection of samsara and nirvana.

wylie: phyogs ris med pa'i mnyam pa nyid/_/
english: There is evenness without partiality.

wylie: dbang po'i yul brten so sor rtogs/_/
english: Relying on the objects of the faculties, there is discriminating [primordial knowing]. [N-143] [N-T80]

wylie: 'bad pas ma yin bya ba grub/_/
english: Not through effort, activity is accomplished.

wylie: tha dad med pas chos kyi dbyings/_/
english: Because there is no difference, there is the basic space of phenomena. [N-143] [N-T80]

wylie: sprul pa'i sku la shes bya ste/_/
english: In the emanation embodiment, there is what is to be known.

wylie: ji ltar mkhyen pas dngos po yi/_/
english: Through knowing how [things are], an entity's

wylie: gnas lugs rang gi don du shes/_/
english: natural state is known for one's own purpose.

wylie: ji snyed pas ni gdul bya yi/_/
english: Through knowing the multiplicity, concerning those to be trained,

wylie: bsam pa ci ltar gnas pa shes/_/
english: one knows how their intentions abide.

wylie: de ltar thugs rje'i 'char tshul las/_/
english: Thus, from the ways compassionate responsiveness arises,

wylie: gdul bya'i 'gro ba tha dad la/_/
english: for the different beings to be trained,

wylie: 'dul byed sku yang de tsam mo/_/
english: there are that many embodiments that train them. [N-143]

wylie: dris lan bco brgyad pa/
english: [Source heading: Eighteenth reply.]

wylie: de nyid ye shes gnad bstan pas/_/
english: In teaching that very crucial point of primordial knowing:

wylie: dang po gzhi la khyab tshul la/_/
english: first, its manner of pervading the Ground;

wylie: bar du lam la rdzogs pa yi/_/
english: in between, its completion on the path;

wylie: tha ma 'gro ba'i lus la khyab/_/
english: finally, it pervades the bodies of beings.

wylie: lus kyi dus ni 'di lta ste/_/
english: At the time of the body, it is like this:

wylie: 'byung ba 'dus pa'i phung po yi/_/
english: in the aggregates of gathered elements,

wylie: tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas na/_/
english: within the precious palace of the heart (citta),

wylie: ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i cha/_/
english: the portion of essence, pure from the outset,

wylie: stong gsal 'dus pa sku yi gdangs/_/
english: is the radiance of embodiment, empty and clear united.

wylie: zhal phyag rdzogs pa bum sku'i tshul/_/
english: Faces and hands complete: the manner of the vase embodiment.

wylie: lhun grub 'od kyi gong bur gnas/_/
english: It abides as an orb of spontaneously present light.

wylie: thugs rje kha dog so sor gsal/_/
english: Compassionate responsiveness is clear in distinct colors.

wylie: ro ma rkyang ma kun 'dar ma/
english: Roma, Kyangma, and Kundarma;

wylie: ka ti shel gyi sbu gu can/_/
english: the Kati crystal tube channel—

wylie: me long mnyam nyid so sor rtogs/_/
english: the mirror-like, evenness, and discriminating,

wylie: bya grub chos dbyings ye shes ni/_/
english: activity-accomplishing and basic-space-of-phenomena primordial knowings,

wylie: thig le rgyu dang mi rgyu dang*/_/
english: with moving and nonmoving spheres,

wylie: rang rtsa la rdzogs pa'i rten du gnas/_/
english: abide as supports of completion in their own channels. [N-144]

wylie: dwangs ma 'dus pa'i mig gnyis nas/_/
english: From the two eyes, where the refined parts gather,

wylie: thabs dang shes rab khyad par las/_/
english: through the distinction of methods and discerning knowing,

wylie: ji ltar mkhyen pa'i thig le dang /_/
english: knowing how [things are] matures as the sphere [lamp] and

wylie: dag pa dbyings kyi sgron mar smin/_/
english: the lamp of pure basic space.

wylie: ji snyed pa ni rgyang zhags dang /_/
english: Knowing the multiplicity matures as the far-reaching-lasso [lamp] and

wylie: shes rab sgron mar smin pa yis/_/
english: the discerning-knowing lamp.

wylie: 'gro ba rnams kyi las kyi yang /_/
english: Also concerning the karma of beings,

wylie: dbang po'i bye brag ci lta bar/_/
english: whatever the distinctions of their faculties,

wylie: de la bslabs pas shes par 'gyur/_/
english: through training in this, they become known. [N-144]

wylie: dris lan bcu dgu pa/
english: [Source heading: Nineteenth reply.]

wylie: bzhugs tshul gnas lugs rnam pa gnyis/_/
english: The manner of abiding and the natural state have two aspects:

wylie: thog ma'i gzhi la gnas pa dang /_/
english: abiding in the initial Ground,

wylie: 'khrul pa'i yul la gnas pa'o/_/
english: and abiding in the object of delusion.

wylie: thog ma'i ngo bo rang bzhin dang /_/
english: The initial [abiding] is as essence, intrinsic nature,

wylie: thugs rje rnam pa gsum du gnas/_/
english: and compassionate responsiveness—the three.

wylie: de yang ngo bo skur gnas pas//
english: Furthermore, because essence abides as embodiment,

wylie: chos dang longs spyod sprul pa'i char/_/
english: into portions of dharma, complete enjoyment, and emanation,

wylie: ma phye 'byed pa med pa'i tshul/_/
english: it is not divided: the manner of no division.

wylie: bab las grub pa nyid la yang*/_/
english: Even in what is accomplished from its own condition,

wylie: sku mdog la sogs blo yul med/_/
english: the embodiment's color and so forth are not objects of conceptual mind. [N-145]

wylie: rang bzhin 'char byed 'od kyi tshul/_/
english: Intrinsic nature makes appearances arise in the manner of light:

wylie: dkar dmar ser dang ljang mthing ni/_/
english: white, red, yellow, green, and blue.

wylie: mtshan ma ris can ma yin par/_/
english: Not as characteristics with delineations,

wylie: ris med shes bya'i bab las grub/_/
english: without delineation, it is accomplished from the condition of what is to be known. [N-145]

wylie: thugs rje 'char ba sna tshogs las/_/
english: From compassionate responsiveness arising in manifold ways,

wylie: 'di 'dra gcig tu nges med pas/_/
english: because it is not determined as one ‘like this,’

wylie: sna tshogs snang phyir gzhi zhes bya/_/
english: and manifold [appearances] arise, it is called the Ground.

wylie: 'khrul pa'i yul la rang bzhag dang*/_/
english: In the object of delusion, leave [it] of itself,

wylie: cog bzhag rang grol rgyas gdab po/_/
english: and seal leaving just as it is with self-liberation. [N-145]

wylie: dris lan nyi shu pa/
english: [Source heading: Twentieth reply.]

wylie: _dgongs pa gcig las g.yos pa med/_/
english: Enlightened intent has not moved from one.

wylie: snang ba snang ba'i thog gsal bas/_/
english: Because appearance is clear right upon appearance,

wylie: bzhin dang me long lta bu las/_/
english: as with a face and a mirror,

wylie: grol ba de dang de nyid grol/_/
english: liberation—that and that itself are liberated. [N-146]

wylie: shes pa 'gyu ba yul stong pas/_/
english: Because moving knowing's object is empty,

wylie: mthong shes rig pa tha dad min/_/
english: seeing, knowing, and awareness are not different.

wylie: de nyid rang gi thog tu grol/_/
english: That itself is liberated right where it is.

wylie: gcig shes pas ni kun grol byed/_/
english: Knowing one liberates all.

wylie: gnyis dang gsum gyi grangs mtha' zad/_/
english: The numerical limits of two and three are exhausted.

wylie: rtog cing 'dzin pa'i yul mi snang*/_/
english: No object of conceptualizing and holding appears.

wylie: 'gyu dang 'dzin pa ye nas stong*/_/
english: Movement and holding are empty from the outset.

wylie: stong pa'i dgongs pa gsal rdzogs pas/_/
english: Because empty enlightened intent is clear and complete,

wylie: du ma'i grangs mtha' zad pa'o/
english: the numerical limits of the many are exhausted. [N-146]

wylie: dris lan nyer gcig pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-first reply.]

wylie: _kun gzhi dang ni chos sku'i gnad/_/
english: The crucial point of the all-basis and the dharma embodiment:

wylie: de la kun gzhi re zhig bshad/_/
english: first, the all-basis will be explained.

wylie: chos dang chos min kun gyi gzhi/_/
english: It is the basis of all phenomena and nonphenomena.

wylie: ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba bshad/_/
english: Its essence, word explanation, and subdivisions are explained.

wylie: ngo bo bag chags rnams kyi snod/_/
english: Its essence is the vessel of habitual tendencies.

wylie: dbye ba yul dang sbyor ba dang*/_/
english: Its subdivisions are object, application,

wylie: sna tshogs pa dang ye gzhi'o/_/
english: the manifold, and the primordial Ground. [N-147]

wylie: nges tshig kun ni 'dus pa la/_/
english: In the word explanation, ‘all’ means gathering;

wylie: gzhi ni tshogs shing sogs pa'o/_/
english: ‘basis’ means assembling and accumulating.

wylie: chos kyi sku ni spros bral te/_/
english: The dharma embodiment is free from conceptual elaborations.

wylie: rang gar 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma med/_/
english: There are no characteristics of arbitrary holding.

wylie: ngo bo stong gsal dbyer med la/_/
english: Its essence is empty and clear, indivisible.

wylie: dbye ba chos dang longs sprul sku/_/
english: Its subdivisions: dharma, complete enjoyment, and emanation embodiments.

wylie: gsum gyi dbye bas khyad par 'jug_/
english: Through this threefold division, distinctions apply.

wylie: nges tshig chos ni yang dag lam/_/
english: In the word explanation, ‘dharma’ is the authentic path;

wylie: sku ni de las grub pa'o/_/
english: ‘embodiment’ is what is accomplished from it.

wylie: de ltar dbye ba'i gnad kyis ni/_/
english: Thus, through the crucial point of distinguishing,

wylie: dus dang thabs dang dpe nyid dang /_/
english: time, method, and example,

wylie: phyed pa'i tshad kyis 'bras bu'o/_/
english: and the measure of distinction, there is the result. [N-147]

wylie: dris lan nyer gnyis pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-second reply.]

wylie: sems dang ye shes gnad nyid ni/_/
english: The crucial point of ordinary mind and primordial knowing:

wylie: sems zhes bya ba 'khrul rtog la/_/
english: what is called ordinary mind concerns delusive conceptual thought.

wylie: ngo bo 'jug cing khyab pa la/_/
english: Its essence enters and pervades;

wylie: dran bsam rnams kyi gzhi pa'o/_/
english: it is the Ground of mindfulness and reflection.

wylie: dbye ba dag dang ma dag pa/_/
english: Its subdivisions are pure and impure.

wylie: nges tshig bsam pa dran yul skye/_/
english: Its word explanation: thought arises as what is recalled.

wylie: de yang gang la sems dang gang gis sems/_/
english: Furthermore, what one thinks about, and that by which one thinks,

wylie: gang sems pa dang gang phyir sems/_/
english: what thinks, and why one thinks. [N-148]

wylie: ye shes rtog pa ma yin te/_/
english: Primordial knowing is not conceptual thought.

wylie: ngo bo rang gsal snying po'i don/_/
english: Its essence is self-clear: the core meaning.

wylie: dbye ba dag ni gsum du 'dod/_/
english: Its subdivisions are held to be three.

wylie: nges tshig ye nas gnas pa'i don/_/
english: Its word explanation means abiding from the outset.

wylie: de ltar shes pas ye shes te/_/
english: Through knowing in this way, it is primordial knowing.

wylie: de nyid dbye ba'i don bstan pa/_/
english: The meaning of distinguishing these is taught:

wylie: dus dang thabs dang dpe dang tshad/_/
english: time, method, example, and measure;

wylie: dgongs pa so so'i 'bras bu dang /_/
english: the results of their respective enlightened intents;

wylie: ye shes rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid ni/_/
english: and the characteristics of realizing primordial knowing.

wylie: lus dang ngag dang sems kyis kyang /_/
english: Through body, speech, and ordinary mind, too,

wylie: rtags dang tshad dang 'jug pa dang /_/
english: signs, measures, and entry;

wylie: mtshan nyid 'gyur bar shes pa dang /_/
english: knowing the changes in characteristics;

wylie: mnyam nyid rdzogs pa'i bye brag go/_/
english: and the distinction of complete evenness. [N-148]

wylie: dris lan nyer gsum pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-third reply.]

wylie: 'byung ba dwangs snyigs 'byed 'dod pas/_/
english: One wishing to distinguish the refined and turbid parts of the elements:

wylie: don dam kun rdzob dbye ba las/_/
english: through the distinction of ultimate and relative,

wylie: 'byung ba la yang gnyis su 'dus/_/
english: the elements, too, are included in two.

wylie: de yi smin po byed las de tsam mo/_/
english: Their maturation and activities are likewise twofold.

wylie: sa yi snyigs ma rags pa las/_/
english: Earth's turbid part is coarse.

wylie: de yi smin po phra rab rdul/_/
english: Its maturation is exceedingly fine particles.

wylie: byed las sha dang de yi nad/_/
english: Its activity is flesh and its illnesses.

wylie: dwangs mas lus zungs rdzogs pa dang /_/
english: The refined part completes the bodily constituents,

wylie: don dam byang sems spel ba dang*/_/
english: increases ultimate awakening ordinary mind, [N-149] [N-T82]

wylie: rgyang zhags sgron mar smin pa dang*/_/
english: and matures as the far-reaching-lasso lamp.

wylie: gnad kyis goms kyang 'grub pa'o/_/
english: Through familiarity with the crucial point, too, it is accomplished.

wylie: chu yi snyigs mas rlan zhing sdud/_/
english: Water's turbid part moistens and gathers.

wylie: byed las khrag dang de yi nad/_/
english: Its activity is blood and its illnesses.

wylie: smin pas chu rdul tshogs pa sdud/_/
english: Through maturation it gathers collections of water particles.

wylie: dwangs mas rga shi zil gnon dang*/_/
english: The refined part overcomes aging and death;

wylie: byed las chos nyid brtan pa dang /_/
english: its activity stabilizes the nature of phenomena,

wylie: shes rab sgron mar smin pa dang*/_/
english: and it matures as the discerning-knowing lamp.

wylie: gnad kyis zas kyi rnal 'byor 'grub/_/
english: Through the crucial point, the yoga of food is accomplished.

wylie: me yi snyigs mas bsreg cing mched/_/
english: Fire's turbid part burns and spreads.

wylie: smin pas lug dang glang rdul lo/_/
english: Through maturation, there are sheep and ox particles. [N-149]

wylie: byed las drod dang de yi nad/_/
english: Its activity is warmth and its illnesses.

wylie: dwangs mas ngag lus rdzogs pa dang /_/
english: The refined part completes speech and body,

wylie: thig le'i sgron mar smin pa dang /_/
english: and matures as the sphere lamp.

wylie: gnyid kyi bsam gtan bsgom pa dang /_/
english: Through cultivating the meditative stabilization of sleep,

wylie: gnad kyis rmi lam 'gags par byed/_/
english: the crucial point causes dreams to cease.

wylie: rlung gi snyigs mas dwangs 'byed bskyod/_/
english: Wind's turbid part separates the refined parts and moves [them].

wylie: smin pas nyi rdul rdzogs pa dang*/_/
english: Through maturation, sun particles become complete. [N-149]

wylie: byed las dbugs dang de yi nad/_/
english: Its activity is breath and its illnesses.

wylie: dwangs mas sems bde nus pa dang*/
english: The refined part gives ordinary mind ease and capacity.

wylie: byed las chos nyid gsal ba dang*/_/
english: Its activity makes the nature of phenomena clear

wylie: rnam rtog tha dad 'byed pa'o/_/
english: and distinguishes varieties of differentiating conceptualization.

wylie: smin pas dbyings kyi sgron ma las/_/
english: Through maturation, from the lamp of basic space,

wylie: gnad kyis bag chags drungs nas 'byin/_/
english: the crucial point uproots habitual tendencies.

wylie: dus dang thabs dang gnad dang tshig_/
english: Through time, method, crucial point, and word,

wylie: de yi rang bzhin 'jug pa yis/_/
english: entering its intrinsic nature,

wylie: 'byung ba'i gnad kyi man ngag rdzogs/_/
english: the pith instructions on the elements' crucial points are complete. [N-149]

wylie: dris lan nyer bzhi pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-fourth reply.]

wylie: sgron ma gtems pa 'di lta ste/_/
english: Packing the lamps is like this:

wylie: dad ldan 'khor ba'i yid bral bas/_/
english: one with faith, free of a mental faculty [turned toward] samsara,

wylie: bla ma mchod dang gtor ma bya/_/
english: should offer to the guru and make a torma.

wylie: 'khor ba'i 'brel pa kun spangs te/_/
english: Having abandoned all connections with samsara,

wylie: dben pa'i phyogs sam dur khrod du/_/
english: in a secluded place or a charnel ground,

wylie: grogs spang gcig pur gnas par bya/_/
english: abandon companions and remain alone.

wylie: gsum po brten pa ma yin par/_/
english: Not relying on the three [unspecified supports],

wylie: rang gi mtheb dang mdzub mo yis/_/
english: with one's own thumb and forefinger—[Editorial note: Do not infer or perform eye pressure from this draft.] [N-150]

wylie: thig le stong pa'i sgron ma gtems/_/
english: one packs the lamp of the empty sphere.

wylie: gtems pa de las gang byung ba/_/
english: Whatever arises from that packing

wylie: chos nyid mngon sum snang ba'o/_/
english: is the vision of the direct perception of the nature of phenomena.

wylie: de las ye shes 'phel ba'i nyams/_/
english: From this, the experience of increased primordial knowing,

wylie: kha dog dang ni dbyibs kyis kyang /_/
english: through colors and shapes,

wylie: phyi dang nang kun gsal bar khyab/_/
english: clearly pervades both outer and inner.

wylie: gong nas gong du nges par 'phel/_/
english: It definitely increases further and further.

wylie: 'di dus lus ngag bde ba'i rtags/_/
english: At this time, the signs of bliss in body and speech

wylie: snang ba'i tshad dang rim pas sbyar/_/
english: are joined to the measures and stages of appearances.

wylie: ye shes rdzogs pa'i snang ba dang*/_/
english: From the appearance in which primordial knowing is complete,

wylie: chos nyid dag pa'i snang ba las/_/
english: and the appearance of the pure nature of phenomena,

wylie: snang gsum rdzogs nas zad par 'gyur/_/
english: when the three appearances are complete, there is exhaustion.

wylie: de la 'bras bu zhes bya'o/_/
english: This is called the result. [N-150]

wylie: dris lan nyer lnga pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-fifth reply.]

wylie: _de ltar gtems pa'i snang ba ni/_/
english: The appearances of packing in this way:

wylie: dang po dmar po dag pa yi/_/
english: first, pure red,

wylie: dbang rdzogs zlum po rang gsal rdzogs/_/
english: complete in power, round, and fully self-clear.

wylie: mdzub gnyis dag las gsum du 'gyur/_/
english: From two fingerbreadths, it becomes three. [N-151]

wylie: de nas yang yang gtems pa yis/_/
english: Then, through packing again and again,

wylie: ye shes lnga yi kha dog ni/_/
english: the colors of the five primordial knowings—

wylie: dkar dmar ljang gu ser mthing nang /_/
english: white, red, green, yellow, and blue—

wylie: yul la snang ste rtsol ba'o/_/
english: appear as the object; this involves effort.

wylie: de nas rtsol bral phyin pa yang*/_/
english: Then, also on reaching freedom from effort,

wylie: rlung gi cha yis 'gro dang 'ong*/_/
english: through the portion of wind, they go and come.

wylie: me long dag gi dbyibs tsam las/_/
english: From merely the form of a mirror,

wylie: gnyis dang gsum gyi char snang ngo /_/
english: they appear in portions of two and three. [N-151]

wylie: de nyid rtag tu goms pa las/_/
english: Through becoming continually familiar with this,

wylie: kha dog lnga yi 'od kyis kyang*/_/
english: also through the five-colored light,

wylie: re lde tsam las gru chad snang /_/
english: isolated patches appear, the size of a blanket;

wylie: yul gru tsam las mthong tshad do/_/
english: the extent of seeing is the size of a region. [N-151]

wylie: de la goms pa'i tshad rnyed nas/_/
english: Having found the measure of familiarity with this,

wylie: thig le'i nang du sku dang bcas/_/
english: within the spheres, [appearances] include embodiments.

wylie: phyed sku dag tu yun 'ga' gnas/_/
english: For a time they abide as half-embodiments.

wylie: de las lnga lnga zung du bcas/_/
english: Then, five and five are joined in pairs,

wylie: rab tu gsal ba'i thig les 'brel/_/
english: connected by exceedingly clear spheres.

wylie: yab yum sku yi snang ba can/_/
english: There are appearances of father and mother embodiments.

wylie: 'khrul snang zad nas zhing khams so/_/
english: Delusive appearances exhausted, there are fields.

wylie: 'di dus lus ngag yid kyi tshad/_/
english: At this time, the measures of body, speech, and mental faculty—

wylie: so so'i snang ba mthong dus kyi/_/
english: at the time of seeing the respective appearances,

wylie: rang la smin pas rtags rdzogs te/_/
english: through maturation in oneself, the signs are complete.

wylie: zad pa'i tshad rnams mngon par snang /_/
english: The measures of exhaustion appear manifestly.

wylie: 'di la brtson 'grus che chung gis/_/
english: Through greater or lesser diligence in this,

wylie: zhag dang zla ba lo rnams kyis/_/
english: in days, months, and years,

wylie: so so'i dus la nges par 'grub/_/
english: accomplishment definitely occurs at each respective time.

wylie: 'gyur ba med pa'i dus dag las/_/
english: Through times that do not change,

wylie: so so'i tshad la phebs pa'o/_/
english: one reaches the respective measures. [N-151]

wylie: dris lan nyer drug pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-sixth reply.]

wylie: rtsa yi gnad ni brgya phrag gnyis/_/
english: The crucial points of the channels number two hundred.

wylie: de la legs par gnad bsdus nas/_/
english: Thoroughly condensing their crucial points:

wylie: brgya dang bco lngas las kun byed/_/
english: one hundred and fifteen perform all activities.

wylie: rab tu 'gyur ba rtsa yi gnad/_/
english: The crucial point of the channels is thorough transformation.

wylie: drug cu rtsa brgyad chos nyid sbyor/_/
english: Sixty-eight join with the nature of phenomena.

wylie: mchog tu bde ba chen po'i rtsa/_/
english: The channels of supremely great bliss,

wylie: gzhi yis bzhi yang byung 'gro ba'i snang ba ston/_/
english: through the Ground, reveal the appearances of beings. [Source variant: ‘Four also occurs.’] [N-152]

wylie: gzhi yi gnas dang 'gro ba'i lam/_/
english: The place of the Ground and the path of going;

wylie: smin pa'i sgo dang byed pa'i las/_/
english: the door of maturation and the activities of agents;

wylie: dus dang de yi snang tshad do/_/
english: time and its measures of appearance.

wylie: de yi gnad kyi man ngag ni/_/
english: The pith instructions on their crucial points:

wylie: gnas dang 'ong dang 'gro lam rten/_/
english: rely on abiding, coming, and the path of going.

wylie: smin pa'i sa dang thig le sbyar/_/
english: Join the ground of maturation and the sphere. [N-152]

wylie: de ltar su yis byas pa yis/_/
english: Whoever acts in this way—

wylie: rnam rtog 'gags nas ye shes skye'o/_/
english: differentiating conceptualization stops, and primordial knowing arises.

wylie: dus ni rlung gi tshad kyis bzung /_/
english: Grasp time through the measure of wind.

wylie: 'gyu ba'i grangs kyis ye shes gnas/_/
english: Through the number of movements, primordial knowing abides.

wylie: mkhas pas shes par byas te bzung*/_/
english: The skilled person should know and retain [this].

wylie: byed las rlung gi grangs tshad kyis/_/
english: Through the numerical measure of wind's activities,

wylie: ma 'khrul pa la chos nyid dang /_/
english: in freedom from error, [these] reveal the nature of phenomena

wylie: ma dag las kyi bye brag ston/_/
english: and the distinctions of impure activities.

wylie: snang ba'i tshad kyang lus ngag yid/_/
english: The measures of appearance, too, are body, speech, and mental faculty,

wylie: _so so'i dus la bab pas so/_/
english: because their respective times have arrived. [N-153]

wylie: dris lan nyer bdun pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-seventh reply.]

wylie: sems kyi sbyangs pa 'di lta ste/_/
english: The training of ordinary mind is like this:

wylie: phyi rol yul dang nang gi lus/_/
english: outer objects and the inner body;

wylie: bar du lus dang sems bsdams pas/_/
english: between them, restraining body and ordinary mind;

wylie: ngag gi bya ba'i las kyi bya/_/
english: acting through the activities of speech;

wylie: mchog tu sems kyis sems la sbyang /_/
english: supremely, training ordinary mind with ordinary mind.

wylie: yul ni yod dang med pa dang*/_/
english: For objects, reflect on existence and nonexistence,

wylie: 'gro dang 'ong ba'i gnad kyis bsam/_/
english: and the crucial point of going and coming.

wylie: lus ni ming dang phra rab rdul/_/
english: For the body, through names and exceedingly fine particles,

wylie: bye brag du ma nyid kyis gzhig_/
english: analyze [it] into many distinctions.

wylie: lus sems bsdom pa'i bar du brtags/_/
english: Examine the interval in which body and ordinary mind are joined.

wylie: ngag gi brjod pa bye brag gis/
english: Through the particulars of verbal expression,

wylie: so so'i rlung dang 'gro dang 'ong /_/
english: the respective winds, going and coming,

wylie: dus kyi gnyis med bsres pas 'grub/_/
english: are accomplished through mixing the nonduality of times. [N-154]

wylie: mchog tu sems ni 'gro 'ong gnas/_/
english: Supremely, ordinary mind's going, coming, and abiding—

wylie: rgyu mtshan brtag pa med pas sbyangs/_/
english: train through the absence of examination of their reasons. [N-154]

wylie: de ltar 'byongs pa'i tshad kyang bzung*/_/
english: Also grasp the measure of proficiency in this way.

wylie: de ltar de yi mtshan nyid rdzogs/_/
english: In this way, its characteristics are complete.

wylie: dris lan nyer brgyad pa'o/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-eighth reply.]

wylie: _nyon mongs pa ni rang rkyen las/
english: Afflictions arise from their own conditions:

wylie: rang gi grib mas 'jigs pa bzhin//
english: as when one fears one's own shadow,

wylie: rang gi rang bzhin mthong bar 'gyur/_/
english: one comes to see one's own intrinsic nature.

wylie: de yang rlung gi grangs tshad las/_/
english: Also, from the numerical measures of wind,

wylie: brgya dang nyi shu'i grangs kyis shes/_/
english: one knows through the number one hundred and twenty.

wylie: la la yul la brten pa yis/_/
english: Some rely on objects,

wylie: bden dang rdzun gyi khyad par 'byung*/_/
english: from which distinctions of true and false arise.

wylie: la la dmigs pa med pa las/_/
english: Some, from having no object of focus,

wylie: gzu bo tsam gyis shes par gzung /_/
english: are to be known through mere neutrality.

wylie: la la 'khor 'das 'dod pa yang /_/
english: Some desire samsara and nirvana as well;

wylie: bden pa gnyis las sems gnyis 'khrul/_/
english: from the two truths, two ordinary minds become deluded. [N-155]

wylie: de las snang rkyen nyon mongs sogs/_/
english: From this, appearing conditions, afflictions, and so forth.

wylie: gzhan yang rab tu bshad bya ba/_/
english: Furthermore, what is to be closely explained:

wylie: snang ba 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin ni/_/
english: the intrinsic nature of delusive appearance

wylie: ye shes yin par sngar ma mthong*/_/
english: was not previously seen to be primordial knowing.

wylie: rtog bcas 'khrul pa'i gzhi med pas/_/
english: Because there is no Ground of delusion accompanied by conceptual thought,

wylie: kun gzhi chos sku chen por rtogs/
english: the all-basis is realized as the great dharma embodiment.

wylie: 'khrul pa'i rang rtog rgyun chad do/_/
english: The flow of delusion's own conceptual thought is cut.

wylie: de ltar 'khrul med snang ba ni/_/
english: Thus, undeluded appearance

wylie: ye nas grol ba'i gnad las 'byung*/_/
english: arises from the crucial point of liberation from the outset. [N-155]

wylie: 'gro ba'i phung po sangs rgyas sku/_/
english: The aggregates of beings are the buddhas' embodiments:

wylie: ye nas yin par sus ma rig_/
english: who has not known them to be so from the outset?

wylie: phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag tu/_/
english: As for the aggregates having the identity of the five buddhas,

wylie: rtsa gnas yi ge grub las byung*/_/
english: [this] arises from the accomplishment of letters abiding in the channels.

wylie: chu bur mig las ye shes ni/_/
english: From the bubble-like eyes, primordial knowing—

wylie: rang snang yin par sus ma mthong*/_/
english: who has not seen it to be self-appearance?

wylie: rang byung rang la rdzogs pas zhi/_/

wylie: mngal du gnas pa chos kyi dbyings/_/

wylie: de yang chos nyid mngon sum gnad/_/
english: Furthermore, the crucial point of directly perceiving the nature of phenomena:

wylie: mthong ba tsam gyis shes pa dang*/_/

wylie: grol zhes bkrol ba ma yin te/_/

wylie: thim nas rang bzhin dmigs med ltar/_/

wylie: ris med cha shas yod ma yin/_/

english: Thus, from The Great All-Penetrating Word, the Root of All Phenomena,

wylie: chos nyid gnas pa ji ltar lags/_/

wylie: las dang dbang po'i 'thad pa ci/_/

wylie: me long lta bu ci yi phyir/_/

wylie: mnyam pa nyid kyi 'dod pa ci/_/
english: What is intended by evenness?

wylie: so sor rtogs pa gang tsam zhig_/
english: What is the extent of discriminating [primordial knowing]?

wylie: bya ba ji ltar 'grub pa lags/_/
english: How is activity accomplished?

wylie: chos kyi dbyings la ji ltar spyod/_/

wylie: shes pas bsdus pa'i ye shes gang /_/

wylie: ji snyed pa la khyab pa ci/_/
english: What pervades the multiplicity?

wylie: ji lta mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa gang*/_/

wylie: ye shes rnams kyi sdom gcig gang /_/

wylie: 'di dag bdag gis sngar ma 'tshal/_/

wylie: ston pa thugs rje chen pos gsungs/_/
english: Teacher of great compassionate responsiveness, speak.’ [N-159]

wylie: nam mkha' mi 'byed bar snang nas/_/
english: From the intervening space, without dividing space,

wylie: sus kyang byas pa med pa'i tshig_/

wylie: rang bzhin rtog pa gang med par/_/
english: intrinsically without any conceptual thought,

wylie: brjod med bsam dag sgra las kyang*/_/
english: from words beyond expression, with reflection pure—[N-159]

wylie: tshig gi rgyal po 'di dag ni/_/

wylie: dris lan dang po la nang gses bcus bstan/
english: [Source annotation: The first reply is taught in ten subdivisions.]

wylie: chos nyid gnas pa zhes bya ba/_/

wylie: dus kyi gnas dang rang bzhin dang /_/

wylie: 'pho ba nges pa'i tshad kyis gnas/_/
english: and through the definite measure of shifting;

wylie: ye nas gnas dang 'bad pa dang /_/

wylie: rkyen dang rgyu rkyen bar skabs so/_/
english: conditions, causes and conditions, and intervals. [N-160]

wylie: dus kyi gnas pa'i chos nyid ni/_/
english: The nature of phenomena's abiding in time:

wylie: dbyar dgun ston dpyid cha bzhi las/_/
english: from the four parts—summer, winter, autumn, and spring—

wylie: ston gyi dang por phung po dang*/_/

wylie: 'di dus rten 'brel zab mo bstan/_/

wylie: nyi ma'i dus kyang bcu gnyis la/_/

wylie: rang bzhin du ni gnas pa dag_/

wylie: phyi rol yul dang nang gi sems/_/

wylie: bar gyi dbugs la gnas pa ste/_/

wylie: 'di yang rnal 'byor pas shes bya/_/

wylie: 'pho ba nges pa'i tshad gnas ni/_/

wylie: 'gyu ba chen po'i rlung dag gis/_/

wylie: so so'i gnas skabs 'gyu tshad la/_/

wylie: lnga brgya dag la re re nyid/_/

wylie: rtog pa 'dzin pa stong tshigs la'o/_/

wylie: rigs drug so so'i ltung ba'i gnas/_/

wylie: rlung gi 'gyu ba'i mtshams sbyar bzung*/_/

wylie: de la sems nyid gnas pa'i thabs/_/

wylie: lnga brgya'i dus nas brtsis nas ni/_/

wylie: so so'i dge ba'i sbyor kha 'bad/_/

wylie: 'di yang rkyen gyis nyon mongs 'gyur/_/
english: This, too, changes into afflictions through conditions.

wylie: so so'i rlung gi mtshams nas bzung /_/

wylie: tshe tshad las kyi bye brag yang /_/

wylie: ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid ni/_/

wylie: snang ba med pa thog ma'i dus/_/

wylie: rang bzhin bcos pa med par gnas/_/

wylie: dri med sems kyang de bzhin no/_/

wylie: 'bad pas mngon sum gnad gzir bas/_/

wylie: ma bcos gzhi la gnas pa'o/_/

wylie: rkyen gyis gnas pa 'byung ba yi/_/
english: For abiding through conditions, through the elements'

wylie: lus kyi bye brag dag pa dang*/_/

wylie: ma dag pa yi khyad par gyis/_/
english: and the distinction of impurity,

wylie: ye shes gnas pa'i byed pas ni/_/
english: through the activity of primordial knowing's abiding,

wylie: so so'i dus tshod mkhas pas bzung /_/

wylie: rgyu yis gnas pa'i sems de ni/_/

wylie: kun la khyab phyir chos nyid ngang /_/

wylie: bcos pa med na gnas pa yin/_/

wylie: bar skabs gnas pa rlung gis drang /_/

wylie: 'gyu ba phra ba'i bar du shes/_/

wylie: 'di ni ye shes gnad 'dus pa'o/_/

wylie: dris lan gnyis pa don brgyad bstan pa/

wylie: de las 'khrul pa rgyu dang rkyen/_/

wylie: cha dang yan lag las nyid dang*/_/

wylie: ma smin rnam rtog 'khor ba'o/_/

wylie: ma rig pa ni rnam pa gsum/_/

wylie: yan lag spros pa tha dad las/_/

wylie: thams cad ming gi bye brag tu/_/

wylie: ma smin pa ni rigs drug gzugs/_/

wylie: ming dang bye brag tha dad 'gyur/_/

wylie: rnam rtog bag la nyal ba dang*/_/

wylie: kun nas ldang dang khyab tshul lo/_/

wylie: 'khor ba zhes pa mtshungs pa dang /_/

wylie: tshogs pa'i las te sdud dang mched/_/

wylie: rdzogs dang bye brag sna tshogs pa'o/_/

wylie: de ltar 'khrul zhes ming tsam las/_/

wylie: rtog 'dzin byed pa'i rtags dang ni/_/

wylie: tshogs shing sdud pa'i byed pa can/_/
english: and the agency of assembling and condensing,

wylie: ming gi bye brag gis brtags so/_/

wylie: dris lan gsum pa don dgu bstan pa/
english: [Source annotation: The third reply is taught in nine points.]

wylie: 'khrul pa'i rgyu ni ma rig pa/_/
english: The cause of delusion is ignorance:

wylie: gzhi dang shes pa sbags pa dang*/_/
english: the Ground, knowing, contamination,

wylie: gzung dang dbang po 'khor tshul lo/_/

wylie: rkyen ni yul dang gzung cha las/_/

wylie: mtha' dang mtha' yi byed _pa dang /_/

wylie: gcig ma shes pa dmigs rten no/_/

wylie: gzhi ni gang yang 'byed med cing*/_/

wylie: nges pa med pa tsam las so/_/

wylie: shes pa 'ju dang yal ba dang*/_/

wylie: mched par 'dzin pa rnams yin no/_/

wylie: gcig ma shes pa ka dag las/_/

wylie: dris lan bzhi pa don brgyad bstan pa/

wylie: mtshan nyid rtogs pa'i bye brag ni/_/

english: Clarity reveals its own identity

wylie: mi snang ba las log pa'o/_/
english: and is the reverse of nonappearance.

wylie: stong pa skye ba ma yin las/_/
english: Emptiness is not birth;

wylie: gdangs dang mtha' dbus med par ston/_/
english: it reveals radiance and absence of limits or center.

wylie: ma byung bas na 'gag med do/_/
english: Because it has not arisen, it does not cease.

wylie: rags pa rdul dang phra rags las/_/
english: The coarse, from fine and coarse particles,

wylie: sna tshogs gzugs su rdzogs pa dang*/_/
english: is complete as manifold forms;

wylie: reg yod 'jig par snang ba'o/_/
english: it is tangible and appears as destructible.

wylie: 'dzin pa dbang po'i yul dag la/_/
english: The apprehending subject, toward the objects of the faculties,

wylie: so so'i bzung bas 'ching ba dang*/_/
english: binds through their respective apprehension,

wylie: bdag dang nyon mongs las kun byed/_/
english: and performs all activities of selfhood and afflictions.

wylie: rnam par shes pa rtog pa'i cha/_/
english: Consciousness is a portion of conceptual thought:

wylie: yul la 'jug cing spyod pa dang*/_/
english: it enters objects and engages with them,

wylie: rtog dang las kyi rnam par rtog_/
english: and differentiating conceptualization concerns thought and activity.

wylie: gzugs can rig bcas bem po ste/_/
english: What possesses form is aware [or] insentient,

wylie: sems sdud pa dang bkod pa'o/_/
english: gathering and arranging ordinary mind. [N-165]

wylie: dris lan lnga pa don brgyad bstan pa/
english: [Source annotation: The fifth reply is taught in eight points.]

wylie: sems can kun gyi tha dad rgyu/_/
english: The causes of all sentient beings' differences:

wylie: 'byung ba'i rgyu dang byed las dang*/_/
english: elemental causes and activities of agency,

wylie: dbang po nyid dang dbyibs dang tshad/_/
english: the faculties themselves, shapes and measures,

wylie: sgra dang so so'i brjod pa dang*/_/
english: sounds and respective expressions,

wylie: gnas pa'i snod kyi bye brag go/_/
english: and particulars of the vessels in which they abide.

wylie: 'byung ba'i rgyu ni bzhi dag las/_/
english: The elemental causes, from four,

wylie: brtags pas drug cu dag yin te/_/
english: when examined, are sixty;

wylie: rnam par phye bas bzhi brgya bzhi'o/_/
english: when differentiated, four hundred and four.

wylie: byed pa'i las ni bzhi gnyis dag las/_/
english: The activities of agency, from four and two,

wylie: brtags pas bcu gnyis drug cu dag tu 'gyur/_/
english: when examined, become twelve and sixty.

wylie: de las rigs drug tha dad do/_/
english: From these, the six classes differ. [N-166]

wylie: dbang po mig la sogs pa yi/_/
english: For faculties such as the eyes,

wylie: dbyibs dang kha dog mi mthun pas/_/
english: through differences in shapes and colors,

wylie: bzhi brgya dag dang bzhi yis kyang /_/
english: also through four hundred and four,

wylie: sems can lus kyang tha dad do/_/
english: the bodies of beings differ.

wylie: dbyibs ni lus dang yan lag dang /_/
english: Through bodily shape, body and limbs,

wylie: so so'i gling dang dbang pos kyang /_/
english: and their respective continents and faculties,

wylie: 'gro ba'i gzugs kyang des phye'o/_/
english: the forms of beings are differentiated.

wylie: tshad ni rigs drug so so ste/_/
english: Measures concern each of the six classes:

wylie: thog ma bar dang tha ma dang*/_/
english: beginning, middle, and end,

wylie: so so'i bsod nams las kyis dbye/_/
english: distinguished by their respective merit and karma.

wylie: sgra ni ring dang thung ba dang*/_/
english: Sounds are long and short,

wylie: drag dang zhan dang gzir dang dbyung*/_/
english: strong and weak, pressing and releasing,

wylie: phra dang seng dang rtse mo'o/_/
english: subtle, seng [unresolved], and pointed. [N-166]

wylie: dngos po sa chu me rlung gis/_/
english: Entities, through earth, water, fire, and wind,

wylie: shes pa nyid dang bsod nams dang*/_/
english: are examined through knowing itself, merit,

wylie: dbang thang lus kyi shas kyis brtags/_/
english: ascendancy, and bodily portions.

wylie: brjod pa gnas dang 'byung ba dang /_/
english: Expression: place, elements,

wylie: las dang rtog pa rang gnad do/_/
english: activity, and conceptual thought—their own crucial points.

wylie: gnas pa'i snod ni dag pa dang*/_/
english: The vessels of abiding are pure

wylie: ma dag pa yang bcud kyis dbye/_/
english: or impure, distinguished by their inhabitants.

wylie: des na 'byung ba'i rang gnad las/_/
english: Therefore, through the elements' own crucial points,

wylie: sems can lus kyang tha dad do/_/
english: the bodies of beings differ. [N-166]

wylie: dris lan drug pa don brgyad bstan pa/
english: [Source annotation: The sixth reply is taught in eight points.]

wylie: rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i gnas skabs ni/_/
english: The state in which intrinsic nature is complete:

wylie: chos nyid dbyings dang rang ngo dang /_/
english: the nature of phenomena, basic space, and own identity;

wylie: 'gyu ba stong dang rtog pa zad/_/
english: movement empty and conceptual thought exhausted;

wylie: gzhi rdzogs lam dang 'bras bu'o/_/
english: completion in the Ground, path, and result.

wylie: chos nyid sus kyang bcos su med/_/
english: The nature of phenomena cannot be contrived by anyone.

wylie: rang bzhin dag pa spros pa bral/_/
english: Intrinsic nature is pure, free from conceptual elaborations,

wylie: rnam rtog tha dad yul las 'das/_/
english: beyond the object of distinct differentiating conceptualizations.

wylie: tshig byung 'khrul pa rgyun chad pa'o/_/
english: The flow of delusion arising through words is cut. [N-167]

wylie: dbyings ni phyi dang nang gi ste/_/
english: Basic space has outer and inner aspects.

wylie: phyi ni sprin bral mkha' la 'dzin/_/
english: Outer: hold [the focus] in cloud-free space.

wylie: bag rdul char gyis dengs dus su/_/
english: When fine dust has been cleared by rain,

wylie: mkhas pas mngon sum gnad gzir dang*/_/
english: the skilled person presses the crucial point of direct perception,

wylie: nang gi sgron ma lam du bya'o/_/
english: and takes the inner lamps as the path.

wylie: rang ngo rig pa lu gu rgyud/_/
english: Own identity: awareness as vajra chains,

wylie: 'gro 'ong phral te mkha' la'o/_/
english: separating going and coming, in space. [N-167]

wylie: 'gyu ba rlung gnyis byed pa bcad/_/
english: Movement: cut the activity of the two winds.

wylie: dgu pa yi ni rlung gis dbye/_/
english: Distinguish through the ninth wind;

wylie: gnas su 'jug pa thabs kyis dbye'o/_/
english: distinguish entry into abiding through methods.

wylie: dpe ni rlung dag stong pa yi/_/
english: The example: through the winds being empty,

wylie: snang ba thams cad zad par 'gyur/_/
english: all appearances become exhausted.

wylie: de ltar rnam rtog zad pa dang /_/
english: Likewise, the exhaustion of differentiating conceptualization

wylie: skye med ye shes dus mnyam ste/_/
english: and unborn primordial knowing are simultaneous.

wylie: 'di tshe 'khor 'das 'dres pa'o/_/
english: At this time, samsara and nirvana mix.

wylie: de yang gzhi la rdzo gas pa'i gnad/_/
english: This, too, is the crucial point of completion in the Ground. [N-167]

wylie: rang bzhin ma bcos mngon du snang /_/
english: Uncontrived intrinsic nature appears manifestly.

wylie: lam ni sgron mas mtshams sbyar nas/_/
english: The path: through connecting with the lamps,

wylie: mngon sum nyid du snang ba'o/_/
english: it appears in direct perception itself.

wylie: 'bras bu gang du bzlog pa med/_/
english: The result cannot be turned back anywhere.

wylie: 'dod dang re dogs yul las 'das/_/
english: It transcends objects of desire, hope, and fear.

wylie: rang snang ka nas dag par rdzogs/_/
english: Self-appearance is complete as pure from the outset;

wylie: shes 'dzin rtog pa kun zad pa'o/_/
english: knowing, holding, and conceptual thought are all exhausted. [N-167]

wylie: dris lan bdun pa don brgyad bstan pa/
english: [Source annotation: The seventh reply is taught in eight points.]

wylie: ming gi mtshan nyid byed pa ni/_/
english: What makes the characteristics of names:

wylie: rgyu dang rkyen dang btags pa dang /_/
english: cause, conditions, imputation,

wylie: mtha' dang dang po tha ma bsgyur/_/
english: limits, the first, transformation of the last,

wylie: brtags pas ma rnyed tha snyad gzhi'o/_/
english: not finding through examination, and the basis of convention. [N-168]

wylie: ming gi rgyu ni tshig gi brda/_/
english: The cause of a name is a verbal symbol.

wylie: mtshan nyid gang du ma grub pas/_/
english: Because characteristics are not established anywhere,

wylie: ltar snang gdags su med pa'o/_/
english: what merely appears cannot be designated. [N-168]

wylie: rkyen ni dbang po thad ka'i yul/_/
english: The conditions are the objects directly before the faculties.

wylie: so so'i snang zhen bcas pa la/_/
english: In their respective appearances accompanied by clinging,

wylie: kun gzhi tshogs pa'i snang char shar/_/
english: the gathering of the all-basis arises as aspects of appearance.

wylie: btags pas brda dang sgyur byed las/_/
english: Through imputation, from symbols and agents of transformation,

wylie: mtshan nyid nye bar ston pa dang /_/
english: characteristics are closely shown.

wylie: khyad par ming gis gang bsgyur gnad/_/
english: In particular, the crucial point of what is transformed by a name:

wylie: so so'i skabs dang sbyar byas nas/_/
english: joining [it] with each respective occasion,

wylie: bcom ldan 'das kyang 'jig par 'gyur/_/
english: even the Blessed One will be destroyed. [N-168]

wylie: mtha' ni 'byung ba'i gnad kyis dbye/_/
english: Limits are distinguished through the elements' crucial points.

wylie: bsad dang gso dang 'jig pa'i las/_/
english: Killing, restoring, and destroying activities

wylie: ming dang rten cing 'brel pas bya'o/_/
english: are performed through names and dependent connections.

wylie: dang po btags pa'i ming yi ge/_/
english: First, the letters of the imputed name:

wylie: dang po dag la brten pa yis/_/
english: through relying on their first [letters],

wylie: bsad dang gso dang gnas pa nyid/_/
english: killing, restoring, and abiding itself—

wylie: so so'i tshad kyis shes par gyis/_/
english: know these through their respective measures.

wylie: tha ma bsgyur ba'i ming gi mtha'/_/
english: For the end of the name transformed last,

wylie: bzlog cing bzhag pa 'byung lus sbyar/_/
english: reverse and place [it], joining elements and body.

wylie: yang dag chos nyid rtog bral la/_/
english: In the authentic nature of phenomena, free from conceptual thought,

wylie: ming gi mtshan nyid rab phye nas/_/
english: having thoroughly distinguished the characteristics of names,

wylie: phyi dang nang la rab brtags pas/_/
english: through thorough examination of outer and inner,

wylie: ming gis mtshan nyid ma rnyed pas/_/
english: because characteristics are not found through names,

wylie: rang gi cho ga rdzogs par 'dod/_/
english: one wishes to complete one's own rite. [N-168]

wylie: tha snyad rnams ni tshig gi mtha'/_/
english: Conventions are the limits of words.

wylie: gang du'ang yod med mtha' yis dbye/_/
english: Distinguish them everywhere through the extremes of existence and nonexistence.

wylie: lus sems gnyis la brtags gzhig pas/_/
english: Through examining and analyzing body and ordinary mind, the two,

wylie: tha snyad gzhi yang stong pa'o/_/
english: the basis of convention, too, is empty.

wylie: gzhi ni gcig dang gnyis su min/_/
english: The Ground is neither one nor two.

wylie: btags stong yod med mtha' 'gags te/_/
english: Imputed emptiness: the extremes of existence and nonexistence stop.

wylie: byas dang byung ba sus mi rnyed/_/
english: No one finds what is made or what has arisen.

wylie: de bzhin gnas dang 'gro 'ong med/_/
english: Likewise, there is no abiding, going, or coming.

wylie: de phyir chos nyid stong pa'o/_/
english: Therefore, the nature of phenomena is empty. [N-168]

wylie: dris lan brgyad pa don bdun bstan pa/
english: [Source annotation: The eighth reply is taught in seven points.]

wylie: sems can las dang dbang po ni/_/
english: Sentient beings' karma and faculties:

wylie: rlung dang shes pa phyi snod dang /_/
english: wind, knowing, the outer vessel,

wylie: 'byung ba spyi dang khyab byed tshul/_/
english: the elements in general, and the manner of pervading;

wylie: gsum dang dgu dang nyer gcig go/_/
english: three, nine, and twenty-one. [N-169]

wylie: sems can las ni rlung gi yang*/_/
english: Sentient beings' karma, too, is impelled

wylie: 'byung ba'i 'phen pa dag tu phul/_/
english: into the elemental projection of wind.

wylie: de las las kyi bye brag gis/_/
english: From this, through karmic particulars,

wylie: 'jug cing thabs kyis rab tu 'byed/_/
english: one enters and thoroughly distinguishes through methods.

wylie: de yi byed pa'i shes pa ni/_/
english: The knowing that enacts this,

wylie: mkha' la sprin gyi rang bzhin nyid/_/
english: like the intrinsic nature of clouds in space

wylie: rlung gis gtor ba ci bzhin du/_/
english: being scattered by wind,

wylie: dum bu dum bus las snang ston/_/
english: reveals karmic appearances piece by piece.

wylie: de las lus ngag yid gsum la/_/
english: From this, through maturing into body, speech, and mental faculty,

wylie: smin pas las kyi rnam par ston/_/
english: the forms of karma are revealed.

wylie: 'byung ba sa chu me rlung gis/_/
english: Through the elements—earth, water, fire, and wind—

wylie: lus su rdzogs pa rlung gi las/_/
english: completion as a body is wind's activity.

wylie: khyab byed sems can thams cad la/_/
english: Pervading: all sentient beings,

wylie: 'byung bzhi'i lus las ma 'das pas/_/
english: because they do not go beyond a body of four elements,

wylie: so so'i las kyi sdebs su'o/_/
english: are in their respective combinations of karma.

wylie: tshul ni gzugs su grub pa dang /_/
english: Manner: being established as form,

wylie: de yi las kyi snga phyi las/_/
english: from the earlier and later aspects of its karma,

wylie: so sor blangs te myong bar 'gyur/_/
english: each takes up and experiences [them]. [N-169]

wylie: dbang po gsum ni rab 'bring tha/_/
english: The three faculties are superior, middling, and inferior.

wylie: des ni theg gsum 'du shes bral/
english: Through these, the three vehicles are free from perception. [N-169]

wylie: _de las gsum gsum rab phye bas/_/
english: Thoroughly dividing each into three,

wylie: dgu ste theg dgu dbang po'i gnad/_/
english: there are nine: the faculties' crucial point of the nine vehicles.

wylie: de las gnyis su rab phyes te/_/
english: From these, thoroughly dividing into two,

wylie: dgu phrag gnyis te snang ba'i cha/_/
english: there are two sets of nine: aspects of appearance.

wylie: gzhi la gsum bzhag nyer gcig gis/_/
english: Placing three in the Ground, through twenty-one,

wylie: snang ba nyer gcig rdzogs pa'o/_/
english: the twenty-one appearances are complete. [N-169]

wylie: dris lan dgu pa nang don drug bstan pa/
english: [Source annotation: The ninth reply is taught in six inner points.]

wylie: _tshig gi 'jug pa 'di lta ste/
english: The entry of words is like this:

wylie: tshangs pa khyab 'jug brgya byin dang /_/
english: Brahmā, the All-Pervader, and the Hundred-Giver;

wylie: mkha' lding dbang phyug drag po dang*/_/
english: the Sky-Soarer, the Powerful Lord, and the Fierce One;

wylie: so so'i sgra dang lha yi skad/_/
english: their respective sounds and the voices of gods.

wylie: gnas gzhan brtsis pas tshig la 'jug_/
english: By reckoning other places, one enters words. [N-170]

wylie: tshangs pas tshigs bcad dang po dang*/_/
english: For Brahmā, the first verse,

wylie: phyed rdzogs gnas gzhan brgyad du 'gyur/_/
english: half complete, becomes eight other places.

wylie: dbang phyug gis ni tshigs bcad dgu/_/
english: For the Powerful Lord, nine verses;

wylie: de yi gnas kyi phyed gnyis 'gyur/_/
english: two halves of their places result.

wylie: khyab 'jug gis ni stong gnyis la/_/
english: For the All-Pervader, in two thousand,

wylie: gnas la dbang pas gcig rdzogs pa'o/_/
english: through mastery of the places, one is complete. [N-170]

wylie: brgya byin gyis ni tshigs bcad lnga/_/
english: For the Hundred-Giver, five verses;

wylie: sgra yi bzlog pas gsum gnyis rdzogs/_/
english: through reversing sound, three and two are complete.

wylie: mkha' lding tshigs bcad drug gis kyang /_/
english: For the Sky-Soarer, through six verses,

wylie: rtags phye bas ni bdun gnyis la'o/_/
english: distinguishing signs: seven and two.

wylie: drag pos 'jug pa gsum sum cu yang byung gnyis la/_/
english: For the Fierce One, entry is in three and two. [Source variant: ‘Thirty also occurs.’] [N-170]

wylie: rtags bkod las kyi bdun brgya bzhi yang bzhi'o/_/
english: The activity of arranging signs: seven and four. [Source variant: ‘Four hundred also.’] [N-170]

wylie: so so'i sgra ni gnas pa dang*/_/
english: Their respective sounds, from abiding,

wylie: 'jug dang 'byung ba ldog pa las/_/
english: entering, arising, and reversing,

wylie: dus la brten pas lnga ldan rdzogs/_/
english: relying on time, are complete with five.

wylie: lha yi skad ni stong phrag drug_/
english: The voices of gods number six thousand.

wylie: yan lag spras pas de nyis 'gyur/_/
english: Adorning them with branches doubles that.

wylie: gnas gzhan rtsa ba brtse ba bzhi yang gzhi dag las/_/
english: From the root foundation of other places—[Source variant: ‘brtse ba bzhi also’; wording unresolved.] [N-170]

wylie: tshig la rtog pas gnas brgya brgyad kyang gnyis/_/
english: examining words: one hundred and two places. [Source variant: ‘Eight also.’] [N-170]

wylie: de las spros pas spros pas brgya gya bzhi yang bzhi brgya bzhi/_/
english: Extending from that: four hundred and four. [Source variant: ‘Extending: one hundred and eighty-four also.’] [N-170]

wylie: khyad par nges pa'i nges par de bcur yang rtsis bcur 'gyur/_/
english: The calculation of definite particulars becomes ten. [Source variant: ‘Definitely, that becomes ten also.’] [N-170]

wylie: de dag rab tu sbyor shes pas/_/
english: By knowing how to combine these thoroughly,

wylie: tshigs las dbang ste smra ba'i rgyal/_/
english: one gains mastery through verses and becomes a king of speech.

wylie: des ni sbyor mchog nges 'grub pa'o/_/
english: Through this, the supreme combination is definitely accomplished. [N-170]

wylie: dris lan bcu pa nang don dgu bstan pa'o/_/
english: [Source annotation: The tenth reply is taught in nine inner points.]

wylie: blo dang shes pa zhes bya ba/_/
english: What are called conceptual mind and knowing:

wylie: sems dang yid dang 'gyu ba dang*/_/
english: ordinary mind, mental faculty, movement,

wylie: 'phro dang rgod dang rengs pa dang*/_/
english: proliferation, agitation, rigidity,

wylie: yul dang 'dzin dang zhen pa'o/_/
english: object, apprehending subject, and clinging.

wylie: sems ni dag dang ma dag pa'i/_/
english: Ordinary mind: the pure and impure

wylie: khams gsum po yang sangs rgyas 'jug_/
english: three realms, too, enter buddhahood. [N-171]

wylie: yid ni ngo bo nges tshig dang /
english: Mental faculty is known through essence, word explanation,

wylie: dbye ba dag gis shes par 'gyur/_/
english: and subdivisions.

wylie: 'gyu ba dran dang snang ba'i cha/_/
english: Movement: portions of mindfulness and appearance,

wylie: brtags pa las ni blo 'gyur ro/_/
english: through examination, become conceptual mind.

wylie: 'phro ba yul gyi las mtha' las/_/
english: Proliferation, from the culmination of activities toward objects,

wylie: blo dang shes pa'i rtsal du snang*/_/
english: appears as the expressiveness of conceptual mind and knowing.

wylie: rgod pa rlung gi byed pa'i las/_/
english: Agitation is the activity enacted by wind;

wylie: 'du byed blo dang shes pa'i brda'o/_/
english: formations are a symbol of conceptual mind and knowing.

wylie: rengs pa nyon mongs gsum dag las/_/
english: Rigidity, from three afflictions,

wylie: blo zhes 'gyur dang shes pas gcod/_/
english: changes into what is called conceptual mind and is cut by knowing.

wylie: gnyis 'dus pa las shes khams gsum yang gsum 'byung*/_/
english: From the two gathering, three [kinds of] knowing arise. [Source variant: ‘Three realms also.’] [N-171]

wylie: yul ni sgo lnga'i snang cha las/_/
english: Objects: from the apparent aspects of the five doors,

wylie: blo dang shes pa'i 'jug cha byung*/_/
english: the entry portions of conceptual mind and knowing arise.

wylie: 'dzin pa mig la sogs pa yis/_/
english: The apprehending subject: through eyes and so forth,

wylie: de dang de la blo shes dngos/_/
english: conceptual mind and knowing are actual in each respective [object].

wylie: zhen pa blo yi rtogs tshad bzhi/_/
english: Clinging: conceptual mind has four measures of realization;

wylie: shes pa'i tshad las brgyad du 'gyur/_/
english: through the measures of knowing, these become eight.

wylie: de las 'byung bas 'dzin chags so/_/
english: Arising from this, there are holding and attachment. [N-171]

wylie: dris lan bcu gcig pa/
english: [Source heading: Eleventh reply.]

wylie: de ltar snang cha'i byed pa las/_/
english: Thus, from the agency of apparent aspects,

wylie: gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis su shar/_/
english: apprehended object and apprehending subject arise as two.

wylie: gzung ba yul la 'dzin pa sems/_/
english: The apprehended object is the object; the apprehending subject is ordinary mind.

wylie: yul sems 'dus pas dug gsum mo/_/
english: Object and ordinary mind gathered together are the three poisons.

wylie: yul gnad dbang la dbang gnad sems/_/
english: The object's crucial point is in the faculties; the faculties' crucial point is ordinary mind.

wylie: sems gnad mig la mig gnad rtsa/_/
english: Ordinary mind's crucial point is in the eyes; the eyes' crucial point is the channels.

wylie: des na lus kyi 'dug stangs la/_/
english: Therefore, through bodily posture,

wylie: bag chags lus kyi 'brel chod dang /_/
english: the connection of habitual tendencies with the body is cut,

wylie: sangs rgyas dgongs pa rdzogs pa'o/_/
english: and the buddhas' enlightened intent is complete.

wylie: rtsa ni rten 'brel 'khor lo yis/_/
english: The channels, through the wheel of dependent connections,

wylie: btsal zhing gzung dang spel ba'i gnas/_/
english: are the place of seeking, holding, and increasing—

wylie: rnal 'byor pa yi yan lag go/_/
english: the yogin's branches. [N-172]

wylie: dris lan bcu gnyis pa/
english: [Source heading: Twelfth reply.]

wylie: ngo bo ka dag ye shes las/_/
english: From essence as primordial purity and primordial knowing,

wylie: ma rig pa zhes srid ming med/_/
english: there is no possible name ‘ignorance.’

wylie: gcig dang gnyis kyi grangs med pa'o/_/
english: There is no count of one and two. [N-173]

wylie: brtags pas yod med grub pa med/_/
english: On examination, neither existence nor nonexistence is established.

wylie: gang du ma phye chos nyid las/_/
english: In the nature of phenomena, undivided anywhere,

wylie: ye shes tsam du'ang grub pa med/_/
english: not even a mere primordial knowing is established.

wylie: tshig med brjod las grub pa med/_/
english: Without phrases, nothing is established through expression. [N-174]

wylie: mtha' la mi gnas rang rig dag_/
english: Pure self-awareness does not abide at an extreme;

wylie: gzung 'dzin ming gi mtha' zad pa'o/_/
english: the limits of the names ‘apprehended object and apprehending subject’ are exhausted.

wylie: rgyu med rkyen gyi grangs med la/_/
english: There is no cause, nor any number of conditions;

wylie: gnyis snang yul dang yul can med/_/
english: there is no dual appearance, object, or possessor of an object.

wylie: mtshan nyid gang du'ang phye ba med/_/
english: No characteristic is differentiated anywhere;

wylie: yul rkyen rags pa rang zad pa'o/_/
english: coarse objects and conditions are self-exhausted.

wylie: ye nas med pas dag pas dag_/
english: Absent from the beginning, pure through purity,

wylie: 'khrul rtog 'gags pas cir mi mdzad/_/
english: with deluded conceptual thought ceased, it does not enact anything.

wylie: ma skyes pas na 'gag stong ngo*/_/
english: Since it has not arisen, cessation is empty. [N-174]

wylie: dris lan bcu gsum pa/
english: [Source heading: Thirteenth reply.]

wylie: rang bzhin lhun grub ye shes zhes/_/
english: What is called primordial knowing of intrinsic nature's spontaneous presence

wylie: mi skye mi 'gag cir mi dgongs/_/
english: does not arise, does not cease, and directs enlightened intent toward nothing,

wylie: yul dag nges pa med phyir ro/_/
english: because no object is fixed. [N-175]

wylie: rtsal dang yon tan 'gag med pas/_/
english: Since expressiveness and qualities do not cease,

wylie: rol pa tsam du snang ba las/_/
english: it appears merely as play:

wylie: sna tshogs rdzogs pa'i gzhi ma'o/_/
english: the foundation in which diversity is complete. [N-175]

wylie: med phyir snang la snang phyir stong /_/
english: Because it does not exist, it appears; because it appears, it is empty.

wylie: snang stong 'jug pa'i yan lag can/_/
english: It has the subsidiary aspects of appearance and emptiness entering together;

wylie: sangs rgyas sems can dag yul lo/_/
english: it is the pure domain of buddhas and sentient beings.

wylie: 'di ltar gzhi zhes mngon par gnas/_/
english: Thus it manifestly abides as what is called ‘the Ground.’

wylie: rang bzhin tsam du gnas pa las/_/
english: Abiding merely as intrinsic nature,

wylie: ngo bo'i cha nas brtags pas stong*/_/
english: it is empty when examined from the aspect of essence.

wylie: yan lag spros phyir mkhyen pa rdzogs/_/
english: Because its subsidiary aspects unfold, knowing is complete.

wylie: rang gnas lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/_/
english: Since it abides of itself in spontaneous presence,

wylie: 'di la spang blang gnyis med pa'o/_/
english: rejecting and accepting, the two, are absent here. [N-175]

wylie: dris lan bcu bzhi pa/
english: [Source heading: Fourteenth reply.]

wylie: thugs rje kun khyab ye shes las/_/
english: From primordial knowing of all-pervading compassionate responsiveness,

wylie: mi 'dzad sna tshogs 'char ba'i sgo/_/
english: the inexhaustible gates of diverse arising

wylie: 'dzad pa ltar snang ngo bor rdzogs/_/
english: are complete in essence, though appearing to be exhausted. [N-176]

wylie: chos sku stong pa'i rang bzhin las/_/
english: From the empty intrinsic nature of the dharma embodiment,

wylie: ye shes mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i cha/_/
english: the aspect of primordial knowing whose knowing is complete

wylie: thugs kyis sems can rnams la 'char/_/
english: arises for sentient beings through awakened mind.

wylie: de med 'khor 'das lte chad pas/_/
english: Without that, the central connection of samsara and nirvana would be severed;

wylie: _mkhyen pas rig cing gsal ba'o/_/
english: through knowing, there is awareness and clarity. [N-176]

wylie: rang rig gsal ba'i bdag nyid las/_/
english: From the very identity of clear self-awareness,

wylie: rang bzhin shugs kyis thugs rje nyid/_/
english: through the force of intrinsic nature, compassionate responsiveness itself

wylie: ma 'gags 'gag pa med pa'o/_/
english: has not ceased and does not cease.

wylie: 'byung ba dag pa'i cha nas ni/_/
english: From the pure aspect of the elements,

wylie: las su med pa gcig rdzogs pa'o/_/
english: the one that is not an activity is complete. [N-176]

wylie: nyi ma las ni 'od bzhin du/_/
english: Like light from the sun,

wylie: rang chas sgrib pa med pa'o/_/
english: it is inherent and unobscured.

wylie: dris lan bco lnga pa/
english: [Source heading: Fifteenth reply.]

wylie: de las mtshan nyid 'dzin pa yi/_/
english: Then I shall explain the characteristic-holding

wylie: longs sku'i ye shes bshad par bya'o/_/
english: primordial knowing of the complete enjoyment embodiment.

wylie: me long ye shes gzugs can gsal/_/
english: Mirror-like primordial knowing makes forms clear;

wylie: dbyibs dang kha dog snang cha rdzogs/_/
english: the appearance aspects of shape and color are complete. [N-177]

wylie: dkar po dri ma dag phyir ro/_/
english: It is white because stains are purified.

wylie: rang chas snang ste 'khor 'das sbyor/_/
english: Appearing inherently, it joins samsara and nirvana.

wylie: chos rnams kun gyi gzugs mthong bas/_/
english: Because it sees the forms of all phenomena,

wylie: rang gis ye shes zhes bya'o/_/
english: it is called ‘primordial knowing through itself.’ [N-177]

wylie: gsal zhing stong la stong par grol/_/
english: Clear and empty, it is liberated into emptiness;

wylie: grol 'dzin mtha' yi rtog pa zad/_/
english: conceptual thought at the limits of liberation and grasping is exhausted.

wylie: gzhan med grol gzhi rdzogs pa'o/_/
