english: With no other, the Ground of liberation is complete.

wylie: dris lan bcu drug pa/
english: [Source heading: Sixteenth reply.]

wylie: mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba ni/_/
english: What is called ‘evenness’

wylie: mnyam rgyu gnyis la mnyam rkyen gsum/_/
english: is through two causes of evenness, three conditions of evenness,

wylie: mnyam pa'i dus dang tshad kyis so/_/
english: and the time and measure of evenness.

wylie: 'di la gnyis med rig dang bral/_/
english: Here there is no duality, and it is free from awareness. [N-177]

wylie: mi phyed mi 'byed rang gnas nyid/_/
english: Neither divided nor dividing, it abides of itself.

wylie: mnyam pa zhes bya chos nyid la/_/
english: What is called ‘even’ is, in the nature of phenomena,

wylie: zug rngu spros pa bral ba'o/_/
english: freedom from the elaborations of pain.

wylie: nyid ces bcos zhing rtsol bsgrub med/_/
english: ‘-ness’ means there is no contrivance or accomplishment through effort.

wylie: rang bzhin gnas pa ngo bo stong /_/
english: Intrinsic nature abides; essence is empty.

wylie: sems nyid rtog pa kun zad pa'o/_/
english: In the nature of ordinary mind, all conceptual thought is exhausted.

wylie: ye shes zhes bya gnas pa la/_/
english: What is called ‘primordial knowing’ abides;

wylie: de yi mtshan nyid rtogs pa yis/_/
english: through realizing its characteristics,

wylie: 'khor 'das gnyis la mi gnas pa'o/_/
english: one does not abide in either samsara or nirvana. [N-177]

wylie: dris lan bcu bdun pa/
english: [Source heading: Seventeenth reply.]

wylie: so sor rtogs pa dbang po'i rigs/_/
english: Discriminating [primordial knowing]: the types of faculty,

wylie: gang la snang ba de yi chos/_/
english: whatever appears to them, and the phenomena of that appearance

wylie: rim pa so sor gsal ba'o/_/
english: are each clear in sequence. [N-177]

wylie: brtag pa rang snang dag nas ni/_/
english: When the self-appearance of examination is purified,

wylie: rig pa yul du gyur pa nyid/_/
english: awareness itself becomes the object.

wylie: so so zhes bya bye brag las/_/
english: What is called ‘individually’ arises from distinctions

wylie: gnyen po'i tshul du byung ba ste/_/
english: in the manner of an antidote.

wylie: rtogs pa zhes ni mtshan nyid mthong /_/
english: What is called ‘realization’ is seeing the characteristics,

wylie: rang snang 'phel dang bcas pa'o/_/
english: together with the increase of self-appearance.

wylie: ye shes thog mar byung ba las/_/
english: Primordial knowing arises at the beginning;

wylie: shes pas nyon mongs skyon dag go/_/
english: through knowing, the faults of afflictions are purified. [N-177]

wylie: dris lan bco brgyad pa/
english: [Source heading: Eighteenth reply.]

wylie: bya ba grub pa zhes bya ba/_/
english: What is called ‘doing accomplished’:

wylie: 'bad cing rtsol ba rang 'gags nas/_/
english: when striving and effort have self-ceased,

wylie: chos kun rang bzhag rang grol lo/_/
english: all phenomena rest of themselves and are self-liberated.

wylie: rang grol rdzogs pa'i gzhi snang las/_/
english: From ground-appearance in which self-liberation is complete,

wylie: cha phra rdul bral dri med thob/_/
english: the subtle aspect attains freedom from particles and stains.

wylie: rtog dpyod yul las 'das pa ste/_/
english: Beyond the object of conceptual thought and examination,

wylie: gang gis ma phye chos nyid do/_/
english: it is the nature of phenomena, divided by no one.

wylie: rang bzhin rdzogs pas snang mtha' zad/_/
english: Intrinsic nature being complete, the limits of appearance are exhausted.

wylie: cig char rtogs pa bya ba'o/_/
english: Simultaneous realization is ‘doing.’

wylie: grub pas 'dod pa bral ba la//
english: Through being ‘accomplished,’ desire is absent;

wylie: bskyar dang ldog pa med pa'o/_/
english: there is neither repetition nor reversal.

wylie: ye ni gnas pa'i don nyid la/_/
english: ‘Primordial’ has the meaning of abiding;

wylie: shes pas mngon du gyur nas ni/_/
english: through ‘knowing,’ it becomes manifest,

wylie: chos rnams zad pa'i sar phyin pa'o/_/
english: and one reaches the place where phenomena are exhausted. [N-177]

wylie: dris lan bcu dgu pa/
english: [Source heading: Nineteenth reply.]

wylie: _chos kyi dbyings ni yangs pa la/_/
english: The basic space of phenomena is vast;

wylie: mtha' dang dbus su _mi dmigs pas/_/
english: no edge or center is an object of focus.

wylie: grol gzhi chos nyid dag pa la/_/
english: In the pure nature of phenomena, the Ground of liberation,

wylie: chos ni spyod par byed pa las/_/
english: ‘phenomena’ means engaging in activity:

wylie: 'das dang 'jig rten bya ba byed/_/
english: doing the doings of the transcendent and the world.

wylie: rang bzhin gsal zhing dwangs pa'o/_/
english: Intrinsic nature is clear and limpid.

wylie: dbyings ni go skabs 'byed pa las/_/
english: ‘Basic space’ opens room;

wylie: rang byung chen po'i gnas pa'o/_/
english: it is great naturally arisen abiding.

wylie: ye ni gnas pa'i bdag nyid la/_/
english: ‘Primordial’ is the very identity of abiding,

wylie: thog ma nas ni bcos pa med/_/
english: uncontrived from the beginning.

wylie: shes pas 'khor 'das gnyis las grol/_/
english: Through ‘knowing,’ one is liberated from both samsara and nirvana.

wylie: rang snang rdzogs pa'i dgongs pa'o/_/
english: This is enlightened intent in which self-appearance is complete. [N-177]

wylie: dris lan nyi shu pa/
english: [Source heading: Twentieth reply.]

wylie: shes pas bsdus pa'i ye shes ni/_/
english: Primordial knowing encompassed by knowing

wylie: sangs rgyas sems can thams cad la/_/
english: pervades all buddhas and sentient beings

wylie: dbyer med rang bzhin med par khyab/_/
english: indivisibly, without intrinsic nature.

wylie: de yang sangs rgyas rnam dag rdzogs/_/
english: In buddhas it is completely pure;

wylie: dri med rdul dang bral bar gnas/_/
english: it abides unstained and free from particles.

wylie: sems can rigs drug snang cha la/_/
english: In the appearance aspect of sentient beings of the six classes,

wylie: so so'i rgyud la gnas pa de/_/
english: it abides in each one's continuum:

wylie: lha rnams rang gsal rdzogs pa ste/_/
english: in gods, it is complete in its own clarity;

wylie: lha min rnams la phra zhing 'khyug_/
english: in asuras, subtle and flashing;

wylie: mi rnams rang gsal zlum po nyid/_/
english: in humans, round and clear of itself;

wylie: byol song rnams la nang du gsal/_/
english: in animals, clear within;

wylie: yi dwags rnams la phra ba la/_/
english: in hungry ghosts, subtle;

wylie: dmyal bar rang snang rdzogs pa'o/_/
english: in hell, complete as self-appearance. [N-178]

wylie: shes pas rig cing rang sa gsal/_/
english: Through ‘knowing,’ there is awareness, clear in its own place.

wylie: bsdus pas ngo bo rang rig pa/_/
english: Through ‘encompassed,’ essence is self-awareness.

wylie: ye ni gsal zhing mkhyen rig cha/_/
english: ‘Primordial’ is the clear aspect of knowing and awareness;

wylie: shes pa rang grol dkyil 'khor gcig_/
english: ‘knowing’ is self-liberation, a single mandala. [N-178]

wylie: dris lan nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-first reply.]

wylie: _shes byas bsdus pa'i ye shes ni/_/
english: Primordial knowing encompassed by objects of knowledge

wylie: rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya'o/_/
english: is to be known in two aspects.

wylie: de la shes bya ji snyed bshad/_/
english: Of these, I shall explain objects of knowledge in their multiplicity.

wylie: 'dis ni gdul bya'i bsam pa mkhyen/_/
english: Through this, the intentions of those to be trained are known.

wylie: gzhan don khong du chud pa yis/_/
english: Through understanding others' benefit,

wylie: chos rnams rang bzhin shes pa'o/_/
english: one knows the intrinsic nature of phenomena.

wylie: ji zhes bya ba gnas lugs la/_/
english: ‘Whatever’ refers to the natural state;

wylie: snyed pas ma lus rdzogs par byas/_/
english: ‘multiplicity’ completes everything without remainder.

wylie: ye ni sems can kun don la/_/
english: ‘Primordial’ concerns the benefit of all sentient beings;

wylie: shes pas khams gsum dong nas 'byin/_/
english: through ‘knowing,’ the three realms are drawn out from their depths. [N-178]

wylie: sprul pa'i sku yi mkhyen pa'i cha/_/
english: The knowing aspect of the emanation embodiment

wylie: rang snang ngo la rdzogs pa'o/_/
english: is complete in the identity of self-appearance.

wylie: dris lan nyer gnyis pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-second reply.]

wylie: ji lta mkhyen pa'i ye shes bshad/_/
english: I shall explain the primordial knowing that knows how [things are].

wylie: snang chas brjod gzhi bral ba la/_/
english: The appearance aspect is free from a basis for expression;

wylie: rang snang dag pa'i gzugs brnyan gsal/_/
english: the reflection of pure self-appearance is clear.

wylie: dngos po'i gnas lugs mkhyen pa las/_/
english: Through knowing the natural state of things,

wylie: rang don rtogs pas 'khrul rgyun zad/_/
english: and realizing one's own benefit, the flow of delusion is exhausted.

wylie: ji zhes bya ba gnas lugs las/_/
english: ‘How’ refers to the natural state;

wylie: lta ba yengs pa med par spyod/_/
english: ‘view’ engages without distraction. [N-178]

wylie: mkhyen pa 'gag pa med phyir rdzogs/_/
english: ‘Knowing’ is complete because it does not cease.

wylie: ye ni lam du gyur pa la/_/
english: ‘Primordial’ has become the path;

wylie: shes pa tshad du phyin pa'o/_/
english: ‘knowing’ has reached its measure.

wylie: ma bcos rang grol chen po yi/_/
english: There is no movement from the Ground

wylie: gzhi la g.yo ba med pa'o/_/
english: of great uncontrived self-liberation. [N-178]

wylie: dris lan nyer gsum pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-third reply.]

wylie: ye shes rnams kyi bsdom pa ni/_/
english: The gathering of primordial knowings

wylie: mtshan nyid khyab cing gsal ba la/_/
english: has pervasive and clear characteristics;

wylie: rang bzhin gsal stong dbyer mi phyed/_/
english: intrinsic nature is clarity-emptiness, indivisible,

wylie: ngo bo gang du'ang phye ba med/_/
english: and essence is not differentiated anywhere.

wylie: dbye ba bzhi yis bsdus pa las/_/
english: Gathered into four divisions,

wylie: rtog 'jug thabs kyi bye brag ston/
english: it shows distinctions in the methods by which conceptual thought enters.

wylie: _gzhi dang snying po me tog gis/_/
english: With Ground, core, and flowers,

wylie: mdzes shing yang dag rdzogs pa nyid/_/
english: it is beautiful and truly complete. [N-179]

wylie: khyab dang khyab byed tshul gyi yang*/_/
english: Through the manner of pervasion and that which pervades,

wylie: rang snang gzhi la ston pa dang /_/
english: it shows self-appearance in the Ground

wylie: rnam rtog zad par byed pa'o/_/
english: and exhausts differentiating conceptualization.

wylie: khyad par 'dus pa rnams phye ba/_/
english: Distinguishing the gathered special features,

wylie: rtog bral chos nyid rang gdangs las/_/
english: from the self-radiance of the nature of phenomena, free from conceptual thought,

wylie: dmigs med ye shes snang ba 'byung /_/
english: there arises an appearance of primordial knowing without an object of focus.

wylie: de la rnal 'byor sems rdzogs so/_/
english: There the yogin's ordinary mind is complete.

wylie: yang dag 'dus pa'i yan lag tu/_/
english: As a subsidiary aspect of the true gathering,

wylie: ye shes gnad ni mig las 'byung /_/
english: the crucial point of primordial knowing arises from the eyes.

wylie: mig gi gzigs stangs shes pa yis/_/
english: Through knowing the eyes' gaze,

wylie: chos kyi dbyings dang lhan cig spyod/_/
english: one engages together with the basic space of phenomena.

wylie: khams gsum po ni zad bya'i phyir/_/
english: In order to exhaust the three realms,

wylie: mig gi phugs na 'phar ba'i rtsa/_/
english: the pulsating channel behind the eyes

wylie: gyen la bzlog pas ye shes 'bebs/_/
english: is turned upward, bringing down primordial knowing. [N-179]

wylie: gnad las byung ba'i ye shes gang*/_/
english: Whatever primordial knowing arises from the crucial point,

wylie: rig ldan chos nyid ci bzhin du/_/
english: just as the nature of phenomena endowed with awareness,

wylie: rtog pa kun las rnam grol bas/_/
english: is completely liberated from all conceptual thought:

wylie: dbyings las byung ba'i ye shes so/_/
english: it is primordial knowing arising from basic space.

wylie: mig gi gnad ni steng dang 'og_/
english: The crucial points of the eyes are above and below;

wylie: mkhas pas rtsol ba'i sna gang 'gyur/_/
english: whichever avenue of effort the adept employs,

wylie: kun 'dus ye shes snang ba'o/_/
english: there is the appearance of all-gathering primordial knowing. [N-179]

wylie: yang na mig gi ye shes la/_/
english: Alternatively, in the primordial knowing of the eyes,

wylie: kha dog lnga yi rab phye bas/_/
english: through clearly distinguishing the five colors,

wylie: dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i gzugs 'dra ba/_/
english: there is a likeness of the form of a complete mandala.

wylie: 'di las 'byung ba'i nyams myong ni/_/
english: The experiential acquaintance arising from this

wylie: gang gis brjod par mi nus pa'i/_/
english: cannot be expressed by anyone—

wylie: e ma ngo mtshar che ba nyid/_/
english: Ema! Such great wonder!—

wylie: yon tan rdzogs pa'i snang ba'o/_/
english: an appearance complete in qualities.

wylie: khyab cing cha phra ye shes las/_/
english: From pervasive primordial knowing, subtle in aspect,

wylie: mngon sum pas dang lam du'o/_/
english: it is through direct perception and on the path. [N-179]

wylie: gzhan yang rab tu bshad bya ba/_/
english: Furthermore, this is to be explained:

wylie: rnam rtog 'dus pa'i dran bsam las/_/
english: from mindfulness and reflection in which differentiating conceptualization gathers,

wylie: chos kyi sku yang gzugs su 'gyur/_/
english: even the dharma embodiment becomes form. [N-180]

wylie: gal te khams gsum 'das 'dod pas/_/
english: One who wishes to go beyond the three realms,

wylie: dam pa'i ye shes gnad che bas/_/
english: through the great crucial point of sacred primordial knowing,

wylie: so so'i rlung gi dbugs su brtags/_/
english: examines the respective winds as breaths.

wylie: chos kun dri ma rang dag las/_/
english: From the self-purification of stains in all phenomena,

wylie: sku gsum lus kyi dbus su rdzogs/_/
english: the three embodiments are complete in the center of the body.

wylie: 'di la rtog pa ci yi phyir/_/
english: Why is there conceptual thought concerning this?

wylie: dran bsam 'dus pa'i rang bzhin las/_/
english: From the intrinsic nature of gathered mindfulness and reflection,

wylie: chos kyi sku yang 'khor bar 'gyur/_/
english: even the dharma embodiment becomes samsara. [N-180]

wylie: gang tshe 'khor ba'i mtha' zad pas/_/
english: When the limits of samsara are exhausted,

wylie: byas pa med par rang sar grol/_/
english: one is liberated in one's own place without anything being done.

wylie: grol ba 'di la ci yang med/_/
english: In this liberation there is nothing at all.

wylie: med phyir chos nyid dngos po min/_/
english: Because there is nothing, the nature of phenomena is not a thing.

wylie: ye shes rdzogs pas 'khrul rgyun chad/_/
english: Primordial knowing being complete, the flow of delusion is cut;

wylie: chad pas 'gro dang 'ong ba zad/_/
english: being cut, going and coming are exhausted.

wylie: zad phyir stong pa'i ye shes so/_/
english: Because they are exhausted, it is empty primordial knowing.

wylie: sku gsum ye shes ma 'gags pas/_/
english: Since the primordial knowing of the three embodiments has not ceased,

wylie: khams gsum po yang yod pa stong /_/
english: the existence of the three realms is empty.

wylie: 'gro zhing 'byung ba rnyed pa yis/_/
english: By finding going and arising,

wylie: dngos po dag pas gzugs zad pa'o/_/
english: things being pure, form is exhausted. [N-180]

wylie: gzhan yang snang ba'i ye shes bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the primordial knowing of appearance.

wylie: sa chu me rlung nam mkha' las/_/
english: From earth, water, fire, wind, and space,

wylie: ye shes snang ba ngo mtshar bas/_/
english: through the wonder of primordial knowing's appearance,

wylie: bcom ldan mgon po rig med pa'o/_/
english: the blessed protector is without awareness. [N-181]

wylie: brtags pas ma rnyed ye shes ni/_/
english: Primordial knowing, not found on examination,

wylie: khams gsum gdar sha chod pa las/_/
english: decisively resolves the three realms

wylie: sgo lnga'i zhen rgyun gcod pa'o/_/
english: and cuts the flow of clinging at the five gates.

wylie: zla dang nor bu mar gar 'od/_/
english: The moon, a jewel, ‘mar gar,’ and light—

wylie: gang gis 'dzin par 'dod pa yi/_/
english: one who wishes to hold these

wylie: 'dzin byung sku yi snang ba bzung*/_/
english: holds the appearance of embodiment arising from holding. [N-181]

wylie: yang ni rdzogs pa chen po yi/_/
english: Then, through knowing the crucial point

wylie: gnad shes pa las ye shes ni/_/
english: of the Great Perfection, primordial knowing

wylie: bya bral nam mkha' ji bzhin du/_/
english: is free from doing, just like space.

wylie: kun tu rtogs pas sngo dang bral/_/
english: Through complete realization, it is free from blue. [N-181]

wylie: ngo mtshar rmad byung ye shes ni/_/
english: Wondrous, marvelous primordial knowing

wylie: sngon med phyis med gdod nas med/_/
english: was absent before, is absent afterward, and absent from the beginning.

wylie: da lta rnam rtog yul las 'das/_/
english: Now it is beyond the object of differentiating conceptualization:

wylie: mtha' bral stong pa'i rang bzhin no/_/
english: an empty intrinsic nature free from extremes.

wylie: tshig 'das blo bral ngo bos stong*/_/
english: Beyond phrases, free from the conceptual mind, empty in essence,

wylie: rang bzhin gang du ma phye bas/_/
english: its intrinsic nature not differentiated anywhere,

wylie: thugs rje mdzad pa mi snang ngo*/_/
english: the deeds of compassionate responsiveness do not appear. [N-181]

wylie: ye shes snang ba gsum pa las/_/
english: From the third appearance of primordial knowing,

wylie: yid 'byung shes rab 'khrul char bzung*/_/
english: discerning knowing arising from the mental faculty is held as an aspect of delusion. [N-181]

wylie: 'di la rnam par dmigs mtha' med/_/
english: Here there is no limit of differentiated focus.

wylie: med pa rmad byung rol pa las/_/
english: From the marvelous play of absence,

wylie: sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'bras bu rnyed/_/
english: the result of the buddhas is found.

wylie: phyi dang nang kun chos kyi dbyings/_/
english: Outside and inside are all the basic space of phenomena;

wylie: 'di la gang yang mi snang ngo*/_/
english: here nothing whatsoever appears.

wylie: gzhan yang yul gyi ye shes bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the primordial knowing of objects.

wylie: gzugs dang sgra yi bye brag las/_/
english: Through distinctions of form and sound,

wylie: bslab bya'i nyams kyang lngar 'gyur ro/_/
english: the experiences to be trained in become five.

wylie: shes pa'i nyams zad snang ba ste/_/
english: There is the appearance of the exhaustion of knowing's experience;

wylie: 'phel ston zla ba yar ngo bzhin/_/
english: increase is shown like the waxing moon.

wylie: snang ba re la nyams re 'ong /_/
english: With each appearance, an experience comes. [N-182]

wylie: drod dang tshad dang rtags las ni/_/
english: Through warmth, measure, and signs,

wylie: bden gnyis zung 'jug rtog mtha' zad/_/
english: the two truths enter in union, and the limits of conceptual thought are exhausted.

wylie: bya ba med pas mtshan nyid stong /_/
english: With no doing, characteristics are empty.

wylie: brjod gzhi 'gags pas mtha' mi gnas/_/
english: The basis of expression having ceased, one does not abide at an extreme.

wylie: zag pa zad phyir rdos bcas min/_/
english: Since outflows are exhausted, there is no material weight.

wylie: dran pa'i khong 'gag ngo bo gsal/_/
english: The interior of mindfulness ceases; essence is clear. [N-183]

wylie: gsal rig yul gyi mtha' mi rtog_/
english: Clear awareness does not conceptualize the limits of objects.

wylie: sgra bral yang dag tshig med phyir/_/
english: Free from words, truly without phrases,

wylie: ltos gzhi thams cad zad pa'o/_/
english: all bases of dependence are exhausted.

wylie: gzhan yang 'dod yon mngon par spyod/_/
english: Furthermore, one directly engages the desirable qualities.

wylie: gzugs kyis bslab pa gnyis dag ni/_/
english: The two trainings through form

wylie: dmigs pa'i rten dang dmigs med do/_/
english: are a support for focus and freedom from focus.

wylie: yid mthun las kyi khyad par gyis/_/
english: Through the special activity agreeable to the mental faculty,

wylie: sngon du bla ma mchod byas la/_/
english: first make offerings to the lama.

wylie: dbyibs la goms te kha dog la/_/
english: Become accustomed to shapes and then to colors;

wylie: goms par byas pas 'khrul snang 'gags/_/
english: through this familiarity, delusory appearance ceases.

wylie: sgra ni dmigs pa'i rten dag pas/_/
english: For sound, with a pure support for focus:

wylie: pi waM rdza rnga bum ldir dang /_/
english: piwaṃ, earthenware drum, resonant pot,

wylie: dra ba rgyud mang mdo gsum pa/_/
english: draba, the many-stringed instrument, the three-junctioned instrument,

wylie: har dang gling bu cha lang dang*/_/
english: har, flute, cymbals,

wylie: pheg rdob cang te'u dril bu sogs/_/
english: pheg, rdob, small hand drum, bell, and so forth—

wylie: so so'i sgra la rlung yang sbyar/_/
english: join wind to each respective sound. [N-184]

wylie: dri ni yid mthun dmigs rkyen gyis/_/
english: For smell, through a condition for focus agreeable to the mental faculty,

wylie: dad dang dad pa chen po dang /_/
english: faith and great faith,

wylie: mchog dang khyad par chen po yis/_/
english: the supreme and the greatly distinctive,

wylie: rnal 'byor pa yi bde chen sbyor/_/
english: join the yogin to great bliss. [N-184]

wylie: ro ni bu ram drug ldan dang*/_/
english: For taste, an adept combines cane sugar, that endowed with six [tastes],

wylie: rgun chang 'bras chang mkhas pas sbyar/_/
english: grape wine, and rice beer.

wylie: sdom ldan rim pa lnga shes pas/_/
english: Knowing the five stages endowed with restraint,

wylie: myang ba tsam gyis ye shes 'bar/_/
english: merely tasting makes primordial knowing blaze. [N-184]

wylie: reg ni yid mthun dmigs rten la/_/
english: For touch, with a support for focus agreeable to the mental faculty,

wylie: so so'i rig pa nyams myong sbyar/_/
english: join each awareness to experiential acquaintance.

wylie: shing lo g.yas 'khyil bskum dus la/_/
english: When a tree leaf curls rightward and contracts,

wylie: bslang ste reg pas sangs rgyas rtogs/_/
english: raise it: through touch, buddhahood is realized. [N-184]

wylie: chos ni bla ma'i lung dang bstun/_/
english: Concerning phenomena, accord with the lama's authoritative transmission.

wylie: gal te bsgom pa bzang po rtogs/_/
english: When excellent cultivation is realized,

wylie: 'di ltar brtsams pas lam du slong*/_/
english: practicing thus brings it onto the path,

wylie: khams gsum 'khrul 'khor rgyun chad do/_/
english: and the flow of the machinery of delusion in the three realms is cut.

wylie: gzhan yang ye shes snang ba ni/_/
english: Furthermore, the appearance of primordial knowing:

wylie: dri med dag pas dkar po las/_/
english: from the white of stainless purity,

wylie: yon tan rdzogs phyir snang ba'i gzugs/_/
english: because qualities are complete, the form of appearance

wylie: mi 'byed rdzogs pa'i gzugs skur 'gyur/_/
english: becomes the indivisible, complete form embodiment.

wylie: yon tan bskyed pa'i ser po las/_/
english: From the yellow that generates qualities,

wylie: gzhi dang 'byed pa dus mnyam pa'i/_/
english: in an activity in which the Ground and differentiation are simultaneous,

wylie: las su chos nyid ston par byed/_/
english: the nature of phenomena is shown. [N-185]

wylie: rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i dmar po las/_/
english: From the red of complete self-expressiveness,

wylie: rang bzhin dag pa'i dkyil dang 'khor/_/
english: the center and surrounding of pure intrinsic nature,

wylie: mu khyud ra ba rdzogs par ston/_/
english: the encircling bands and enclosure, are shown in completeness.

wylie: bya rtsal bral ba'i ljang gu las/_/
english: From the green free from doing-expressiveness,

wylie: phrin las dag pa'i sprul pa 'byung*/_/
english: emanations of pure enlightened activity arise.

wylie: mi 'gyur rdzogs pa'i mthing ga las/_/
english: From the blue of unchanging completeness,

wylie: mtha' dbus mi gnas khyab par stong /_/
english: not abiding at edge or center, it is pervasively empty.

wylie: rang bzhin dag pas sku gsum bzhi'o/_/
english: Through pure intrinsic nature, the embodiments are ‘three, four.’ [N-185]

wylie: zhes sgra thal 'gyur chen po chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba las/
english: Thus, from the Great All-Penetrating Word, Root of All Phenomena:

wylie: _ye shes bkod pa snang ba'i rtsa ba nges par 'byung ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o//_//
english: the third chapter, the Array of Primordial Knowing, in which the root of appearance definitely emerges.

wylie: de nas lha dbang dga' byed kyis/_/
english: Then the Lord of Gods, Maker of Joy,

wylie: ston pa khyab bdag chen po la/_/
english: asked the teacher, the great all-pervading lord,

wylie: chos nyid bkod pa'i rang bzhin zhus/_/
english: about the intrinsic nature of the Array of the Nature of Phenomena.

wylie: kye kye yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/_/
english: ‘Kye kye! Truly complete buddha,

wylie: bdag ni ye shes bkod pa las/_/
english: through the Array of Primordial Knowing,

wylie: 'khor ba'i las las dbugs phyung ste/_/
english: I have gained respite from the activities of samsara,

wylie: myang 'das lam la gzengs kyang bstod/_/
english: and been uplifted on the path of passing beyond sorrow. [Source variant: gzengs.] [N-186]

wylie: rang bzhin snang ba'i yul yang mthong /_/
english: I have also seen the object of intrinsic nature's appearance.

wylie: sangs rgyas dgongs pa'i gdeng rnyed kyang*/_/
english: Although I have gained confidence in the buddhas' enlightened intent,

wylie: ma 'ongs 'jug pa'i sems can rnams/_/
english: for sentient beings who will enter in the future,

wylie: rtog bral ye shes rdzogs don du/_/
english: so that primordial knowing free from conceptual thought may be complete,

wylie: chos nyid bkod pa mnyam par 'tshal/_/
english: I seek the Array of the Nature of Phenomena in evenness. [N-186]

wylie: gnas pa'i chos nyid gang la bgyi/_/
english: Where is the nature of phenomena of abiding to be applied?

wylie: 'gyu mtshams nyid kyi gnad de gang*/_/
english: What is the crucial point of the intervals of movement?

wylie: dus kyi chos nyid ci ltar dbye/_/
english: How is the nature of phenomena of time distinguished?

wylie: sangs rgyas chos nyid ci lta bu/_/
english: What is the nature of phenomena of buddhas like?

wylie: sems can dus na ci ltar gnas/_/
english: How does it abide at the time of sentient beings?

wylie: lus kyi gnad ni gang dang gang /_/
english: What are the crucial points of the body?

wylie: sgo nas ci ltar byung ba lags/_/
english: How does it emerge from the gates?

wylie: yul la snang ba'i mtshan nyid gang*/_/
english: What are the characteristics of appearing in the object?

wylie: de la ci yi snang bar 'gyur/_/
english: As what does it appear there? [N-186]

wylie: mthong nas gtan la ci yis dbab/_/
english: Having seen, by what is it decisively established?

wylie: phebs nas rdzogs pa'i tshad gang lags/_/
english: Having arrived, what is the measure of completeness?

wylie: rgyu 'bras chos nyid ci yis bsgrub/_/
english: By what is the nature of phenomena of cause and result accomplished?

wylie: rang sar dengs pa'i chos nyid gang /_/
english: What is the nature of phenomena that clears in its own place?

wylie: chos nyid nges pa'i tshig gang lags/_/
english: What are the definitive phrases of the nature of phenomena?

wylie: gnad kyi chos nyid gang dang gang*/_/
english: What are its crucial points?

wylie: 'byung dus gnad 'di ci yis bzung /_/
english: How is this crucial point of the time of arising held?

wylie: bar do'i chos nyid ci lta bu/_/
english: What is the nature of phenomena of the intermediate state like?

wylie: de yi mtshan nyid snang tshul ci/_/
english: How do its characteristics appear?

wylie: 'di dag sems can don du gsung /_/
english: Speak of these for the benefit of sentient beings.’

wylie: de nas ston pa rdo rje 'chang*/_/
english: Then, [the words of] the teacher Vajradhara,

wylie: rang bzhin dag pa'i nam mkha' las/_/
english: from the space of pure intrinsic nature—

wylie: sgra tshig spros pa 'di lta bu/_/
english: these elaborations of words and phrases—

wylie: brjod pa med pa'i gzhi la shar/_/
english: arose in the Ground free from expression. [N-186]

wylie: e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*/_/
english: ‘Ema! Marvelous wonder!

wylie: zhing khams gzhan du ma grags pa'i/_/
english: I shall teach an expression of wonder

wylie: ngo mtshar brjod pa bstan par bya'o/_/
english: unheard of in other fields.

wylie: _zhus don dang po/
english: [Source heading: First subject of inquiry.]

wylie: gnas pa'i chos nyid 'di lta ste/_/
english: The nature of phenomena of abiding is as follows:

wylie: gshis kyi gnas pas dge sdig bral/_/
english: abiding in its fundamental disposition, it is free from virtue and wrongdoing;

wylie: rgyu 'bras gnas pas ltos pa bral/_/
english: abiding as cause and result, it is free from dependence;

wylie: rkyen gyi gnas pas 'byung ba dag_/
english: abiding through conditions, the elements are pure—

wylie: 'pho zhing 'gyur ba ma yin no/_/
english: it does not shift or change. [N-187]

wylie: zhus don gnyis pa/
english: [Source heading: Second subject of inquiry.]

wylie: 'gyu mtshams chos nyid 'di lta bu/_/
english: The nature of phenomena of the intervals of movement is like this:

wylie: ngo mtshar che bas rab tu bshad/_/
english: I shall explain it fully as a great wonder.

wylie: rlung ni zhag gi rim pa yis/_/
english: Wind, according to the sequence of a day,

wylie: nyi khri dang ni gcig stong dang /_/
english: is reckoned as twenty thousand, one thousand,

wylie: drug brgya ru ni brtsis pa yis/_/
english: and six hundred;

wylie: zhag gcig la ni rlung rdzogs so/_/
english: the winds of one day are thereby complete.

wylie: ci ltar so so'i bye brag gis/_/
english: According to the particular distinctions,

wylie: chung ba rnams la drug cu lhag_/
english: for the young there are sixty extra;

wylie: rgas pa dag la chad pa yin/_/
english: for the old there is a shortfall.

wylie: 'byung ba snod kyi las kyis so/
english: This is through the activity of the elemental vessel. [N-188]

wylie: 'gyu ba'i rlung ni drug cu la/_/
english: Among sixty movements of wind,

wylie: phra 'gyur chos nyid rtsis kyis bzung*/_/
english: the subtle movement of the nature of phenomena is held through reckoning.

wylie: de phrag gnyis las rags pa ste/_/
english: From two such groups it is coarse;

wylie: de bsdoms gsum la sbom po nyid/_/
english: when these are gathered as three, it is gross.

wylie: de las gsum dbri mnyam pa'o/_/
english: Subtract three from that: it is even. [N-188]

wylie: mdor na 'gyu ba nyi shu'i bar/_/
english: In brief, within twenty movements,

wylie: chos nyid mnyam pa re re'o/_/
english: there is one evenness of the nature of phenomena.

wylie: zhus don gsum pa/
english: [Source heading: Third subject of inquiry.]

wylie: dus kyi chos nyid 'di lta ste/_/
english: The nature of phenomena of time is as follows:

wylie: phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang /_/
english: outer, inner, secret,

wylie: kho na nyid dang bzhi yin no/_/
english: and suchness—four.

wylie: phyi ni ston gyi gnyis pa las/_/
english: The outer is the second [month] of autumn,

wylie: dus kyi chos nyid gnas pa ston/_/
english: showing the abiding of the nature of phenomena of time.

wylie: nang ni skya rengs shar dus so/_/
english: The inner is the time when dawn breaks.

wylie: gsang ba gnyid dang rmi lam mo/_/
english: The secret is sleep and dreams.

wylie: kho na nyid ni rlung gis bzung /_/
english: Suchness is held through wind.

wylie: dus la phebs na rdzogs pa'o/_/
english: When the time is reached, it is complete. [N-188]

wylie: zhus don bzhi pa/
english: [Source heading: Fourth subject of inquiry.]

wylie: sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos nyid ni/_/
english: The nature of phenomena of buddhas:

wylie: ma phyes mi 'byed mnyam pa las/_/
english: undivided, not dividing, even—

wylie: sgra tshig ming du ga la srid/_/
english: how could words, phrases, and names exist there?

wylie: ltos gzhi rang dag 'khrul pa dag_/
english: The basis of dependence is self-purified, and delusion is purified.

wylie: 'khor 'das ming du ma grags so/_/
english: It is not known by the names samsara and nirvana.

wylie: ma byung ma skyes 'gag pa med/_/
english: Not having come about or arisen, it does not cease.

wylie: kun 'byung ye shes gang ma yin/_/
english: All-arising primordial knowing is not any [thing]. [N-187]

wylie: len pa med cing grol ba med/_/
english: There is no taking and no liberation.

wylie: rgyu rkyen bral ba'i skad cig las/_/
english: In a moment free from causes and conditions,

wylie: sangs rgyas sems can gzhi mar snang*/_/
english: buddhas and sentient beings appear as a foundation,

wylie: du ma cha shas kun bral ba'o/_/
english: free from all multiplicity and parts. [N-187]

wylie: zhus don lnga pa/
english: [Source heading: Fifth subject of inquiry.]

wylie: gal te 'khrul pa'i sems can la/_/
english: As for deluded sentient beings:

wylie: sku dang ye shes rang lugs te/_/
english: embodiments and primordial knowing are in their own manner,

wylie: rnal ma so ma lhug pa ste/_/
english: genuine, fresh, and letting be—

wylie: gyi nar gnas pa kho na dang /_/
english: abiding solely in ‘gyi nar’ [unresolved expression],

wylie: dbang po yul la rang bzhin no/_/
english: intrinsic nature at the faculties' objects. [N-189]

wylie: 'dir ni rang yul bstan pa las/_/
english: Here their own object is shown;

wylie: 'khor rkyen 'jug pa ma yin par/_/
english: without entering into surrounding conditions,

wylie: zang ma nyid dang thal byung du/_/
english: in unobstructedness and penetration,

wylie: yul dang shes pa'i snang cha las/_/
english: from the appearance aspects of object and knowing,

wylie: thad ka so so'i gzhi las grol/_/
english: each is directly liberated from its own Ground. [N-189]

wylie: 'dod yon rnams ni rang rdzogs te/_/
english: The desirable qualities are self-complete.

wylie: sna tshogs 'gyu ba so so'i gnad/_/
english: In the respective crucial points of diverse movement,

wylie: gcig shes pa yis grol bar gnas/_/
english: knowing one, one abides liberated.

wylie: des na chos nyid rtogs pa ste/_/
english: Thus the nature of phenomena is realized,

wylie: cha shas nyid dang bral ba'o/_/
english: free from parts.

wylie: zhus don drug pa/
english: [Source heading: Sixth subject of inquiry.]

wylie: lus kyi gnad ni 'di lta ste/_/
english: The crucial points of the body are as follows:

wylie: spyi dang tsit+ta rtsa yi gnad/_/
english: the general [body], the heart, and the channels—

wylie: ma bcos dag pa'i chos nyid gnas/_/
english: the pure, uncontrived nature of phenomena abides there. [N-190]

wylie: sems can kun gyi lus spyi la/_/
english: Throughout the bodies of all sentient beings,

wylie: chos nyid rlung gi tshul du khyab/_/
english: the nature of phenomena pervades in the manner of wind.

wylie: phra dang yang dang 'gyu dang 'byed/_/
english: Subtle, light, moving, and separating:

wylie: byed las bzhi yi tshul gyis ni/_/
english: through these four ways of functioning,

wylie: dus bzhi'i rnal 'byor shes par bya/_/
english: know the yoga of the four times.

wylie: tsit+ta'i nang na skur gnas te/_/
english: Within the heart it abides as embodiment.

wylie: gdangs kyi sku ni rnam pa lnga/_/
english: The embodiments of radiance have five aspects;

wylie: so so'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid 'dzin/_/
english: they hold the characteristics of their respective families.

wylie: zer gyi sku ni drug gis kyang*/_/
english: The six embodiments of rays

wylie: rang bzhin snang ba'i chos rnams sdud/_/
english: gather the phenomena of intrinsic nature's appearance.

wylie: dag pa'i sku ni rnam gsum gyis/_/
english: Through the three aspects of pure embodiment,

wylie: mya ngan 'das pa'i mtshan nyid 'dzin/_/
english: the characteristics of passing beyond sorrow are held.

wylie: rnam pa'i sku ni brgyad kyis kyang*/_/
english: Through the eight aspect-embodiments,

wylie: sa lam rdzogs pa'i bya ba byed/_/
english: the doing of completing grounds and paths is done. [N-190]

wylie: rtsa yi nang na thig le ste/_/
english: Within the channels are spheres.

wylie: 'jug pa'i thig le rnam gsum gyis/_/
english: Through three aspects of entering spheres,

wylie: 'khor 'das 'brel pa'i sa bon 'debs/_/
english: the seeds connecting samsara and nirvana are planted.

wylie: skye ba'i thig le lnga yis kyang /_/
english: Through the five arising spheres,

wylie: rnal 'byor nyams kyi dkyil 'khor 'jog_/
english: the mandala of yogic experience is established.

wylie: bkod pa'i thig le drug gis ni/_/
english: Through the six arraying spheres,

wylie: chos nyid du ma gcig tu sdud/_/
english: the manifold nature of phenomena is gathered into one.

wylie: de dang de la brten pa yis/_/
english: Through reliance on each of these,

wylie: chos kun mnyam pa'i bdag nyid do/_/
english: all phenomena have the identity of evenness. [N-190]

wylie: zhus lan bdun pa/
english: [Source heading: Seventh reply.]

wylie: sgo nas ci ltar 'byung ba ni/_/
english: As for how it emerges from the gates:

wylie: 'jug pa'i rlung gis bskul ba yis/_/
english: impelled by entering wind,

wylie: sgron ma bzhi las las bzhir 'gyur/_/
english: the four lamps become four activities.

wylie: khyab pa'i rlung gis bskyod pa yis/_/
english: Moved by pervading wind,

wylie: rig pa nyid las lu gu rgyud/_/
english: vajra chains [arise] from awareness itself.

wylie: smin pa'i rlung gis bsdus pa yis/_/
english: Gathered by ripening wind,

wylie: lnga lnga zung la skur snang ba'o/
english: they appear as embodiments in fivefold pairs. [N-191]

wylie: mig las rlung gnyis gzung dang 'dzin/_/
english: From the eyes, the two winds of apprehended object and apprehending subject:

wylie: g.yas pas bzung bas snang ba spel/_/
english: through the right, the apprehended aspect, appearance increases;

wylie: g.yon pas 'dzin pas kha dog rdzogs/_/
english: through the left, the apprehending aspect, colors are complete. [N-191]

wylie: rna ba khyab dang 'jug rlung las/_/
english: At the ears, from pervading and entering winds,

wylie: g.yas pas khyab pas sgra rnams ston/_/
english: the right, through pervasion, displays sounds;

wylie: g.yon pas 'jug pa rlung gi las/_/
english: the left, through the activity of entering wind,

wylie: gang dang gang rnams 'dzin par byed/_/
english: holds each respective [sound].

wylie: spyi gtsug khyab par rdzogs pa'i rlung*/_/
english: The wind of complete pervasion at the crown,

wylie: phra zhing bskyed pa med pa las/_/
english: subtle and without generation,

wylie: rig pa'i sku yang 'dzin pa'o/_/
english: also holds the embodiments of awareness. [N-191]

wylie: _zhus lan brgyad pa/
english: [Source heading: Eighth reply.]

wylie: yul la snang ba'i mtshan nyid ni/_/
english: The characteristics of appearing in the object:

wylie: nam mkha' sngo sangs rdzi med las/_/
english: from space, clear blue and unstirred,

wylie: 'od dang kha dog dbyibs nyid dang*/_/
english: light, colors, and shapes

wylie: ye shes lnga yi rang snang ston/_/
english: display the self-appearance of the five primordial knowings.

wylie: dag pa dbyings kyi sgron ma las/_/
english: From the lamp of pure basic space,

wylie: thig le sku dang 'khrul snang dag_/
english: spheres, embodiments, and purified delusory appearance—

wylie: rang bzhin nyid dang ngo bo nyid/_/
english: intrinsic nature itself and essence itself—

wylie: gnyis med 'du 'bral med par snang /_/
english: appear nondually, without joining or separating. [N-191]

wylie: 'di dus zad pa'i mtshan nyid ni/_/
english: At this time the characteristic of exhaustion

wylie: bya bral nam mkha' ci bzhin no/
english: is just like space, free from doing.

wylie: zhus lan dgu pa/
english: [Source heading: Ninth reply.]

wylie: _de la ci yis mthong ba ni/_/
english: As for by what it is seen:

wylie: goms dang gnad kyis mthong ba ste/_/
english: it is seen through familiarity and the crucial points.

wylie: goms pa sngon du 'gro ba nas/_/
english: Familiarity starts with the preliminaries;

wylie: brtsams te lus ngag gnad gzir bas/_/
english: applying the crucial points of body and voice,

wylie: rang snang dag pa'i gzugs mthong nas/_/
english: one sees the forms of pure self-appearance,

wylie: 'khrul pa thams cad nub pa'o/_/
english: and all delusion subsides.

wylie: gnad kyi lus kyis mthong bar byed/_/
english: Through the body at the crucial point, seeing occurs.

wylie: chos sku'i bzhugs stangs seng ge yis/_/
english: Through the lion posture of the dharma embodiment,

wylie: 'khrul pa'i 'jigs pa kun bral nas/_/
english: free from all fear of delusion,

wylie: rdo rje'i mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/_/
english: one sees with the vajra eye.

wylie: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bzhugs stangs kyis/_/
english: Through the posture of the complete enjoyment embodiment,

wylie: glang chen nyal ba la brten nas/_/
english: relying on the reclining elephant,

wylie: chos nyid rnam par longs spyod nas/_/
english: one fully enjoys the nature of phenomena

wylie: pad+ma'i spyan gyis mthong bar 'gyur/_/
english: and sees with the lotus eye.

wylie: sprul pa sku yi bzhugs stangs kyis/_/
english: Through the posture of the emanation embodiment,

wylie: drang srong tsog pu la brten nas/_/
english: relying on the crouching sage,

wylie: chos nyid rnam par rang sprul pas/_/
english: the nature of phenomena emanates of itself,

wylie: chos kyi mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/_/
english: and one sees with the dharma eye. [N-192]

wylie: gzhan yang rtsa dang 'khrul 'khor gyis/_/
english: Furthermore, through channels and bodily exercises,

wylie: rang bzhin snang ba'i ye shes lnga/_/
english: one sees the five primordial knowings of intrinsic nature's appearance

wylie: chu bur mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/_/
english: with the water-bubble eyes. [N-192]

wylie: zhus lan bcu pa/
english: [Source heading: Tenth reply.]

wylie: mthong nas gnad la dbab pa ste/_/
english: Having seen, one applies the crucial point.

wylie: snang ba 'khrid pa'i thabs kyis kyang /_/
english: Through methods of guiding appearance,

wylie: 'byung bzhi'i snang ba gnad la phebs/_/
english: the appearances of the four elements reach the crucial point.

wylie: rlung brgyad las kyi 'brel brtsis pas/_/
english: By reckoning the connections of the eight winds' activities,

wylie: rnam rtog du ma gnad la phebs/_/
english: manifold differentiating conceptualization reaches the crucial point.

wylie: lus ni gcud dang rtsal sprug dang /_/
english: For the body: compressing, shaking out expressiveness,

wylie: yan lag brdab 'phen sdud pa'i gnad/_/
english: and the crucial points of striking, extending, and gathering the limbs;

wylie: phra zhing drang la mnye ba yis/_/
english: through subtlety, straightening, and massage—

wylie: sha dang khrag ste rus pa la'o/_/
english: in flesh, blood, and bone. [N-192]

wylie: zhus lan bcu gcig pa/
english: [Source heading: Eleventh reply.]

wylie: de ltar phebs nas rdzogs pa'i tshad/_/
english: Having thus arrived, the measures of completeness are:

wylie: thad ka'i ngos snang 'gags pa dang /_/
english: cessation of what appears directly before one;

wylie: sa rdor snang ba gzhug pa dang*/_/
english: introducing appearance into earth and stone;

wylie: rang shes ci la'ang tshud pa dang*/_/
english: one's own knowing entering anything;

wylie: de btsud bem po 'gul ba dang /_/
english: through that entry, moving insentient things;

wylie: rlung gi 'gyu ba'i tshad zin dang*/_/
english: taking the measure of wind's movement; [N-193]

wylie: lus kyi rdul phran mthong ba 'byung*/_/
english: seeing the body's minute particles arises;

wylie: cir snang gzugs skur rdzogs pa dang*/_/
english: whatever appears is complete as form embodiment;

wylie: de la yab yum 'khril pa dang /_/
english: there, father and mother embrace;

wylie: lnga lnga yab dang yum sbyor dang*/_/
english: fivefold fathers and mothers join;

wylie: kun kyang mu khyud zlum po la/_/
english: all are within a round encircling band.

wylie: rnal 'byor lus kyang 'od gsal zhing*/_/
english: The yogin's body too is clear light;

wylie: 'gro dang 'ong dang 'dug pa dang*/_/
english: going, coming, and abiding—

wylie: thams cad rig pa tshad phebs so/_/
english: all are awareness reaching its measure. [N-194]

wylie: zhus lan bcu gnyis pa/
english: [Source heading: Twelfth reply.]

wylie: tshad phebs lugs kyang 'di ltar 'gyur/_/
english: The manner of reaching the measure also becomes like this:

wylie: so so'i lus kyi rdul bral nas/_/
english: free from the particles of each body,

wylie: bar snang 'od kyi skar khung snang /_/
english: windows of light appear in the intervening space.

wylie: de las 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs/_/
english: From these, rays shaped like hooks,

wylie: phra zhing 'khril pas snang ba 'dzin/_/
english: subtle and entwining, hold appearance.

wylie: lus kyi rdos pa rang 'gags nas/_/
english: The body's material weight self-ceases:

wylie: zang thal dri med 'od kyi lus/_/
english: a stainless body of light with unimpeded penetration.

wylie: dbus na a yi mtshan ma dang*/_/
english: At its center is the sign of A,

wylie: mdzod spu'i 'od zer 'dom gang tshad/_/
english: and rays from the brow curl measure one armspan.

wylie: thor tshugs rlung gis 'geg 'degs kyang byung par snang*/_/
english: The topknot appears held back by wind. [Source variant: ‘lifted.’] [N-194]

wylie: zhi sku lag pa'i sor mo las/_/
english: From the fingers of the peaceful embodiments,

wylie: 'od kyi phreng ba rnam par 'khrigs/_/
english: garlands of light gather densely.

wylie: sgra med sems kyi spyod pa ste/_/
english: There is activity of ordinary mind without sound.

wylie: mgo bo thod pa'i gzhal yas las/_/
english: From the palace of the skull in the head,

wylie: he ru ka rnams mngon par 'byung /_/
english: Herukas manifestly arise.

wylie: 'di dus rang lus tshad la phabs/_/
english: At this time one's body is brought to its measure:

wylie: zang thal sku gsum gcig tu dril ba'o/_/
english: the three embodiments, with unimpeded penetration, gathered into one. [N-194]

wylie: zhus lan bcu gsum pa/
english: [Source heading: Thirteenth reply.]

wylie: 'di dus sems ni gsal ba dang*/_/
english: At this time ordinary mind is clear;

wylie: mngon par shes pa drug rnams dang*/_/
english: through the six higher knowings,

wylie: ring dang dpag tu gyur pa yi/_/
english: phenomena that are far away or measurable

wylie: chos rnams skad cig gis shes 'gyur/_/
english: are known in an instant.

wylie: tshad med sangs rgyas zhing khams dang*/_/
english: Immeasurable buddha fields

wylie: de bzhin sku yang sems la snang*/_/
english: and likewise embodiments appear to ordinary mind.

wylie: stong pa'i sems la dri ma zad/_/
english: In empty ordinary mind, stains are exhausted.

wylie: rang bzhin mi g.yo stong gsal mnyam/_/
english: Intrinsic nature does not move; emptiness and clarity are even.

wylie: ma 'dres mnyam rdzogs dbyings la khyab/_/
english: Unmixed, complete in evenness, it pervades basic space.

wylie: snang srid gsal ba du ma bral/_/
english: Appearance and existence are clear, free from multiplicity.

wylie: cha shas med pas spros med do/_/
english: Without parts, there is no elaboration. [N-195]

wylie: zhus lan bcu bzhi pa/
english: [Source heading: Fourteenth reply.]

wylie: de ltar snang ba'i dus rnams su/_/
english: At the times of such appearances,

wylie: lus sems 'brel pa chod pa ni/_/
english: the connection between body and ordinary mind is severed.

wylie: zag bcas zad pa'i lus la yang*/_/
english: Even in the body whose contaminated [elements] are exhausted,

wylie: phyir 'byung mtshan nyid gsal ba'i sems/_/
english: ordinary mind, characterized by clarity, emerges outward.

wylie: skar mda' 'pho ba'i tshul gyis kyang*/_/
english: In the manner of a shooting star passing across,

wylie: nam mkha'i khams su gsal bar mthong /_/
english: it is clearly seen in the element of space. [N-195]

wylie: de nyid thog ma'i dus rnams su/_/
english: At the initial times of this,

wylie: rlung dang bral ba dag la yang*/_/
english: even in separation from wind,

wylie: 'bad cing dag pa rlung gi las/_/
english: through effort and the activity of pure wind,

wylie: lus las phyi rol 'phang las 'byung /_/
english: it arises from being projected outside the body.

wylie: mthong byed gnyis kyi cha las kyang /_/
english: Through the two aspects of what sees,

wylie: lus ni 'od gsal dag pa la/_/
english: the body is pure clear light;

wylie: sems ni me stag 'phro ba bzhin/_/
english: ordinary mind is like proliferating sparks,

wylie: gcig tu mi gnas rang gsal gzhi/_/
english: not abiding in one place, a Ground of its own clarity.

wylie: snang cha gnyis kyi tshul du 'byung*/_/
english: It arises in the manner of two appearance aspects.

wylie: 'dis ni lus sems 'brel chad nas/_/
english: Through this, the connection between body and ordinary mind is severed,

wylie: khams gsum ldog pa ma yin no/_/
english: and one does not return to the three realms. [N-195]

wylie: _zhus lan bco lnga pa/
english: [Source heading: Fifteenth reply.]

wylie: rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos nyid ni/_/
english: The nature of phenomena of cause and result:

wylie: rtog pa rags pa'i khungs 'gags nas/_/
english: when the source of coarse conceptual thought has ceased,

wylie: dran pa rang dag rgyud la yang*/_/
english: in the continuum of self-purified mindfulness,

wylie: rten 'brel rlung nyid rnam dag pa/_/
english: dependent connections and wind itself are completely pure.

wylie: rlu las byung ba'i chos nyid do/_/
english: It is the nature of phenomena arising from wind. [N-196]

wylie: ka nas dag pa'i rang bzhin la/_/
english: In intrinsic nature, pure from the beginning,

wylie: gcig dang du ma'i grangs zad de/_/
english: the numbers one and many are exhausted.

wylie: sku dang ye shes med pa dang*/_/
english: There are no embodiments or primordial knowing;

wylie: chos rnams zad pa'i mthar phyin pa/_/
english: having reached the limit where phenomena are exhausted,

wylie: 'bras bu chos nyid yin par 'dod/_/
english: this is held to be the nature of phenomena of the result. [N-196]

wylie: _zhus lan bcu drug pa/
english: [Source heading: Sixteenth reply.]

wylie: rang sar dengs pa'i chos nyid ni/_/
english: The nature of phenomena that clears in its own place:

wylie: 'byung ba dengs pas rdos pa dag_/
english: when the elements clear, material weight is purified;

wylie: rdul dang phra rags mthar 'gags nas/_/
english: particles, subtle and coarse, cease at their limit,

wylie: cha shas tsam yang gnas pa min/_/
english: and not even a mere part abides.

wylie: nyon mongs dengs pas 'khrul pa dengs/_/
english: When afflictions clear, delusion clears.

wylie: rtog bral zhen pa mi gnas pas/_/
english: Free from conceptual thought, clinging does not abide;

wylie: bag la nyal dang kun nas ldang /_/
english: neither dormancy nor manifest arising—

wylie: rdul cha tsam yang mi gnas so/_/
english: not even a particle's portion abides.

wylie: de ltar phra rags dengs pa yis/_/
english: Through the clearing of subtle and coarse in this way,

wylie: phung po lnga yang mthar gyis phra/_/
english: the five aggregates gradually become subtle.

wylie: 'byung ba bzhi yi lus zad nas/_/
english: When the body of the four elements is exhausted,

wylie: thams cad ye shes rdzogs sku'o/_/
english: all is embodiment complete in primordial knowing.

wylie: rtog med ting 'dzin rang gnas te/_/
english: Deep absorption free from conceptualization abides of itself.

wylie: bcos ma'i chos las 'das pas na/_/
english: Beyond contrived phenomena,

wylie: chos zhes tshig tu mi gnas so/_/
english: it does not abide even in the phrase ‘phenomena.’ [N-196]

wylie: zhus lan bcu bdun pa/
english: [Source heading: Seventeenth reply.]

wylie: de ltar chos nyid nges pa'i tshig_/
english: The definitive phrase ‘nature of phenomena’ is thus:

wylie: chos zhes tshogs shing 'dus pa las/_/
english: ‘phenomena’ means gathering and assembling,

wylie: bya ba byed dang mtshan nyid 'dzin/_/
english: doing doings and holding characteristics,

wylie: rang snang ston par byed pa la/_/
english: showing self-appearance

wylie: so so'i rigs rnams 'dzin pa'o/_/
english: and holding the respective classes.

wylie: nyid ni bcos pa med pa la/_/
english: ‘Nature’ means no contrivance;

wylie: lhug par gnas pas rnal mar khyab/_/
english: abiding in letting be, it genuinely pervades.

wylie: so ma gnyug ma dkyus ma la/_/
english: Fresh, genuine, and in its original course,

wylie: sgra tshig ming gi grangs zad pa'o/_/
english: the number of words, phrases, and names is exhausted. [N-197]

wylie: zhus lan bco brgyad pa/
english: [Source heading: Eighteenth reply.]

wylie: gnad kyi chos nyid 'di lta ste/_/
english: The nature of phenomena of the crucial points is as follows:

wylie: 'byung ba'i gnas dang rang lus dang /_/
english: the elements' abodes, one's body,

wylie: yul dang sgo dang shes pa rlung*/_/
english: objects, gates, knowing, wind,

wylie: rtsa dang thig le yan lag gis/_/
english: channels, spheres, and subsidiary aspects—

wylie: so so'i 'jug pa khyab par gnas/_/
english: each respective entry abides pervasively.

wylie: de dag so so'i sngon 'gro dang /_/
english: Through transforming their respective preliminaries

wylie: dngos gzhi gnas la bsgyur ba yis/_/
english: and the abiding of the main practice,

wylie: rtog pa bral ba'i chos nyid la/_/
english: in the nature of phenomena free from conceptual thought,

wylie: rang bzhin gnas pas 'gyu ba zad/_/
english: intrinsic nature abides and movement is exhausted.

wylie: zad snang gnyis med yul las ni/_/
english: From the object in which exhaustion and appearance are nondual,

wylie: rang bzhin gnas dang bcos ma las/_/
english: through intrinsic abiding and contrived [practice],

wylie: chos kyi dbyings kyang dag pas snang /_/
english: the basic space of phenomena also appears through purity.

wylie: 'dis ni gnad kyi 'tshang rgya'o/_/
english: Through this, buddhahood comes through the crucial points. [N-197]

wylie: zhus lan bcu dgu pa/
english: [Source heading: Nineteenth reply.]

wylie: 'byung dus gnad ni 'di lta bu/_/
english: The crucial point of the time of arising is like this:

wylie: e ma ngo mtshar che ba bshad/_/
english: Ema! I shall explain a great wonder.

wylie: chos nyid 'di la 'byung dus brgyad/_/
english: This nature of phenomena has eight times of arising,

wylie: gnas pa'i dus kyang de tsam las/_/
english: and just as many times of abiding.

wylie: khyad par dus ni bzhi la yang /_/
english: Also at four distinctive times,

wylie: rnal 'byor ldan pas sems gnas pas/_/
english: when the yogin's ordinary mind abides,

wylie: mnyam nyid 'du 'bral med pa'o/_/
english: there is evenness without joining or separating.

wylie: rang bzhin dag pa'i gnad shes nas/_/
english: Knowing the crucial point of pure intrinsic nature,

wylie: byas pa med par chos rnams shes/_/
english: one knows phenomena without anything being done.

wylie: dus ni 'pho ba'i grangs kyis bzung /_/
english: Time is held through the number of transitions;

wylie: bzung bas 'khrul med dag pa'o/_/
english: through holding it, there is purity without delusion. [N-197]

wylie: zhus lan nyi shu tham pa/
english: [Source heading: Twentieth reply, in full.]

wylie: bar do'i chos nyid 'di lta bu/_/
english: The nature of phenomena of the intermediate state is like this:

wylie: rab tu gsang ba'i chos nyid bshad/_/
english: I shall explain the most secret nature of phenomena.

wylie: dbye na rnam pa bzhi dag las/_/
english: Distinguished, there are four aspects;

wylie: 'dir ni chos nyid bar do bshad/_/
english: here I shall explain the intermediate state of the nature of phenomena.

wylie: 'chi ka las ni thar pa'i tshe/_/
english: When released from the moment of death,

wylie: rnam shes nam mkha' dag la thim/_/
english: consciousness dissolves into space.

wylie: nam mkha' 'od gsal la thim dus/_/
english: When space dissolves into clear light,

wylie: phra rags snang ba kun 'gags te/_/
english: all subtle and coarse appearances cease.

wylie: dbang po kun ldan 'od kyi lus/_/
english: A body of light endowed with all faculties

wylie: lus las grib ma bzhin du 'gyur/_/
english: becomes like a shadow from the body. [N-198]

wylie: de tshe 'od snang dum bu'i tshe/_/
english: At that time, when light appears in fragments,

wylie: mkhas pas snang ba mched pa bzung /_/
english: the adept holds the spreading of appearance.

wylie: g.yo ba rlung dag mched pa yis/_/
english: Through the spreading of moving wind,

wylie: kha dog lnga yi 'od dang zer/_/
english: light and rays of five colors

wylie: ma nges 'ja' tshon ris su snang /_/
english: appear in uncertain rainbow patterns.

wylie: 'jug cing smin pa'i rlung las kyang /_/
english: From entering and ripening winds,

wylie: phyogs bzhi mtshams dang bla 'og grub/_/
english: the four directions, intermediate directions, above and below are established.

wylie: de la phyogs kyi 'od 'dus pas/_/
english: As the directions' lights gather there,

wylie: rigs lnga'i sku yang mngon par snang*/_/
english: embodiments of the five families also manifest.

wylie: mthing ga dkar ser dmar ljang ni/_/
english: Blue, white, yellow, red, and green

wylie: so so'i yul dang bcas par snang /_/
english: appear with their respective objects.

wylie: 'di la mched dang 'dzin shes na/_/
english: Knowing how to spread and hold them,

wylie: sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan rdzogs/_/
english: one completes the buddhas' qualities

wylie: khams gsum 'jug pa ma yin no/_/
english: and does not enter the three realms. [N-198]

wylie: zhus lan nyer gcig pa/
english: [Source heading: Twenty-first reply.]

wylie: de yi mtshan nyid 'di lta bu/_/
english: Their characteristics are like this:

wylie: rags pa'i 'byung bar ltos bral bas/_/
english: free from dependence on coarse elements,

wylie: 'od la thig le zer du 'bar/_/
english: spheres blaze as rays in the light.

wylie: thig le lnga 'brel sku rkyang ste/_/
english: Five connected spheres are single embodiments;

wylie: phyed sku las ni gzugs rdzogs pa'o/_/
english: from half-embodiments, forms become complete.

wylie: gzugs phyed sku las lnga lnga'i zung /_/
english: From embodiments with half-forms, there are fivefold pairs.

wylie: so so'i tshom bu rdzogs pa las/_/
english: As each cluster becomes complete,

wylie: lnga ldan bcu ldan brgya dang ldan/_/
english: there are groups of five, ten, and a hundred;

wylie: tshom bu stong dang 'bum phrag ni/_/
english: clusters of a thousand and a hundred thousand

wylie: bsam ngo rang bzhin dag par snang /_/
english: appear pure in the intrinsic nature of what is envisaged. [N-198]

wylie: brjod kyis mi langs grangs med pa/_/
english: Innumerable, beyond what expression can encompass—

wylie: 'di yi rang bzhin rang shes na/_/
english: when one oneself knows their intrinsic nature,

wylie: sku gsum gcig tu dril ba thob/_/
english: one attains the three embodiments gathered into one.

wylie: thob pa 'di las slar log med/_/
english: From this attainment there is no return.

wylie: gsal gdab pa las byung ba'o/_/
english: It comes from making this clear. [N-199]

wylie: gzhan yang chos nyid ngo bo ni/_/
english: Furthermore, the essence of the nature of phenomena

wylie: rang bzhin nyid las ngo bor grub/_/
english: is established as essence from intrinsic nature itself.

wylie: snang tshul gcig tu ma nges pas/_/
english: Since its manner of appearance is not fixed as one,

wylie: 'jug pa'i lam yang tha dad do/_/
english: the paths of entry also differ.

wylie: ngo dang shes dang grol mthong gis/_/
english: Through identity, knowing, and seeing liberation,

wylie: 'jug dang mthong dang goms pa las/_/
english: through entering, seeing, and familiarity—

wylie: ngo shes pa las rang ngo ste/_/
english: from recognition, there is one's own identity;

wylie: yid ches pa yis thug pa'o/_/
english: through trust, one reaches it;

wylie: thag chod pas ni gdeng du tshud/_/
english: through decision, one enters confidence.

wylie: de ltar gsum gyi nges pa las/_/
english: Through these three certainties,

wylie: ngo bo rdzogs pas rgyud 'gags so/_/
english: essence being complete, the continuum ceases. [N-199]

wylie: gzhan yang chos nyid rang bzhin bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the intrinsic nature of the nature of phenomena.

wylie: 'di 'dra gcig tu ma nges pas/_/
english: Not fixed as one thing of this kind,

wylie: gang ltar btags pa de ltar snang /_/
english: it appears however it is designated.

wylie: sna tshogs ming gi gdags gzhi las/_/
english: From the basis for assigning diverse names,

wylie: sgra tshig du ma'i spros par snang*/_/
english: it appears as elaborations of many words and phrases.

wylie: nges med ming ni sna tshogs las/_/
english: Names are uncertain and diverse;

wylie: don yang btags pa tsam gyis stong*/_/
english: meaning too is empty through mere designation.

wylie: stong nyid gang yang ma grub pas/_/
english: Since emptiness is not established as anything,

wylie: rang bzhin dag pa ltar snang ngo /_/
english: its intrinsic nature appears pure. [N-199]

wylie: gzhan yang chos nyid thugs rje bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the compassionate responsiveness of the nature of phenomena.

wylie: gdul bya'i yul ni sna tshogs pas/_/
english: Since the domains of those to be trained are diverse,

wylie: 'dul byed sku yang de bzhin no/_/
english: the embodiments that train them are likewise.

wylie: rigs dang dbang po'i rnam 'phrul las/_/
english: Through the transformations of classes and faculties,

wylie: 'khor 'das rtog pa tha dad de/_/
english: conceptual thoughts of samsara and nirvana differ.

wylie: de nyid so so'i yul bzhag na/_/
english: When each is left in its own object,

wylie: ma bcos don gyi dgongs pa'o/_/
english: this is enlightened intent of the uncontrived meaning.

wylie: gzhan yang chos nyid snang ba bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the appearance of the nature of phenomena.

wylie: ma dag pa yi 'khrul pa la/_/
english: In impure delusion,

wylie: dbang po'i sgo rnams ma bcos pas/_/
english: without contriving the gates of the faculties,

wylie: cog ge bzhag pa gnad yin la/_/
english: the crucial point is leaving [them] as they are;

wylie: de las ma bsgyur man ngag go/_/
english: not altering that is the pith instruction. [N-200]

wylie: gzung ba med pa'i snang ba la/_/
english: In appearance without an apprehended object,

wylie: 'dzin pa med pa'i sems shar ba/_/
english: ordinary mind arises without an apprehending subject.

wylie: spyod pa med pa'i mig gis mthong /_/
english: It is seen by eyes without activity;

wylie: chos nyid med pa'i lam nas drangs/_/
english: drawn along a path without a nature of phenomena;

wylie: lta sgom med pa'i gzhi la bskyal/_/
english: carried to a Ground without view and cultivation;

wylie: byar med rtsol bral 'bras bur dril/_/
english: gathered into a result with nothing to do, free from effort.

wylie: 'di la snang mtha' mi gnas so/_/
english: Here the limits of appearance do not abide. [N-200]

wylie: gzhan yang rig pa'i chos nyid bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the nature of phenomena of awareness.

wylie: lu gu rgyud du cer mthong bas/_/
english: Through naked seeing in vajra chains,

wylie: rnam rtog 'gyu ba'i dran pa 'gags/_/
english: the mindfulness of moving differentiating conceptualization ceases.

wylie: bya lam nam mkhar 'gro ba bzhin/_/_/
english: Like going in space along the birds' path,

wylie: chos kyi dbyings las 'gro sa med/_/
english: there is nowhere to go from the basic space of phenomena.

wylie: gzhan med rig snang rnam dag pas/_/
english: With no other, awareness-appearance being completely pure,

wylie: 'khrul par snang ba'i rgyu rkyen zad/_/
english: the causes and conditions of delusive appearance are exhausted.

wylie: dbyings dang rig pa 'bral med pas/_/
english: Since basic space and awareness are inseparable,

wylie: _lu gu rgyud kyi 'brel snang ston/_/
english: the connected appearance of vajra chains is shown.

wylie: rig pa'i ngo bo lu gu rgyud/_/
english: The essence of awareness is vajra chains:

wylie: 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar la/_/
english: in past, future, or present,

wylie: sus kyang byas pa ma yin la/_/
english: no one has made them.

wylie: des na 'dus ma byas pa nyid/_/
english: Thus being unconditioned

wylie: lu gu rgyud kyi rang bzhin no/_/
english: is the intrinsic nature of vajra chains.

wylie: rnam par rtog pa kun dag pas/_/
english: All differentiating conceptualization being pure,

wylie: ma 'khrul pa yi sangs rgyas so/_/
english: there is buddhahood without delusion. [N-200]

wylie: gzhan yang rgyud kyi chos nyid bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the nature of phenomena of the continuum.

wylie: yang dag chos nyid sgra las thal/_/
english: The true nature of phenomena penetrates beyond words;

wylie: rang gi ngo bo yi ge med/_/
english: its own essence is without letters.

wylie: rang rig ye shes sgron 'od 'bar/_/
english: The lamp-light of self-aware primordial knowing blazes.

wylie: chos nyid dag pas bkra shis mdzes/_/
english: With the nature of phenomena pure, auspiciousness is beautiful.

wylie: lta ba 'jigs bral seng rtsal rdzogs/_/
english: The view, free from fear, completes the lion's expressiveness;

wylie: rang rig smin pas rdzogs rang byung*/_/
english: with self-awareness ripened, completeness arises naturally;

wylie: lu gu rgyud 'brel mu tig phreng /_/
english: vajra chains connect, a garland of pearls;

wylie: nyams kyi snang ba nor phra bkod/_/
english: appearances of experience form an array of jeweled inlay;

wylie: rang gnas stong pa'i snying me long*/_/
english: self-abiding emptiness is the mirror of the core;

wylie: gol sa rang gcod thugs me long /_/
english: deviations are cut of themselves: the mirror of awakened mind.

wylie: gzhan las ma byung rang shar nyid/_/
english: Not arising from another, it is self-arising itself.

wylie: rang byung yin pas rang grol la/_/
english: Because it arises naturally, there is self-liberation.

wylie: dbyings su gcig pas klong yang drug_/
english: One in basic space, there are also six expanses.

wylie: yon tan rdzogs pa rin chen spungs/_/
english: With qualities complete, precious things are heaped.

wylie: rang rig bstan pas ngo sprod spras/_/
english: Self-awareness being taught, it is adorned with pointing out.

wylie: snang ba dag pas nyi zla sbyor/_/
english: With appearance pure, sun and moon are joined.

wylie: rig pa smin phyir sku gdung 'bar/_/
english: Because awareness ripens, embodiment-relics blaze.

wylie: 'di dag rnams kyang gzhi las shar/_/
english: All of these arise from the Ground. [N-201]

wylie: 'di ltar chos nyid brjod med pas/_/
english: Thus, because the nature of phenomena is inexpressible,

wylie: tha snyad tshig gi gzhi mar shar/_/
english: it arises as the foundation of conventional phrases.

wylie: tshig brjod rim pas rnam dag pas/_/
english: The sequences of expressed phrases being completely pure,

wylie: de ltar brjod med pa la gnas/_/
english: one thus abides in the inexpressible.

wylie: de phyir tshig rim mtha' zad pa'o/_/
english: Therefore the limits of phrase-sequences are exhausted.

wylie: gzhan yang grol ba'i chos nyid bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the nature of phenomena of liberation.

wylie: gnad kyis grol bas 'bad rtsol zad/_/
english: Liberated through the crucial points, striving and effort are exhausted.

wylie: ye nas grol bas bskyar mi dgos/_/
english: Liberated from the beginning, there is no need to repeat.

wylie: rang grol yin pas gnyen po med/_/
english: Because it is self-liberation, there is no antidote.

wylie: cer grol yin pas mthong sar yal/_/
english: Because it is naked liberation, it vanishes where it is seen.

wylie: yongs su grol bas rang bzhin dag_/
english: Completely liberated, intrinsic nature is pure.

wylie: dus kyi grol bas goms mi dgos/_/
english: Liberated through time, there is no need for familiarity.

wylie: rang bzhin grol bas ma bcos pa'o/_/
english: Liberated through intrinsic nature, it is uncontrived.

wylie: grol zhes tha snyad tsam nyid de/_/
english: ‘Liberated’ is merely a convention.

wylie: rtogs dang ma rtogs su yi chos/_/
english: Whose phenomena are realization and non-realization?

wylie: de la grol zhes su la dmigs/_/
english: For whom there is ‘liberated,’ what is the object of focus? [N-202]

wylie: khams gsum 'jug pa su la srid/_/
english: For whom could entry into the three realms occur?

wylie: srid mtha' grol ba'i chos nyid do/_/
english: This is the nature of phenomena liberated from the limits of existence.

wylie: gzhan yang bya bral chos nyid ni/_/
english: Furthermore, the nature of phenomena free from doing:

wylie: bya ba med pas grol ba la/_/
english: with no doing, there is liberation;

wylie: byung ba med pas gnas med pa'o/_/
english: with no arising, there is no abiding.

wylie: 'gro ba med pas 'ong 'khor zad/_/
english: With no going, coming and circling are exhausted.

wylie: byas byung gcig dang gnyis med pa'o/_/
english: There is neither one nor two of what is done or arisen.

wylie: tha snyad 'khrul pa tsam yang med/_/
english: There is not even mere conventional delusion.

wylie: yod med las kyi 'jug pas stong*/_/
english: It is empty of entry into activities of existence and nonexistence.

wylie: ye nas 'bras bu blo bral nyid/_/
english: From the beginning, the result is free from the conceptual mind,

wylie: smra bsam brjod pa kun 'das pa'o/_/
english: beyond all speaking, thinking, and expression. [N-203]

wylie: zhes sgra thal 'gyur chen po chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba las/
english: Thus, from the Great All-Penetrating Word, Root of All Phenomena:

wylie: _chos nyid bkod pa sems snang gi rtsa ba bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o//_//
english: the fourth chapter, the Array of the Nature of Phenomena, teaching the root of ordinary mind's appearance.

wylie: de nas rang bzhin rnam dag pas/_/
english: Then, through completely pure intrinsic nature,

wylie: chos sku brjod pa med pa las/_/
english: from the inexpressible dharma embodiment,

wylie: chos nyid spros bral nam mkha' las/_/
english: from the space of the nature of phenomena, free from conceptual elaborations,

wylie: brjod du med pa'i gzhi ma las/_/
english: from the inexpressible foundation,

wylie: rang byung bkod pa don gyi tshig_/
english: phrases of meaning in a naturally arisen array

wylie: ston pa'i ljags las 'od 'phros tshul/_/
english: arose like light proliferating from the teacher's tongue,

wylie: sus kyang byas pa med par shar/_/
english: without being made by anyone. [N-204]

wylie: de la lha dbang gis gsol pa/_/
english: The Lord of Gods supplicated:

wylie: kye ma bcom ldan 'khrul med bdag_/
english: ‘Kyema! Blessed one, lord without delusion,

wylie: lta dang bsgom pa'i bkod pa nyid/_/
english: by whom will the Array of View and Cultivation

wylie: gang gis 'dzin par 'gyur ba lags/_/
english: be held?

wylie: bab las grub pa'i gnas lugs gang /_/
english: What is the natural state established in its own disposition?

wylie: de la blta ba ci ltar bgyi/_/
english: How should one view it?

wylie: tshig don lta ba'i mtshams kyis bzung*/_/
english: Distinguish the boundary between viewing phrases and meaning.

wylie: lta ba'i ngo bo rang bzhin gang /_/
english: What are the essence and intrinsic nature of view?

wylie: brjod tshig ming gi rnam grangs ci/_/
english: What are the divisions of expressed phrases and names?

wylie: sgom pa zhes bya ji lta bu/_/
english: What is that called cultivation like?

wylie: de yi las dang go ba gang /_/
english: What are its activity and understanding?

wylie: ma gol gnas pa'i bsgom pa gang*/_/
english: What cultivation abides without deviation?

wylie: bsgom pa'i mtshan nyid snang tshul ci/_/
english: How do cultivation's characteristics appear?

wylie: ma bsgoms pa yi skyon gang lags/_/
english: What are the faults of not cultivating?

wylie: 'di dag bdag gis mnyan par 'tshal/_/
english: I wish to hear these.

wylie: rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag la gsung /_/
english: Vajra-holder, speak to me.’

wylie: de nas bcos med nam mkha' las/_/
english: Then, from uncontrived space,

wylie: sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang bas/_/
english: the one bearing thirty-two marks

wylie: lta sgom bkod pa 'di skad gsungs/_/
english: spoke the Array of View and Cultivation thus:

wylie: lha yi dbang po legs nyon cig_/
english: ‘Lord of Gods, listen well.

wylie: 'di la the tshom sus za ba/_/
english: Whoever doubts this

wylie: sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku la bsgrib/_/
english: obscures the embodiments of the buddhas.

wylie: zhus lan dang po/
english: [Source heading: First reply.]

wylie: blta ba bsgom pa 'dzin pa ni/_/
english: Those who hold view and cultivation

wylie: dad pa rab dang brtson 'grus ldan/_/
english: have excellent faith and diligence,

wylie: gtong bar nus shing bla ma gus/_/
english: are able to give and respect the lama,

wylie: brtul zhugs can la sdig la 'dzem/_/
english: possess disciplined observance and avoid wrongdoing;

wylie: 'gyur med rab tu brtan pas 'dzin/_/
english: unchanging and utterly stable, they hold it.

wylie: yang na rang nyid shugs dal ba/_/
english: Alternatively, one whose own impetus is quiet,

wylie: lhug pa glen pa'i lhod yod pas/_/
english: letting be, with a simple person's relaxation,

wylie: rtogs pa chung zhing rang bzhin dal/_/
english: whose realization is small and whose intrinsic nature is quiet,

wylie: lus ngag bya ba bral ba dang /_/
english: who is free from doings of body and voice,

wylie: shes rab ldan pas 'dzin par 'gyur/_/
english: and possesses discerning knowing, will hold it. [N-205]

wylie: zhus lan gnyis pa/
english: [Source heading: Second reply.]

wylie: bab las grub pa'i gnas lugs ni/_/
english: The natural state established in its own disposition

wylie: gnas pa bdun gyi tshul la yang*/_/
english: also has seven manners of abiding:

wylie: sna tshogs ngos nas lhun grub pa/_/
english: spontaneous presence from the side of diversity;

wylie: 'gyur tshad cha nas nges med pa/_/
english: indeterminacy from the aspect of the extent of change;

wylie: mi 'gyur ba las nges pa can/_/
english: certainty through not changing;

wylie: snang ba'i rtsal ni cir yang bsgyur/_/
english: appearance's expressiveness transforming into anything;

wylie: thams cad 'byung zhing khas len bcas/_/
english: all arising, together with affirmation;

wylie: 'khrul pa dag phyir ka dag la/_/
english: primordial purity because delusion is purified;

wylie: snang tshul tha dad khra bor 'dod/_/
english: and the variegation held to be diverse manners of appearance. [N-206]

wylie: 'di ltar 'dod pa'i bye brag las/_/
english: Through such distinctions in what is asserted,

wylie: rdzogs pa chen po cir snang phyir/_/
english: because the Great Perfection appears as anything,

wylie: tha dad 'dod pa grangs mang yang*/_/
english: although differing assertions are numerous,

wylie: gnas pa bab kyi lta ba la/_/
english: in the view of abiding in its own disposition

wylie: gcig med gnyis med gang dang bral/_/
english: there is no one, no two, and freedom from anything.

wylie: srog gcod ma byin len pa yang /_/
english: Even taking life and taking what is not given

wylie: nga las byung zhing nga yi chos/_/
english: arise from me and are my phenomena. [N-207]

wylie: lta dang sgom dang spyod pa yang*/_/
english: View, cultivation, and activity too

wylie: yod med stong pa'i mtha' las 'das/_/
english: are beyond the extremes of existence, nonexistence, and emptiness.

wylie: mdor na mtshan nyid kyis phye'o/_/
english: In brief, they are distinguished through characteristics.

wylie: zhus lan gsum pa/
english: [Source heading: Third reply.]

wylie: de la blta ba rnam pa gnyis/_/
english: There are two ways of viewing this:

wylie: tshig gi blta dang don blta'o/_/
english: viewing phrases and viewing meaning.

wylie: tshig gi blta ba bdun rim las/_/
english: Viewing phrases has seven stages;

wylie: so so'i 'dod pa blos byas te/_/
english: their respective assertions are constructed by the conceptual mind:

wylie: bya bral 'bad pa med pa dang*/_/
english: freedom from doing and absence of striving;

wylie: rim 'jug rang gzhan khyad 'don dang /_/
english: gradual entry and drawing out distinctions of self and other;

wylie: srog gcod dge sdig bral ba dang*/_/
english: taking life, and freedom from virtue and wrongdoing;

wylie: byas med byung ba med pa dang /_/
english: nothing done and nothing arisen;

wylie: ma bsgyur snang ba rang dag dang*/_/
english: unaltered appearance, self-purified;

wylie: nyon mongs rang bzhin grol bar 'dod/_/
english: and afflictions held to be liberated in intrinsic nature. [N-207]

wylie: don ni chos nyid mngon sum la/_/
english: Meaning is viewed in direct perception of the nature of phenomena,

wylie: shes rab kyis ni ma yin par/_/
english: not through discerning knowing,

wylie: dbang po'i spyod yul nyid du blta/_/
english: but as the very domain of the faculties.

wylie: tshig gis gtan la mi phebs te/_/
english: It is not decisively reached through phrases.

wylie: gnad gsum mthong ba'i ngo gang la/_/
english: In the identity of seeing the three crucial points,

wylie: tshig gsum gnad du 'grol ba'i phyir/_/
english: because the three phrases are explained as crucial points,

wylie: dbang po rno brtul med pa dang /_/
english: there are no sharp or dull faculties.

wylie: chos nyid mthong bas dag pas na/_/
english: Because seeing the nature of phenomena purifies,

wylie: las la bzang dang ngan pa med/_/
english: there is no good or bad in activities.

wylie: chos nyid stong pa ris med pas/_/
english: The nature of phenomena is empty and without divisions;

wylie: dge sdig gnyis ka rnam par sel/_/
english: virtue and wrongdoing, both, are removed. [N-207]

wylie: rang rig mngon sum mthong med pas/_/
english: Without seeing self-awareness directly,

wylie: rim dgu'i 'dod pas grol ba min/_/
english: the assertions of the nine stages do not liberate.

wylie: chos nyid zad cing mthar phyin pas/_/
english: When the nature of phenomena is exhausted and its limit reached,

wylie: sku gsum lam gyi snang ba'o/_/
english: the three embodiments are the appearance of the path.

wylie: zhus lan bzhi pa/
english: [Source heading: Fourth reply.]

wylie: tshig don blta ba'i sa mtshams ni/_/
english: The boundary between the views of phrases and meaning:

wylie: tshig ni brjod pa'i rgyu yin te/_/
english: phrases are causes of expression;

wylie: gang gis brjod dang sprul byed pa/_/
english: whatever expresses or produces an emanation

wylie: de la bsam pa'i yid dpyod do/_/
english: is mental examination that thinks about it.

wylie: don ni rang la rang gis blta/_/
english: Meaning is oneself viewing oneself.

wylie: mngon sum tshad ni gsum dag gis/_/
english: Through the three measures of direct perception,

wylie: lu gu rgyud la mngon du spyod/_/
english: one engages directly with vajra chains.

wylie: cer mthong ba dang cer grol du/_/
english: Through naked seeing and naked liberation,

wylie: gang gis mthong ba don yin no/_/
