english: whatever one sees is meaning. [N-208]

wylie: _zhus lan lnga pa/
english: [Source heading: Fifth reply.]

wylie: blta ba'i ngo bo mthong ba la/_/
english: The essence of view is seeing,

wylie: yid dpyod tshig gis 'gyur ba med/_/
english: unchanged by phrases of mental examination.

wylie: lung dang bla ma'i man ngag las/_/
english: Neither authoritative transmission nor the lama's pith instructions

wylie: gang gis bstan pa med pa'o/_/
english: shows it by any [means]. [N-208]

wylie: zhus lan drug pa/
english: [Source heading: Sixth reply.]

wylie: lta ba'i rang bzhin snod bcud la/_/
english: The intrinsic nature of view pervades environment and inhabitants;

wylie: ma khyab med pas gang yang grol/_/
english: nothing is unpervaded, so anything is liberated.

wylie: grol ba'i chos la rnam 'dzin bral/_/
english: In liberated phenomena, differentiated grasping is absent.

wylie: cir snang rang gi chos nyid las/_/
english: Whatever appears is one's own nature of phenomena;

wylie: bcos ma'i chos nyid logs na med/_/
english: there is no separate contrived nature of phenomena.

wylie: ci ltar spyod kyang mi rtog skye/_/
english: However one acts, non-conceptuality arises.

wylie: spang dang blang med rang snang ngo /_/
english: There is self-appearance without rejecting and accepting.

wylie: _zhus lan bdun pa/
english: [Source heading: Seventh reply.]

wylie: brjod tshig ming gi rnam grangs ni/_/
english: The divisions of expressed phrases and names

wylie: phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang /_/
english: are outer, inner, secret,

wylie: bla na med pa'i blta ba bzhi'o/_/
english: and unsurpassed—the four views.

wylie: phyi ni chos can la blta ba/_/
english: The outer is viewing bearers of properties:

wylie: rim brgyad so so'i 'dod pa la/_/
english: in the respective assertions of the eight stages,

wylie: yid dpyod 'dzin pa nyid du 'dod/_/
english: mental examination and grasping are maintained. [N-209]

wylie: nang ni chos nyid la bltas pas/_/
english: The inner: viewing the nature of phenomena,

wylie: ngo bo rang bzhin sgyu mar mthong*/_/
english: one sees essence and intrinsic nature as illusion.

wylie: gsang ba rang rig la bltas pas/_/
english: The secret: viewing self-awareness,

wylie: lu gu rgyud dang 'brel chags mthong*/_/
english: one sees its uninterrupted connection with vajra chains.

wylie: kho na nyid ni dbyings rig go/_/
english: Suchness is basic space and awareness. [N-209]

wylie: zhus lan brgyad pa/
english: [Source heading: Eighth reply.]

wylie: bsgom pa zhes ni sems gnas la/_/
english: What is called cultivation is ordinary mind abiding,

wylie: 'gyu ba phyi nang gcod pa ste/_/
english: cutting outer and inner movement,

wylie: gzung dang 'dzin pa 'gag pa'o/_/
english: and ceasing apprehended object and apprehending subject.

wylie: rang bzhin bab las byung ba ni/_/
english: What arises from intrinsic nature's own disposition

wylie: bsam gtan dag tu brjod par bya/_/
english: is to be called meditative stabilization.

wylie: rlung dang rtsa dang thig le dang /_/
english: Wind, channels, spheres,

wylie: lus gnad mig dang stong pa ni/_/
english: the body's crucial points, the eyes, and emptiness—

wylie: bsgom pa zhes ni 'dod pa yin/_/
english: these are held to be cultivation.

wylie: yi ge'i 'od dang kha dog dang /_/
english: The light and colors of letters,

wylie: rnam par 'phrul pa'i spro bsdu ni/_/
english: and the emanations' proliferating and gathering,

wylie: ting nge 'dzin zhes bshad pa la/_/
english: are explained as deep absorption.

wylie: ma bcos rang bzhag gnas lugs te/_/
english: Uncontrived, resting of itself, is the natural state.

wylie: ci ltar de las 'gyur med pas/_/
english: Because there is no change from that, however [it occurs],

wylie: sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa'o/_/
english: it is the buddhas' enlightened intent. [N-210]

wylie: _zhus lan dgu pa/
english: [Source heading: Ninth reply.]

wylie: de yi las dang go ba ni/_/
english: Its activity and understanding:

wylie: las kyis yul zhen gcod pa dang /_/
english: through activity, clinging to objects is cut,

wylie: nyon mongs la sogs spang ba dang*/_/
english: afflictions and the like are rejected,

wylie: 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'byin pa'o/_/
english: and the root of samsara is drawn out.

wylie: go bas sems nyid 'dzin pa dang*/_/
english: Through understanding, the nature of ordinary mind is held,

wylie: gnas par byed dang rlung zad dang*/_/
english: made to abide, and wind is exhausted;

wylie: chos nyid stong pa'i lam rnyed dang /_/
english: the path of the empty nature of phenomena is found,

wylie: rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhi snang ngo /_/
english: and there is ground-appearance of pure intrinsic nature.

wylie: _zhus lan bcu pa/
english: [Source heading: Tenth reply.]

wylie: ma gol gnas pa'i bsgom pa ni/_/
english: Cultivation that abides without deviation:

wylie: dbang po'i sgo rnams gsal ba la/_/
english: the faculties' gates are clear,

wylie: yid kyi rtog pa ma 'gyus pas/_/
english: and the mental faculty's conceptual thought does not move.

wylie: shes pa nyid la dpyod pa'i yid/_/
english: The mental faculty that examines knowing itself

wylie: phyir la shor ba med pa nyid/_/
english: does not escape outward.

wylie: ris can gsal ba ma yin dang*/_/
english: It is not a clarity marked by divisions;

wylie: gud bcad stong par ma song dang /_/
english: it has not gone into an emptiness cut off separately;

wylie: bde ba rgyun chags ma yin dang /_/
english: it is not a continuous succession of bliss;

wylie: btang snyoms lteng por ma song dang*/_/
english: it has not become a stagnant pool of equanimity. [N-211]

wylie: dran rig gsal ba ngal gso dang*/_/
english: Resting in clear mindfulness and awareness;

wylie: sbyangs pa log cha lam song dang /
english: training's contrary aspects having become the path;

wylie: 'dzin cha nang du rgyun bde dang /_/
english: an apprehending aspect with a continuous inward ease;

wylie: cha lugs gsal ba'i 'dzin cha dang*/_/
english: an apprehending aspect clear in its manner of parts;

wylie: kha dog yig 'bru skyur byed rnams/_/
english: and casting out colors and syllables—

wylie: de rnams phyogs su ma lhung na/_/
english: when one has not fallen to the side of any of these,

wylie: ma gol gnas pa'i bsgom pa'o/_/
english: this is cultivation abiding without deviation. [N-211]

wylie: zhus lan bcu gcig pa/
english: [Source heading: Eleventh reply.]

wylie: bsgom pa'i mtshan nyid snang tshul ni/_/
english: The characteristics and manner of appearance of cultivation:

wylie: mtshan nyid stong gsal rig pa la/_/
english: its characteristic is empty, clear awareness;

wylie: rang bzhin gang dang ma 'dres pa/_/
english: its intrinsic nature is mixed with nothing;

wylie: gzung dang 'dzin pa'i mtha' zad dang*/_/
english: the limits of apprehended object and apprehending subject are exhausted;

wylie: chos nyid rang ngo dag pa'o/_/
english: and the nature of phenomena is pure in its own identity.

wylie: snang tshul 'khrul pa ma yin la/_/
english: Its manner of appearance is not delusion.

wylie: rgyu rkyen dag pa'i rang bzhin la/_/
english: In the intrinsic nature of pure causes and conditions,

wylie: dngos dang dngos med rang dag nas/_/
english: things and absence of things are self-purified;

wylie: sgo lnga'i yul zhen dag pa dang*/_/
english: clinging to the objects of the five gates is purified;

wylie: 'byung ba'i rigs pa dag pa dang /_/
english: the order of the elements is purified;

wylie: ye shes dag pa'i 'phel snang ston/_/
english: and the increasing appearance of pure primordial knowing is shown.

wylie: de la zad pa'i chos nyid do/_/
english: There is the nature of phenomena of exhaustion. [N-212]

wylie: _zhus lan bcu gnyis pa/
english: [Source heading: Twelfth reply.]

wylie: ma bsgoms pa yi skyon nyid ni/_/
english: The faults of not cultivating are:

wylie: 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid mngon snang ba/_/
english: the characteristics of samsara manifest;

wylie: bdag dang gzhan te yul shes dang*/_/
english: self and other, objects and knowing,

wylie: tshig dang bcas pa'i blta ba dang /_/
english: a view bound to phrases,

wylie: dmigs dang bcas pa'i yul dag dang /_/
english: and objects bound to focus—

wylie: nyon mongs bdag tu 'ching bar 'gyur/_/
english: afflictions bind [one] as a self.

wylie: sangs rgyas lam yang stor ba dang*/_/
english: The path of buddhahood is also lost;

wylie: 'bras bu'i rang bzhin ma shes dang /_/
english: the intrinsic nature of the result is not known;

wylie: chos kun mnyam pa'i gzhi med dang /_/
english: there is no Ground of the evenness of all phenomena;

wylie: rang rig khams gsum 'ching ba dang /_/
english: self-awareness is bound in the three realms;

wylie: rtog dang bcas pa'i ltung bar 'gyur/_/
english: and one falls into what is accompanied by conceptual thought. [N-212]

wylie: 'di man chad bsdus don bshad/
english: [Source heading: Below this, the condensed meaning is explained.]

wylie: gzhan yang chos nyid 'khor lo bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the wheel of the nature of phenomena.

wylie: gnas pa'i lta bas chos kun rtogs/_/
english: Through the view of abiding, all phenomena are realized.

wylie: rang bzhin dag pas 'khor 'das phyed/_/
english: With intrinsic nature pure, samsara and nirvana are distinguished.

wylie: byas pa med pas byung ba'o/_/
english: With nothing done, there is arising.

wylie: yang dag lam du btang bas khyab/_/
english: Brought onto the true path, it pervades.

wylie: rdzogs 'byung chos nyid stong pa'o/_/
english: Completely arisen, the nature of phenomena is empty.

wylie: bya ba med pas byung med rdzogs/_/
english: With no doing, non-arising is complete.

wylie: 'khor ba dag pas 'das pa'o/_/
english: Samsara being purified, there is passing beyond sorrow.

wylie: gzhan yang mthong dag blta ba ni/_/
english: Furthermore, the view of pure seeing:

wylie: dngos med rang dag rdzogs pa che/_/
english: the great completeness of self-purified absence of things.

wylie: lha la mchod pa mi dgos te/_/
english: There is no need to make offerings to deities;

wylie: sngags kyi bzlas dang dka' thub med/_/
english: there is no mantra recitation or austerity;

wylie: bdug pa mar me lha bshos med/_/
english: no incense, lamps, or food offerings to deities;

wylie: tshogs dang bla ma mchod pa med/_/
english: no gathering offerings or offerings to the lama;

wylie: bstod dang sbyin bsreg mchod pa med/_/
english: no praise or burnt offerings;

wylie: pha rol phyin drug las mtha' med/_/
english: no scope of activity of the six perfections.

wylie: de ltar gzhi rtsa gang med pas/_/
english: Thus, with no Ground or root whatsoever:

wylie: srog gcod ma byin mi tshangs spyod/_/
english: taking life, taking what is not given, and unchaste activity— [N-213]

wylie: lta ba med dang bsgom med spyod pa med/_/
english: there is no view, no cultivation, and no activity.

wylie: bltar med spyad du med pas bsgom pa'i 'dod pa gang*/_/
english: With nothing to view or enact, what assertion of cultivation is there?

wylie: stong dang gsal ba sems kyi 'dod pa 'gag_/
english: Ordinary mind's assertions of emptiness and clarity cease.

wylie: de bzhin chos dang sangs rgyas chos med pa'o/_/
english: Likewise, phenomena and the phenomena of buddhahood are absent. [N-213]

wylie: gzhan yang rang bzhin blta ba ni/_/
english: Furthermore, the view of intrinsic nature:

wylie: dngos med rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/_/
english: the Great Perfection of intrinsic nature, without things.

wylie: sa chu me rlung 'byung ba mngon sangs rgyas/_/
english: Earth, water, fire, and wind—the elements—are manifestly buddha.

wylie: bcos pa med par rang grol chen po nyid/_/
english: Without contrivance, there is great self-liberation itself.

wylie: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug byang chub bzhi/_/
english: Desire, hatred, dull confusion, and awakening—four. [N-214]

wylie: rnam rtog las kyi spyod pa rtogs pa'i gdeng*/_/
english: The activity of differentiating conceptualization and karma is confidence in realization.

wylie: 'khor ba ma spangs sangs rgyas dgongs pa'o/_/
english: Without rejecting samsara, there is the buddhas' enlightened intent.

wylie: lus dang ngag yid dwangs pas sku gsum rdzogs/_/
english: Body, voice, and mental faculty being refined, the three embodiments are complete.

wylie: sems dang ma rig 'khrul pa chos nyid gzhi/_/
english: Ordinary mind, ignorance, and delusion are the Ground of the nature of phenomena.

wylie: las dang bag chags zhen pa blta gnad do/_/
english: Karma, habitual tendencies, and clinging are crucial points of view. [N-214]

wylie: gzhan yang bcos pa'i lta ba ni/_/
english: Furthermore, the contrived view:

wylie: chos las ma byung sangs rgyas la/_/
english: for a buddha that has not arisen from phenomena,

wylie: rgyu yis ma bskyed 'bras bu rdzogs/_/
english: a result complete without being generated by a cause,

wylie: rkyen gyis mi 'jig lus blang ste/_/
english: one takes a body not destroyed by conditions.

wylie: lung las ma byung grub pa'i mtha'/_/
english: With tenets not arising from authoritative transmission,

wylie: rgyud la ma brten man ngag gis/_/
english: and pith instructions not relying on the continuum,

wylie: mya ngan 'das pa'i rtsa ba bcad/_/
english: one cuts the root of passing beyond sorrow,

wylie: 'khor ba'i 'bras bu smin par byas/_/
english: and makes the result of samsara ripen.

wylie: yang dag ma yin ma dag gzhi/_/
english: An untrue, impure Ground—

wylie: nyon mongs drug gi gzhi ma la/_/
english: in the foundation of the six afflictions,

wylie: byang chub sa bon stongs par byas/_/
english: the seed of awakening is emptied out.

wylie: ngan song gsum gyi gzugs smin te/_/
english: Forms of the three lower destinies ripen,

wylie: sku gsum po yang lag bcangs so/_/
english: and the three embodiments too are ‘lag bcangs’ [unresolved]. [N-215]

wylie: gzhan yang brjod bya'i lta ba bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the view of what is expressed.

wylie: srog ma bcad na sangs mi rgya/_/
english: If life is not cut, one does not become buddha. [N-216]

wylie: skar khung dag ni ma bkag na/_/
english: If the windows are not closed,

wylie: mun pa nyid ni sangs pa min/_/
english: the darkness itself is not cleared. [N-216]

wylie: sangs rgyas rnams kyi slob dpon ni/_/
english: The teacher of the buddhas,

wylie: dmyal ba chos kyi rgyal po la/_/
english: at the king of Dharma in hell,

wylie: chos kyis ngan song gsum du khrid/_/
english: leads through Dharma to the three lower destinies.

wylie: sdig spyad pas ni dge thob po/_/
english: Through practicing wrongdoing, virtue is attained. [N-217]

wylie: bltas pas khams gsum 'khor ba la/_/
english: Through viewing, [one enters] samsara in the three realms;

wylie: bsgoms pas nyon mongs tshogs kun sogs/_/
english: through cultivating, one gathers all the hosts of afflictions;

wylie: spyod pa spyad pas gol sgrib la/_/
english: through enacting activity, [one enters] deviation and obscuration;

wylie: 'bras bu 'khor ba'i rgyu nyid do/_/
english: the result is the very cause of samsara. [N-217]

wylie: gzhan yang brda don tshig 'brel bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the connection of symbolic meaning and phrases.

wylie: bskal pa'i me dpung klong dkyil na/_/
english: In the midst of an expanse of the conflagration of an age,

wylie: mi gcig tshig pa med par yang /_/
english: a person, without being burned,

wylie: kha nas sde snod chos bshad cing /_/
english: expounds the Dharma of the scriptural collections from his mouth,

wylie: las su gzhan gyi srog bcad pas/_/
english: while in action cutting another's life—

wylie: dge sbyor 'phel ba ya re cha/_/
english: and his virtuous practice increases. How strange! [N-217]

wylie: lcags kyi khang yangs sgo med nang*/_/
english: Inside a spacious iron house without a door,

wylie: snang med mun pa'i klong dkyil na/_/
english: in the midst of an expanse of lightless darkness,

wylie: nyi ma zla ba 'od gsal yang*/_/
english: although sun, moon, and clear light are there,

wylie: sus kyang mthong ba med pa ni/_/
english: no one sees them.

wylie: so so'i dbang po'i yul gsal bas/_/
english: The objects of each one's faculties are clear,

wylie: mthong ba med pa ya re cha/_/
english: yet there is no seeing. How strange! [N-217]

wylie: gzhan yang yul 'dzin blta ba bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the view that apprehends objects.

wylie: khams gsum 'khor ba'i gzhi stongs pas/_/
english: Emptying the Ground of samsara in the three realms,

wylie: mya ngan 'das pa phyags mas btab/_/
english: one sweeps away passing beyond sorrow.

wylie: ma rig 'khor ba'i rtsad bcad pas/_/
english: Cutting the root of ignorance and samsara,

wylie: sku gsum 'bras bu drungs nas phyung /_/
english: one uproots the result of the three embodiments.

wylie: mun pa'i go gyon nyi ma bsnubs/_/
english: Putting on the armor of darkness, one extinguishes the sun;

wylie: gsal ba'i mthong byed mun pas gtibs/_/
english: the clear means of seeing is covered by darkness.

wylie: rno ba'i ngar gdags gcig ma chod/_/
english: Giving an edge its sharp temper, not even one [thing] is cut.

wylie: rgya che dkyil stong gcig ma shongs/_/
english: With great breadth and an empty center, not even one [thing] fits.

wylie: sna tshogs 'dus pas gcig ma rnyed/_/
english: Gathering diversity, one is not found.

wylie: yod med mtha' rtog bsal ba'o/_/
english: Conceptual thought at the extremes of existence and nonexistence is cleared. [N-218]

wylie: gzhan yang 'dod sems blta ba bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the view of desiring ordinary mind.

wylie: kun brgyab gcig kyang ma chod pas/_/
english: Striking all, not even one is cut;

wylie: gcig brgyab thams cad gsad par bya/_/
english: striking one, all are to be killed.

wylie: mi brgya lcags sgrog gcig ma thar/_/
english: A hundred people in iron fetters—not one is freed;

wylie: gcig bzung bas ni thams cad thar/_/
english: holding one, all are freed.

wylie: thar pas gong du grol lam zad/_/
english: Through freedom, the path of liberation above is exhausted.

wylie: 'jug pa las kyi rgyu 'gags so/_/
english: The cause of entering activity ceases. [N-218]

wylie: gzhan yang spyod pa'i 'khor lo bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the wheel of activity.

wylie: ma byung bas na bdag med cing /_/
english: Since there is no arising, there is no self;

wylie: mi len mi 'dor sku yi rgya/_/
english: neither taking nor casting away is the seal of embodiment.

wylie: 'byung ba mi btsal yod mi spang*/_/
english: Do not search for elements; do not reject what exists.

wylie: 'dod pa bskyed cing chags mi bya/_/
english: Arouse desire, but do not become attached.

wylie: chags par byas te gtang bar bya'o/_/
english: Having become attached, let go.

wylie: gzhan lus mi smad mtho mi btsam/_/
english: Do not disparage another's body or set [your own] above it.

wylie: sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad/_/
english: Do not interrupt the flow of mantra and gestures.

wylie: grub mtha' mi spang chos mi spang /_/
english: Do not reject tenets; do not reject Dharma.

wylie: grogs dang bla ma mi smod do/_/
english: Do not disparage companions or the lama. [N-219]

wylie: gzhan yang dam tshig sdom pa bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain pledges and vows.

wylie: bla ma sangs rgyas mchod pa'i rten/_/
english: Lamas and buddhas are supports for offerings;

wylie: chos dang dge 'dun yi dam lha/_/
english: to Dharma, the community, chosen deities,

wylie: rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la/_/
english: and vajra ḍākinīs,

wylie: tshogs dang mchod pa rgyun mi gcad/_/
english: do not cut the flow of gathering offerings and other offerings.

wylie: bla ma mtshan nyid ldan mthong na/_/
english: On seeing a lama endowed with the characteristics,

wylie: bstod dang mchod pa rdzogs par bya'o/_/
english: make praise and offerings complete.

wylie: bud med mi smad khro mi bya/_/
english: Do not disparage women; do not become angry.

wylie: phung po mi smad yi dam brten/_/
english: Do not disparage the aggregates; rely on the chosen deity.

wylie: dkyil 'khor dang ni sngags dang lha/_/
english: Relying on mandalas, mantras, deities,

wylie: phyag rgya bsten pa yang dag nyid/_/
english: and gestures is authentic.

wylie: dad can tshogs nyid mi bcag la/_/
english: Do not break up gatherings of the faithful;

wylie: dge ldan sems ni mi dkrugs te/_/
english: do not disturb the ordinary minds of those possessing virtue.

wylie: sdom ldan dam tshig gnas par bya'o/_/
english: Possessing vows, abide in the pledges. [N-219]

wylie: gzhan yang bslab pa'i rim pa nyid/_/
english: Furthermore, the stages of training:

wylie: lus kyi spyod pa rdzogs bya ste/_/
english: complete the body's activity,

wylie: ngag ni rab tu gcad par bya'o/_/
english: and thoroughly cut speech.

wylie: sems ni gnas dang brtags shing dpyad/_/
english: Let ordinary mind abide, and examine and investigate it.

wylie: rim 'jug las kyi rim par ni/_/
english: In the stages of progressively entering activities,

wylie: tshad dang mtshan nyid shes par bya'o/_/
english: know the measures and characteristics.

wylie: rtag tu byugs dang ril bu yis/_/
english: Constantly, through ointments and pills,

wylie: rtsa rnams thig le'i dra bar gzhug_/
english: introduce the channels into a net of spheres. [N-220]

wylie: phreng ba do shal phyed pa yang /_/
english: Garlands, necklaces, and half-[necklaces] too,

wylie: mdzes shing 'khor bas sbrel bar bya/_/
english: beautiful and encircling, are to be connected.

wylie: las kyi bya ba dngos med gsal/_/
english: The doing of activity is clear and without things.

wylie: dngos grub mchog gi gtso bo blang*/_/
english: Take the foremost of supreme accomplishments;

wylie: gnas drug rgyan gyi 'khor lo bya'o/_/
english: make the wheel of adornments at the six places. [N-220]

wylie: gzhan yang bsten cing 'jug pa nyid/_/
english: Furthermore, reliance and entry:

wylie: bla ma bsten pas 'khor rgyun 'gags/_/
english: relying on the lama ceases the flow of samsara;

wylie: dbang bskur bsten pas lus ngag smin/_/
english: relying on empowerment ripens body and voice;

wylie: dam tshig bsten pas dngos grub 'byung*/_/_/
english: relying on pledges brings accomplishments;

wylie: spyod pa bsten pas lus sbyong 'gyur/_/
english: relying on activity trains the body.

wylie: bsten bya 'di las gang byung ba/_/
english: Whatever arises from these objects of reliance

wylie: 'di nyid dam tshig sdom pa'o/_/
english: is itself pledges and vows.

wylie: 'jug pa'i las ni rnam pa brgyad/_/
english: Activities of entry have eight aspects;

wylie: lus kyi 'jug pa lnga yin no/_/
english: bodily entry is fivefold;

wylie: ngag ni rnam pa brgyad du 'gyur/_/
english: voice has eight aspects;

wylie: sems kyi 'jug pa sum cu gnyis/_/
english: ordinary mind's entry is thirty-twofold.

wylie: lus sems khyad par byed pa nyid/_/
english: The special functioning of body and ordinary mind

wylie: las dang ye shes khyad nyid do/_/
english: is the distinction between karma and primordial knowing. [N-220]

wylie: gzhan yang bsgom pa'i gnas 'khor nyid/_/
english: Furthermore, the abiding-wheel of cultivation:

wylie: lus ni 'khrul 'khor sna tshogs kyis/_/
english: through training the body with diverse bodily exercises,

wylie: sbyangs pas sems kyi gnas par 'gyur/_/
english: ordinary mind comes to abide.

wylie: gsum gyi sbyor bas rtsa rnams mnyes/
english: Through three applications, soothe the channels;

wylie: sems ni bags kyis dgug par bya'o/_/
english: draw ordinary mind in gently.

wylie: mtshan ma mtshan ma bzo yi yang byung thabs bzo'i sbyor ba yi/_/
english: Through applications of signs and skillful craft—[Source variant: ‘craft of signs.’]

wylie: lus sems thabs kyi khyad par gyis/_/
english: through the distinct methods for body and ordinary mind,

wylie: rnal 'byor sems ni gnas par bya'o/_/
english: make the yogin's ordinary mind abide. [N-220]

wylie: gzhan yang 'khrul pa'i zhen rgyun bcad/_/
english: Furthermore, cut the flow of deluded clinging.

wylie: nyi zla'i 'od bsdus rgya mtsho drangs/_/
english: Gather the light of sun and moon; draw in the ocean.

wylie: stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal/_/
english: Weigh the Mount Merus of a three-thousandfold world on a balance.

wylie: ma rig gzhi bzlog rang rig go/_/
english: Reverse the Ground of ignorance: self-awareness. [N-221]

wylie: 'khor ba dpyis phyung 'das lam bkag_/
english: Draw samsara out entirely; block the path of passing beyond sorrow.

wylie: chos dang gang zag phyags mas btab/_/
english: Sweep away phenomena and persons.

wylie: 'bras bu rang rdzogs chos nyid gzhi/_/
english: The result is self-complete, the Ground of the nature of phenomena;

wylie: bya dang byed pa rang 'gags so/_/
english: doing and acting self-cease.

wylie: gzhan 'dod sred pa drungs nas 'don/_/
english: Draw out from the root craving that desires another.

wylie: chos kyi 'khrul pas _ye gzhi yang yas gzhi byas/_/
english: Delusion concerning phenomena makes a primordial basis. [Source variant: ‘upper basis.’] [N-221]

wylie: de nyid rang sar grol ba'i yul/_/
english: That itself is the object liberated in its own place.

wylie: khams gsum lam byas sangs rgyas med/_/
english: The three realms made the path, there is no buddha.

wylie: ston pa'i bstan pa su la srid med pa'o/_/
english: For whom could the teacher's teaching exist? It does not.

wylie: chos kun gzhi med rtsa ba su la srid/_/
english: All phenomena are without a Ground; for whom could a root exist?

wylie: srid bral 'dod pa med pa'i sems/_/
english: Ordinary mind free from existence and without desire,

wylie: rang bzhin ma bcos brjod las 'das/_/
english: uncontrived in intrinsic nature, is beyond expression.

wylie: bya byed 'khrul pa'i rtog pa zad/_/
english: Deluded conceptual thought of doing and acting is exhausted.

wylie: chos med sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/_/
english: There are no phenomena, no buddhas, and no sentient beings.

wylie: nga med bdag med gzung dang 'dzin pa med pa'o/
english: There is no I, no self, no apprehended object and no apprehending subject. [N-221]

wylie: _gzhan yang chos sku ro gcig bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the one taste of the dharma embodiment.

wylie: tshig tu brjod pa ma yin te/_/
english: It is not expressed in phrases;

wylie: sems zhes gnas pa tsam du'ang med/_/
english: there is not even mere abiding called ordinary mind.

english: As for the seed of the emanation embodiment, the four elements:

wylie: sgra don rnams la bslabs nas ni/_/

wylie: gzhan yang me yi las mtha' bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the scope of fire's activities.

wylie: kha dog gis ni rnam phye ba/_/
english: Distinguished through colors:

wylie: dkar gsal 'jam na zhi ba 'grub/_/
english: white, clear, and gentle accomplishes pacifying;

wylie: ser phra ring ba rgyas pa 'grub/_/
english: yellow, subtle, and long accomplishes increasing;

wylie: dmar dwangs 'phro ba dbang gi las/_/

wylie: sngo zhing gnag thung drag po 'grub/_/

wylie: sna tshogs chad cing 'khyil pa na/_/

wylie: sna tshogs las kyi bye brag 'grub/_/

wylie: dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ba'o/_/

wylie: sgra yi rnam par phye ba ni/_/

wylie: drag dang 'tsheg na drag po nyid/_/

wylie: 'ur zhing thug na zhi rgyas gnyis/_/

wylie: gshang zhing bsing na mchog 'grub pa'o/_/
english: resounding and ringing accomplish the supreme. [N-232]

wylie: gzhan yang chu yi las mtha' bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the scope of water's activities.

wylie: kha dog nges pa'i rtags nyid ni/_/
english: The definitive signs of colors:

wylie: dkar ba la sogs bzhi yis ni/_/
english: through the four beginning with white,

wylie: zhi ba la sogs 'grub par nges/_/
english: pacifying and the rest are definitely accomplished.

wylie: kham nag rtsub cing 'khyil pa na/_/
english: When brown-black, rough, and whirling,

wylie: rnal 'byor pa yis don mi 'grub/_/
english: the yogin does not accomplish the aim.

wylie: dkar gsal 'phyar dang 'phyur ba na/_/
english: When white and clear, rising and billowing,

wylie: mchog gi dngos grub nges 'thob bo/_/
english: the supreme accomplishment is definitely attained.

wylie: sgra ni gshang dang bsing ba dang /_/
english: Through sounds that resound and ring,

wylie: shwa dang 'ur zhing thug pa yis/_/
english: whoosh, roar, and are dense,

wylie: zas dang gos dang 'bras bu 'grub/_/
english: food, clothing, and the result are accomplished.

wylie: sir dang sil dang lhab pa yis/_/
english: Through sir, sil, and lhab sounds,

wylie: sku gsum so so'i bde thob pa'o/_/
english: the bliss of each of the three embodiments is attained. [N-232]

wylie: gzhan yang sa yi las mtha' bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the scope of earth's activities.

wylie: kha dog dkar dmar gong gis shes/_/
english: Know white, red, and the other colors from the preceding account.

wylie: ma nges 'gyur bas don mi 'grub/_/
english: Indeterminate change does not accomplish the aim.

wylie: gsal zhing 'tsher bas mchog 'grub pa'o/_/

wylie: sgra ni shag dang sdig pa dang*/_/
english: Its sounds are shag and sdig— [N-232]

wylie: gzhan yang rlung gi las mtha' bshad/_/
english: Furthermore, I shall explain the scope of wind's activities.

wylie: kha dog dkar dmar gong bzhin no/_/

wylie: gnag cing 'tshub pas don mi 'grub/_/

wylie: sna tshogs 'bar mchog 'grub pa yin/_/
english: Variegated blazing accomplishes the supreme.

wylie: sgra ni 'ur 'thib sna tshogs las/_/
english: Its sounds are roaring, muffled, and diverse;

wylie: sing dang sna tshogs mchog 'thob po/_/

wylie: gzhan yang rtags dang rang bzhin bshad/_/

wylie: de ltar gong gi rtags byung nas/_/

wylie: zla gsum dang ni zla drug nas/_/

wylie: gnyis kyis bem dang rig sgra shes/_/

wylie: zla bcu dang ni bco brgyad nas/_/

wylie: so so'i sgra dang rigs drug skad/_/

wylie: gzhan yang 'bras bu'i rim pa ni/_/

wylie: sprul pa'i sku ni lus kyis so/_/

wylie: ngo bo nyid ni cha mnyam pas/_/

wylie: lus ni 'byung ba dag pa dang*/_/

wylie: ngag gi A li ka lIr sbyor/_/

wylie: sems ni dngos med zang thal lo/_/

wylie: gzhan yang rab tu bshad bya ba/_/
english: Furthermore, this is to be fully explained:

wylie: sku yi mtshan nyid rab shes pas/_/

wylie: 'khrul pa thams cad dus gcig 'gags/_/

wylie: sku yi rang bzhin yongs shes pas/_/

wylie: gsal dang stong pa'i so mtshams zin/_/

wylie: ngo bo shes pas stong par dag_/

english: Through knowing ‘dang’ [reading unresolved], non-conceptuality arises. [N-234]

wylie: bdag nyid chen po shes pa yi/_/
english: Knowing the great identity,

wylie: khams gsum 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod/_/

wylie: de dag gis ni rang grol gdeng*/_/

wylie: _e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*/_/
english: Ema! Such wondrous marvel!

wylie: byas pa med pa'i nam mkha' la/_/
english: In space in which nothing is done,

wylie: bcos pa med pa'i tshig shar ba/_/

english: Having understood thus, through knowing and realization,

english: [one trusts] that, as the root of all the scriptural collections,

wylie: rang bzhin snang ba'i 'khor rnams kun/_/

wylie: rgyud 'di bklag dang bcang ba dang /_/

wylie: bri zhing 'dzin pa nyid du ste/_/

wylie: ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/_/

wylie: yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku la bstod/_/

wylie: de nas rab tu 'dus pa rnams/_/
english: Then all those fully assembled,

wylie: dga' mgu rang ba'i sems skyes nas/_/

wylie: nam mkha' rang dag gsal ba dang /_/

wylie: rjes su yi rang bde rnyed nas/_/

wylie: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po yi/_/

wylie: spros pa med dang mnyam par gyur/_/

wylie: chos rnams thig le nyag gcig gi/_/
